#### Chapter 17

**1 Chronicles 17:1**

And it came to pass, as David settled in his house, David said to Nathan prophet, Behold, I dwell in cedar house, but the ark of the covenant of the Lord is under curtains.

**1 Chronicles 17:2**

And Nathan said to David, Do all that is in your soul, because God is with you.

**1 Chronicles 17:3**

And it came to pass in that night, the word of the Lord came to Nathan, saying,

**1 Chronicles 17:4**

Go and speak to David my servant, Thus says the Lord, You shall not build me house for me to dwell in it.

**1 Chronicles 17:5**

Because I have not dwelt in a house from the day when I brought up Israel until this day, but I have been in tent and in dwelling-place.

**1 Chronicles 17:6**

In all places where I went through among all Israel, did I ever speak to one tribe of Israel, to shepherd my people, saying, Why have you not built me cedar house?

**1 Chronicles 17:7**

And now thus you shall say to my servant David, Thus says the Lord Almighty, I took you from the fold, from behind the sheep, to be ruler over my people Israel.

**1 Chronicles 17:8**

And I was with you in all places where you went, and I destroyed all your enemies from before you, and I made for you name like the name of great ones on earth.

**1 Chronicles 17:9**

And I will appoint place for my people Israel and plant him, and he shall dwell by himself and not be anxious anymore, and unrighteousness shall not again afflict him as from the beginning,

**1 Chronicles 17:10**

and from days when I appointed judges over my people Israel. And I humbled all your enemies, and I will increase you, and the Lord will build a house for you.

**1 Chronicles 17:11**

And it shall be, when your days are fulfilled and you sleep with your fathers, I will raise up your seed after you, who shall be from your belly, and I will prepare his kingdom.

**1 Chronicles 17:12**

He shall build me house, and I will set upright his throne forever.

**1 Chronicles 17:13**

I will be to him for father, and he shall be to me for son, and I will not remove my mercy from him, as I removed it from those before you.

**1 Chronicles 17:14**

And I will make him faithful in my house and in his kingdom forever, and his throne shall stand upright forever.

**1 Chronicles 17:15**

According to all these words and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.

**1 Chronicles 17:16**

And King David came and sat before the Lord and said, Who am I, the Lord God, and what is my house, that you loved me unto forever?

**1 Chronicles 17:17**

And these things were made small before you, O God, and you spoke concerning the house of your servant for long distance, and you looked upon me as vision of man, and you exalted me, Lord God.

**1 Chronicles 17:18**

What more shall David add to you to glorify? And you know your servant.

**1 Chronicles 17:19**

And according to your heart you did all this greatness.

**1 Chronicles 17:20**

Lord, there is none like you, and there is none besides you, according to all things we heard with our ears.

**1 Chronicles 17:21**

And there is no nation on earth like your people Israel, whom God led to redeem for himself as people, to make for himself great and manifest name, to drive out nations from before your people, whom you redeemed from Egypt.

**1 Chronicles 17:22**

And you gave your people Israel to yourself as people forever, and you, Lord, became God to them.

**1 Chronicles 17:23**

And now, Lord, let your word which you spoke concerning your servant and concerning his house be made faithful forever.

**1 Chronicles 17:24**

Let them say, O Lord, Lord Almighty, God of Israel, and let the house of David your servant be established before you.

**1 Chronicles 17:25**

Because you, Lord, opened ear of your servant to build him house. Therefore your servant found courage to pray before you.

**1 Chronicles 17:26**

And now, Lord, you are that God, and you spoke these good things concerning your servant.

**1 Chronicles 17:27**

And now you began to bless the house of your servant, that it may be forever before you, because you, Lord, blessed; bless forever.

#### Chapter 19

**1 Chronicles 19:1**

And it came to pass after these things, Nahash king of sons of Ammon died, and Anan his son reigned in his place.

**1 Chronicles 19:2**

And David said, I will do mercy with Anan son of Nahash, as his father did mercy with me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. And the servants of David came into the land of sons of Ammon to comfort him.

**1 Chronicles 19:3**

And the rulers of Ammon said to Anan, Does David honor your father before you because he sent comforters to you? Did not his servants come to you to search city and spy out land?

**1 Chronicles 19:4**

**1 Chronicles 19:5**

**1 Chronicles 19:6**

**1 Chronicles 19:7**

And they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots and the king of Maachah and his people, and they came and camped opposite Medeba. And sons of Ammon gathered from their cities and came to battle.

**1 Chronicles 19:8**

And David heard and sent Joab and all army of mighty men.

**1 Chronicles 19:9**

And sons of Ammon came out and drew up for battle by the gate of the city, and kings who came camped by themselves in the plain.

**1 Chronicles 19:10**

**1 Chronicles 19:11**

And the rest of the people he gave into the hand of Abishai his brother, and they drew up opposite sons of Ammon.

**1 Chronicles 19:12**

And he said, If Syrians prevail over me, you shall be for salvation to me, and if sons of Ammon prevail over you, I will save you.

**1 Chronicles 19:13**

Act like a man, and let us strengthen ourselves for our people and for the cities of our God, and the Lord will do what is good in his eyes.

**1 Chronicles 19:14**

And Joab drew up, and people with him, opposite Syrians for battle, and they fled from him.

**1 Chronicles 19:15**

And sons of Ammon saw that Syrians fled, and they too fled from before Joab and from before Abishai his brother and came into the city. And Joab came to Jerusalem.

**1 Chronicles 19:16**

And Syria saw that Israel routed him, and they sent messengers and brought out Syrians from beyond river, with Shophach commander of force of Hadarezer before them.

**1 Chronicles 19:17**

And it was reported to David, and he gathered all Israel and crossed Jordan and came against them and drew up against them. And Syria drew up opposite David and fought him.

**1 Chronicles 19:18**

And Syria fled from before David, and David killed from Syria seven thousand chariots and forty thousand footmen, and he killed Shophach commander of force.

**1 Chronicles 19:19**

And the servants of Hadarezer saw that they had fallen before Israel, and they made covenant with David and served him. And Syria did not want to help sons of Ammon anymore.

#### Chapter 20

**1 Chronicles 20:1**

**1 Chronicles 20:2**

**1 Chronicles 20:5**

**1 Chronicles 20:6**

**1 Chronicles 20:7**

**1 Chronicles 20:8**

#### Chapter 21

**1 Chronicles 21:1**

And slanderer stood up against Israel and stirred David to number Israel.

**1 Chronicles 21:2**

And King David said to Joab and to the chiefs of force, Go, number Israel from Beersheba to Dan, and bring to me, and I shall know their number.

**1 Chronicles 21:3**

And Joab said, May the Lord add to his people a hundredfold as they are, and are not eyes of my lord the king seeing that all are servants to my lord? Why does my lord seek this, so that it should not become sin for Israel?

**1 Chronicles 21:4**

But the word of the king prevailed over Joab. And Joab went out and passed through every border of Israel and came to Jerusalem.

**1 Chronicles 21:5**

And Joab gave number of mustering of the people to David, and all Israel was one million one hundred thousand men drawing sword, and Judah was four hundred eighty thousand men drawing sword.

**1 Chronicles 21:6**

**1 Chronicles 21:7**

And thing appeared evil before God concerning this matter, and he struck Israel.

**1 Chronicles 21:8**

And David said to God, I sinned greatly because I did this thing, and now please take away evil of your servant, because I acted very foolishly.

**1 Chronicles 21:9**

And the Lord spoke to Gad, seer of David, saying,

**1 Chronicles 21:10**

Go and speak to David, saying, Thus says the Lord, I lift three things upon you; choose one of them for yourself, and I will do it to you.

**1 Chronicles 21:11**

And Gad came to David and said to him, Thus says the Lord, Choose for yourself:

**1 Chronicles 21:12**

either three years of famine, or three months for you to flee from before your enemies while sword of your enemies destroys, or three days sword of the Lord and death in the land, and angel of the Lord destroying in all inheritance of Israel. And now see what word I should answer to one who sent me.

**1 Chronicles 21:13**

And David said to Gad, All three press me very hard. Let me now fall into the hands of the Lord, because his mercies are very many; but into the hands of men I shall not fall.

**1 Chronicles 21:14**

And the Lord gave death in Israel, and seventy thousand men fell from Israel.

**1 Chronicles 21:15**

And God sent angel into Jerusalem to destroy it, and as he destroyed, the Lord saw and relented over evil and said to angel destroying, It is enough for you; let go your hand. And the angel of the Lord was standing at the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

**1 Chronicles 21:16**

And David lifted his eyes and saw angel of the Lord standing between earth and between heaven, with his sword drawn in his hand, stretched out over Jerusalem. And David and elders clothed in sackcloth fell on their faces.

**1 Chronicles 21:17**

And David said to God, Was it not I who said to number among people? And I am one who sinned; I acted evilly with evil. But these sheep, what did they do? Lord God, let your hand be on me and on the house of my father, and not on your people for destruction, Lord.

**1 Chronicles 21:18**

And the angel of the Lord said to Gad to tell David to go up and set altar to the Lord at the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

**1 Chronicles 21:19**

And David went up according to the word of Gad, which he spoke in the name of the Lord.

**1 Chronicles 21:20**

And Araunah turned and saw king, and his four sons with him were hiding themselves, and Araunah was threshing wheat.

**1 Chronicles 21:21**

And David came to Araunah, and Araunah came out from threshing floor and bowed to David with his face to the ground.

**1 Chronicles 21:22**

And David said to Araunah, Give me place of your threshing floor, and I will build on it altar to the Lord. For silver at full worth give it to me, and plague will stop from people.

**1 Chronicles 21:23**

And Araunah said to David, Take for yourself, and let my lord the king do good in his sight. Behold, I have given calves for whole burnt offering, and plow and wagons for wood, and wheat for sacrifice; I have given all.

**1 Chronicles 21:24**

And King David said to Araunah, No, because by buying I will buy for full worth in silver, because I shall not take what is yours for the Lord, to offer free whole burnt offering to the Lord.

**1 Chronicles 21:25**

And David gave to Araunah in his place six hundred shekels of weight in gold.

**1 Chronicles 21:26**

And David built there altar to the Lord and offered whole burnt offerings and offerings of salvation, and cried out to the Lord, and he answered him with fire from heaven upon the altar of whole burnt offering and consumed whole burnt offering.

**1 Chronicles 21:27**

And the Lord spoke to angel, and he put sword into sheath.

**1 Chronicles 21:28**

At that time, when David saw that the Lord answered him at the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite, he sacrificed there.

**1 Chronicles 21:29**

And tent of the Lord which Moses made in the wilderness, and altar of whole burnt offerings, were at that time at high place in Gibeon.

**1 Chronicles 21:30**

And David was not able to go before it to seek God, because he hurried in fear from before sword of angel of the Lord.

#### Chapter 22

**1 Chronicles 22:1**

**1 Chronicles 22:2**

**1 Chronicles 22:4**

**1 Chronicles 22:8**

**1 Chronicles 22:9**

**1 Chronicles 22:13**

**1 Chronicles 22:14**

**1 Chronicles 22:15**

And with you are workers in abundance, craftsmen and builders of stone and carpenters of wood and every wise man in every work,

**1 Chronicles 22:16**

in gold, in silver, in bronze, and in iron there is no number. Rise and do, and the Lord be with you.

**1 Chronicles 22:17**

And David commanded all rulers of Israel to help Solomon his son:

**1 Chronicles 22:18**

Is not the Lord with you and has he not given you rest all around? Because he gave inhabitants of the land into hands, and land is subdued before the Lord and before his people.

**1 Chronicles 22:19**

From these, overseers over the works of the house of the Lord were twenty-four thousand, and scribes and judges six thousand,

**1 Chronicles 23:5**

and four thousand gatekeepers, and four thousand praising the Lord with instruments which he made for praising the Lord.

**1 Chronicles 23:6**

And David divided them into courses for the sons of Levi: to Gershon, Kohath, Merari.

**1 Chronicles 23:7**

And to Gershon, to Laadan and to Shimei.

**1 Chronicles 23:8**

Sons of Laadan: chief Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.

**1 Chronicles 23:9**

Sons of Shimei: Shelomith and Jeiel and Haran, three. These were chiefs of fathers for Laadan.

**1 Chronicles 23:10**

And to the sons of Shimei: Jahath and Ziza and Joash and Beriah; these were four sons of Shimei.

**1 Chronicles 23:11**

And Jahath was chief and Ziza second; Joash and Beriah did not multiply sons, and they became one father-house in one reckoning.

**1 Chronicles 23:12**

Sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, Uzziel, four.

**1 Chronicles 23:13**

Sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. And Aaron was set apart to be sanctified as holy of holies, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before the Lord, to minister, and to bless upon his name forever.

**1 Chronicles 23:14**

And Moses, man of God, his sons were called into the tribe of Levi.

**1 Chronicles 23:15**

Sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

**1 Chronicles 23:16**

Sons of Gershom: Shebuel chief.

**1 Chronicles 23:17**

And sons of Eliezer: Rehabiah chief. And Eliezer had no other sons, but sons of Rehabiah increased greatly.

**1 Chronicles 23:18**

Sons of Izhar: Shelomith chief.

**1 Chronicles 23:19**

Sons of Hebron: Idoud chief, Amariah second, Uzziel third, Ikemias fourth.

**1 Chronicles 23:20**

Sons of Uzziel: Micah chief, and Jesiah second.

**1 Chronicles 23:21**

Sons of Merari: Mahali and Mushi. Sons of Mahali: Eleazar and Kish.

**1 Chronicles 23:22**

And Eleazar died, and he had no sons but daughters, and sons of Kish their brothers took them.

**1 Chronicles 23:23**

Sons of Mushi: Mahali and Eder and Jeremoth, three.

**1 Chronicles 23:24**

These were sons of Levi according to the houses of their fathers, chiefs of fathers according to their mustering, by the number of their names, by head, doing works of service of the house of the Lord from twenty years old and upward.

**1 Chronicles 23:25**

Because David said, the Lord God of Israel gave rest to his people, and he dwelt in Jerusalem forever.

**1 Chronicles 23:26**

And Levites were no longer carrying tent and all its vessels for its service.

**1 Chronicles 23:27**

For in last words of David is number of sons of Levi from twenty years old and upward.

**1 Chronicles 23:28**

Because he set them by the hand of Aaron to minister in the house of the Lord, over courts and over storerooms and over the cleansing of all holy things and over the works of service of the house of God,

**1 Chronicles 23:29**

for the bread of presentation and for the fine flour of offering and for unleavened wafers and for griddle and for mixed dough and for every measure,

**1 Chronicles 23:30**

and to stand morning by morning to praise and give thanks to the Lord, and likewise at evening,

**1 Chronicles 23:31**

and over all whole burnt offerings offered to the Lord on Sabbaths and on new moons and on feasts, by number according to ordinance upon them continually before the Lord,

**1 Chronicles 23:32**

and they shall keep charges of the tent of testimony and charges of the sons of Aaron their brothers, to minister in the house of the Lord.

#### Chapter 24

**1 Chronicles 24:1**

to Jeshuah ninth, to Shecaniah tenth,

**1 Chronicles 24:12**

to Eliashib eleventh, to Jakim twelfth,

**1 Chronicles 24:13**

to Ochchoppha thirteenth, to Eshbaal fourteenth,

**1 Chronicles 24:14**

to Bilgah fifteenth, to Immer sixteenth,

**1 Chronicles 24:15**

to Hezir seventeenth, to Aphesse eighteenth,

**1 Chronicles 24:16**

to Pethahiah nineteenth, to Jehezekel twentieth,

to Jachin twenty-first, to Gamul twenty-second,

**1 Chronicles 24:18**

**1 Chronicles 24:26**

Sons of Merari: Mahali and Mushi; sons of Uzziah: sons of Bonni.

**1 Chronicles 24:27**

**1 Chronicles 24:28**

**1 Chronicles 24:29**

**1 Chronicles 24:30**

**1 Chronicles 24:31**

**1 Chronicles 25:1**

**1 Chronicles 26:1**

**1 Chronicles 26:6**

**1 Chronicles 26:16**

**1 Chronicles 26:21**

**1 Chronicles 26:22**

**1 Chronicles 26:23**

**1 Chronicles 26:24**

**1 Chronicles 27:1**

for Levi, Hashabiah son of Kemuel; for Aaron, Zadok;

for Zebulun, Shemaiah son of Obadiah; for Naphtali, Jerimoth son of Azriel;

for Ephraim, Hoshea son of Uzziah; for the half tribe of Manasseh, Joel son of Pedaiah;

#### Chapter 28

**1 Chronicles 28:1**

And David assembled all rulers of Israel, rulers of judges and rulers of courses around body of the king and rulers of thousands and of hundreds and treasurers and those over his possessions and mighty lords and fighters of army, in Jerusalem.

**1 Chronicles 28:2**

And David stood in the midst of assembly and said, Hear me, my brothers and my people. It came upon my heart to build the house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the Lord and footstool of our Lord, and I prepared fitting things for dwelling.

**1 Chronicles 28:3**

But God said, You shall not build me a house to have my name called upon it, because you are man of war and have poured out blood.

**1 Chronicles 28:4**

And the Lord God of Israel chose me from all house of my father to be king over Israel forever, and in Judah he chose kingdom, and from the house of Judah house of my father, and among sons of my father he desired in me to make me king over all Israel.

**1 Chronicles 28:5**

And from all my sons, because the Lord gave me many sons, he chose in Solomon my son to seat him upon the throne of the kingdom of the Lord over Israel.

**1 Chronicles 28:6**

And God said to me, Solomon your son shall build my house and my court, because I chose him to be son to me, and I will be father to him.

**1 Chronicles 28:7**

And I will set his kingdom right forever, if he is strong to keep my commandments and my judgments, as this day.

**1 Chronicles 28:8**

And now, before all the assembly of the Lord and in the ears of our God, keep and seek all commandments of the Lord our God, so that you may inherit good land and leave inheritance to your sons after you forever.

**1 Chronicles 28:9**

And now, Solomon my son, know God of your fathers and serve him with complete heart and willing soul, because the Lord examines all hearts and knows every thought. If you seek him, he will be found by you; and if you forsake him, he will forsake you to end.

**1 Chronicles 28:10**

See now, because the Lord chose you to build him house for sanctuary. Be strong and do.

**1 Chronicles 28:11**

And David gave to Solomon his son pattern of the temple and of its houses and its treasuries and upper rooms and inner storehouses and house of propitiation,

**1 Chronicles 28:12**

and pattern which he had in his spirit of the courts of the house of the Lord and all storerooms around, for treasuries of the house of the Lord and treasuries of holy things,

**1 Chronicles 28:13**

and of chambers of courses of priests and Levites, for every work of service of the house of the Lord and of storehouses of vessels of service of worship of the house of the Lord,

**1 Chronicles 28:14**

and weight of their weighing, both of gold and silver things,

**1 Chronicles 28:15**

weight of lampstands and of lamps he gave him,

**1 Chronicles 28:16**

he likewise gave him weight of tables of presentation, each golden table, and likewise silver ones,

**1 Chronicles 28:17**

and for flesh-hooks and bowls and golden cups, and weight of gold and of silver for each kefphoure according to weight,

**1 Chronicles 28:18**

and for altar of incense, weight from refined gold he showed him, and pattern of chariot of cheroubim spreading wings and overshadowing the ark of the covenant of the Lord.

**1 Chronicles 28:19**

All in the writing of the hand of the Lord, David gave to Solomon according to understanding given to him for working of pattern.

**1 Chronicles 28:20**

And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and act like a man and do. Do not fear and do not be dismayed, because the Lord my God is with you. He will not let go of you and will not forsake you until you finish every work of service of the house of the Lord.

**1 Chronicles 28:21**

And behold, courses of priests and Levites for every service of the house of God are with you, and with you in every work are all willing men in wisdom for every craft, and rulers and all the people for all your words.

#### Chapter 29

**1 Chronicles 29:1**

And King David said to all the assembly, Solomon my son, in whom alone the Lord chose, is young and tender, and work is great, because building not for man but for the Lord God.

**1 Chronicles 29:2**

With all my strength I prepared for the house of my God gold, silver, bronze, iron, wood, shoham stones and filling stones and precious stones and varied stones and every precious stone and much Parian stone.

**1 Chronicles 29:3**

And still, because I delighted in the house of my God, I have gold and silver which I kept for myself, and behold, I gave it for the house of my God in addition to what I prepared for the house of holy things,

**1 Chronicles 29:4**

three thousand talents of gold from Ophir and seven thousand talents of refined silver to overlay walls of sanctuary with them,

**1 Chronicles 29:5**

by the hand of craftsmen. And who is willing to fill his hands for the Lord today?

**1 Chronicles 29:6**

And chiefs of fathers and rulers of sons of Israel and commanders of thousands and of hundreds and leaders of works and stewards of the king were made willing.

**1 Chronicles 29:7**

And they gave for the works of the house of the Lord five thousand talents of gold and ten thousand gold pieces, and ten thousand talents of silver, and eighteen thousand talents of bronze, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.

**1 Chronicles 29:8**

And those with whom stone was found gave it to treasuries of the house of the Lord by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

**1 Chronicles 29:9**

And the people rejoiced over their willingness, because with full heart they were made willing to the Lord, and King David rejoiced greatly.

**1 Chronicles 29:10**

And King David blessed the Lord before assembly, saying, Blessed are you, Lord God of Israel our father, from age and unto age.

**1 Chronicles 29:11**

Yours, Lord, are greatness and power and boasting and victory and strength, because you rule all things in heaven and on earth; before your face every king and nation is troubled.

**1 Chronicles 29:12**

From you are riches and glory; you rule all things, Lord, ruler of every beginning, and in your hand are strength and lordship, and in your hand, Almighty One, to magnify and strengthen all things.

**1 Chronicles 29:13**

And now, Lord, we give thanks to you and praise the name of your boasting.

**1 Chronicles 29:14**

And who am I, and who are my people, that we grew strong to be willing to you in this way? Because all things are yours, and from your things we gave to you.

**1 Chronicles 29:15**

Because we are sojourners before you and temporary residents, as all our fathers were. Our days on earth are like a shadow, and there is no staying.

**1 Chronicles 29:16**

Lord our God, all this abundance which I prepared to build a house for is from your hand, and all things are yours.

**1 Chronicles 29:17**

And I knew, Lord, that you examine hearts and love righteousness. In simplicity of heart I was willing for all these things, and now I saw your people found here willingly giving to you with gladness.

**1 Chronicles 29:18**

Lord God of Abraham and Isaac and Israel our fathers, keep these things in thought of heart of your people forever, and direct their hearts toward you.

**1 Chronicles 29:19**

And to Solomon my son give good heart to do your commandments and your testimonies and your ordinances, and to bring building of your house to completion.

**1 Chronicles 29:20**

And David said to all the assembly, Bless the Lord your God. And all the assembly blessed the Lord God of their fathers, and bowing knees they worshiped the Lord and the king.

**1 Chronicles 29:21**

And David sacrificed sacrifices to the Lord and offered whole burnt offerings to God on next day after first day: one thousand calves, one thousand rams, one thousand lambs, and their libations, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel.

**1 Chronicles 29:22**

And they ate and drank before the Lord on that day with joy, and they made Solomon son of David king a second time, and anointed him to the Lord as king and Zadok to priesthood.

**1 Chronicles 29:23**

And Solomon sat on the throne of David his father and prospered, and all Israel listened to him.

**1 Chronicles 29:24**

Rulers and mighty lords and all sons of King David his father submitted to him.

**1 Chronicles 29:25**

And the Lord magnified Solomon exceedingly before all Israel and gave him royal glory such as did not happen on any king before him.

**1 Chronicles 29:26**

And David son of Jesse reigned over Israel.

**1 Chronicles 29:27**

Forty years: in Hebron seven years and in Jerusalem thirty-three years.

**1 Chronicles 29:28**

And he died in good old age, full of days, riches, and glory, and Solomon his son reigned in his place.

**1 Chronicles 29:29**

And the rest of matters of King David, first and last, are written in the words of Samuel seer and in the words of Nathan prophet and in the words of Gad seer,

**1 Chronicles 29:30**

concerning all his kingdom and his mighty rule and times which came upon him and upon Israel and upon all kingdoms of the earth.

### 2 Chronicles

#### Chapter 1

**2 Chronicles 1:1**

And Solomon son of David was strengthened over his kingdom, and the Lord his God was with him and magnified him on high.

**2 Chronicles 1:2**

And Solomon spoke to all Israel, to commanders of thousands and of hundreds and to judges and to all rulers before Israel, to the chiefs of fathers.

**2 Chronicles 1:3**

And Solomon and all the assembly with him went to high place in Gibeon, because there was the tent of testimony of God which Moses servant of the Lord made in the wilderness.

**2 Chronicles 1:4**

But David brought up the ark of God from the city Kirjathjearim, because he prepared tent for it in Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 1:5**

And bronze altar which Bezaleel son of Ourios son of Hur made was there before the tent of the Lord, and Solomon and assembly sought it.

**2 Chronicles 1:6**

And there Solomon brought up upon bronze altar before the Lord, the one in tent, and brought up upon it one thousand whole burnt offerings.

**2 Chronicles 1:7**

In that night God appeared to Solomon and said to him, Ask what I should give you.

**2 Chronicles 1:8**

And Solomon said to God, You did great mercy with David my father and made me king in his place.

**2 Chronicles 1:9**

And now, Lord God, let your name be made faithful upon David my father, because you made me king over numerous people like dust of the earth.

**2 Chronicles 1:10**

Now give me wisdom and understanding, and I shall go out before this people and come in, because who can judge this great people of yours?

**2 Chronicles 1:11**

And God said to Solomon, Because this came to be in your heart, and you did not ask wealth, riches, or glory, nor life of your adversaries, nor many days, but asked wisdom and understanding for yourself so that you may judge my people over whom I made you king,

**2 Chronicles 1:12**

wisdom and understanding I give to you, and wealth and riches and glory I will give to you such as none among kings before you had, and after you there shall not be thus.

**2 Chronicles 1:13**

And Solomon came from high place in Gibeon to Jerusalem, from before the tent of testimony, and reigned over Israel.

**2 Chronicles 1:14**

And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen, and he had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen, and he placed them in the cities of chariots, and people were with the king in Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 1:15**

And the king made gold and silver in Jerusalem like stones, and cedars in Judah like sycamines in lowland in abundance.

**2 Chronicles 1:16**

And the export of horses for Solomon was from Egypt, and merchants of the king were trading and buying at price.

**2 Chronicles 1:17**

And they were bringing up and bringing out from Egypt chariot for six hundred silver and horse for one hundred fifty, and thus for all kings of Hittites and kings of Syria they brought by their hands.

**2 Chronicles 1:18**

And Solomon spoke of building a house to the name of the Lord and a house for his kingdom.

#### Chapter 2

**2 Chronicles 2:1**

And Solomon gathered seventy thousand men and eighty thousand stonecutters in mountain and three thousand six hundred overseers over them.

**2 Chronicles 2:2**

And Solomon sent to Hiram king of Tyre, saying, As you did with David my father and sent him cedars to build a house for to dwell in it,

**2 Chronicles 2:3**

behold, I his son am building a house to the name of the Lord my God, to sanctify it to him, to burn incense of spices before him and perpetual presentation and to offer whole burnt offerings continually morning and evening and on Sabbaths and on new moons and on feasts of the Lord our God. This is forever upon Israel.

**2 Chronicles 2:4**

And house which I am building is great, because our God is great above all gods.

**2 Chronicles 2:5**

And who will have strength to build him house? Because heaven and heaven of heavens do not bear his glory. And who am I building him house, except to burn incense before him?

**2 Chronicles 2:6**

And now send me wise man, one knowing how to work in gold and silver and bronze and iron and purple and scarlet and blue, and knowing how to carve carving, together with wise men with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father prepared.

**2 Chronicles 2:7**

And send me cedar woods and juniper woods and pine woods from Lebanon, because I know your servants know how to cut woods from Lebanon, and behold, your servants are with my servants,

**2 Chronicles 2:8**

to prepare woods for me in abundance, because house which I am building is great and glorious.

**2 Chronicles 2:9**

And behold, for workers, those cutting woods for food, I gave grain to your servants, twenty thousand kors, and barley, twenty thousand kors, and wine, twenty thousand measures, and oil, twenty thousand measures.

**2 Chronicles 2:10**

And Hiram king of Tyre answered in writing and sent to Solomon, Because the Lord loved his people, he gave you king over them.

**2 Chronicles 2:11**

And Hiram said, Blessed is the Lord God of Israel who made heaven and earth, who gave to King David wise son, knowing understanding and knowledge, who will build a house to and a house for his kingdom.

**2 Chronicles 2:12**

And now I have sent to you wise man, knowing understanding, Hiram my father,

**2 Chronicles 2:13**

whose mother was from the daughters of Dan and whose father was Tyrian man, knowing how to work in gold and in silver and in bronze and in iron, in stones and woods, and to weave in purple and in blue and in fine linen and in scarlet, and to carve carvings and devise every design whatever you give him, together with your wise men and wise men of David my lord your father.

**2 Chronicles 2:14**

And now let my lord send to his servants grain and barley and oil and wine which my lord spoke of.

**2 Chronicles 2:15**

And we shall cut woods from Lebanon according to all your need, and we shall bring them on rafts by sea to Joppa, and you shall bring them up to Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 2:16**

And Solomon gathered all sojourning men in the land of Israel, after number by which David his father numbered them, and they were found to be one hundred fifty-three thousand six hundred.

**2 Chronicles 2:17**

And he made from them seventy thousand carriers of burdens and eighty thousand stonecutters and three thousand six hundred overseers over people.

#### Chapter 3

**2 Chronicles 3:1**

And Solomon began building the house of the Lord in Jerusalem on the mountain of Moriah, where the Lord appeared to David his father, in place which David prepared at the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

**2 Chronicles 3:2**

And he began building in the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.

**2 Chronicles 3:3**

And these are foundations which Solomon laid for building the house of God: length by first measure, sixty cubits, and width twenty cubits.

**2 Chronicles 3:4**

And vestibule before the house, length according to breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and height one hundred twenty cubits, and he overlaid it inside with pure gold.

**2 Chronicles 3:5**

And great house he paneled with cedar woods and overlaid it with pure gold and carved upon it palms and chains.

**2 Chronicles 3:6**

And he adorned house with precious stones for glory, and with gold, gold from Pharouaim.

**2 Chronicles 3:7**

And he gilded house and walls and doorposts and ceilings and doors with gold, and carved cheroubim on walls.

**2 Chronicles 3:8**

And he made the house of the holy of holies, its length according to breadth, twenty cubits, and its width twenty cubits, and he overlaid it with pure gold, for cheroubim, six hundred talents.

**2 Chronicles 3:9**

And weight of nails, weight of one, fifty shekels of gold, and upper rooms he gilded with gold.

**2 Chronicles 3:10**

And he made in the house of holy of holies two cheroubim, work from woods, and gilded them with gold.

**2 Chronicles 3:11**

And the wings of cheroubim were twenty cubits in length; one wing five cubits touching wall of the house, and other wing five cubits touching wing of other cheroub.

**2 Chronicles 3:12**

And wing of one cheroub was five cubits touching wall of the house, and other wing five cubits touching wing of other cheroub.

**2 Chronicles 3:13**

And the wings of cheroubim spread out were twenty cubits, and they stood on their feet, and their faces were toward house.

**2 Chronicles 3:14**

And he made veil of blue and purple and scarlet and fine linen, and wove cheroubim in it.

**2 Chronicles 3:15**

And he made before the house two pillars, thirty-five cubits high, and their capitals five cubits.

**2 Chronicles 3:16**

And he made chains in debir and put them on the heads of pillars, and he made one hundred pomegranates and put them on chains.

**2 Chronicles 3:17**

And he set pillars before the temple, one at right and one at left, and he called name of right one Uprightness and name of left one Strength.

#### Chapter 4

**2 Chronicles 4:1**

And he made bronze altar, twenty cubits long and twenty cubits broad and ten cubits high.

**2 Chronicles 4:2**

And he made cast sea, ten cubits across, round all around, and its height five cubits, and its circuit thirty cubits.

**2 Chronicles 4:3**

And likeness of calves under it around encircled it, ten cubits surrounding laver all around, two kinds having cast calves in their casting.

**2 Chronicles 4:4**

Which they made: twelve calves, three facing north and three facing west and three facing south and three facing east, and sea was above them, and their hind parts were inward.

**2 Chronicles 4:5**

And its thickness was a handbreadth, and its rim like the rim of a cup, carved lily blossoms, holding three thousand measures, and it was finished.

**2 Chronicles 4:6**

And he made ten lavers and set five on right and five on left, to wash in them works of whole burnt offerings and rinse in them, and sea was for priests to wash in it.

**2 Chronicles 4:7**

And he made ten gold lampstands according to their ordinance and set them in the temple, five on right and five on left.

**2 Chronicles 4:8**

And he made ten tables and set them in the temple, five on right and five on left, and he made one hundred golden bowls.

**2 Chronicles 4:9**

And he made court of priests and great court and doors for court, and their door-panels plated with bronze.

**2 Chronicles 4:10**

And he set the sea from the corner of the house on the right, toward east, opposite.

**2 Chronicles 4:11**

And Hiram made flesh-hooks and firepans and grate of altar and all its vessels, and Hiram finished making all work which Solomon the king made in the house of God:

**2 Chronicles 4:12**

two pillars, and upon them bowl-capitals on the heads of pillars, two, and two nets to cover two bowl-capitals which were on the heads of pillars,

**2 Chronicles 4:13**

and four hundred golden pomegranates for two nets, two sets of pomegranates on one net to cover two bowl-capitals which were above pillars,

**2 Chronicles 4:14**

and he made ten stands and made lavers upon stands,

**2 Chronicles 4:15**

and one sea and twelve calves under it,

**2 Chronicles 4:16**

and footstools and forks and cauldrons and flesh-hooks and all their vessels, which Hiram made and brought to King Solomon for the house of the Lord, of pure bronze.

**2 Chronicles 4:17**

In the region of Jordan the king cast them in the thickness of the earth, in the house of Succoth and between Sirdatha.

**2 Chronicles 4:18**

And Solomon made all these vessels in very great abundance, because weight of bronze did not fail.

**2 Chronicles 4:19**

And Solomon made all vessels of the house of the Lord, and golden altar and tables, and on them breads of presentation,

**2 Chronicles 4:20**

and lampstands and lamps for light according to ordinance and before debir, of pure gold,

**2 Chronicles 4:21**

and their tongs and their lamps and bowls and censers and firepans of pure gold,

**2 Chronicles 4:22**

and inner door of the house into the holy of holies, and doors of the house of the temple, golden.

#### Chapter 5

**2 Chronicles 5:1**

And all work which Solomon made in the house of the Lord was finished, and Solomon brought in the holy things of David his father, silver and gold and vessels, and gave them into treasure of the house of the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 5:2**

Then Solomon assembled elders of Israel and all rulers of tribes, leaders of fathers of sons of Israel, in Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord from the City of David, this is Zion.

**2 Chronicles 5:3**

And every man of Israel was assembled to the king at feast, this seventh month.

**2 Chronicles 5:4**

And all the elders of Israel came, and all the Levites took the ark.

**2 Chronicles 5:5**

And they brought up ark and the tent of testimony and all holy vessels in tent; priests and Levites brought them up.

**2 Chronicles 5:6**

And King Solomon and all congregation of Israel, those fearing and gathered with him before the ark, were sacrificing calves and sheep which cannot be numbered and cannot be reckoned from multitude.

**2 Chronicles 5:7**

And priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the Lord to its place, into debir of the house, into the holy of holies, under wings of cheroubim.

**2 Chronicles 5:8**

And cheroubim were spreading out their wings over the place of the ark, and cheroubim were covering the ark and its carrying-poles above.

**2 Chronicles 5:9**

And carrying-poles projected, and heads of poles were seen from holy place before debir, but were not seen outside, and they were there until this day.

**2 Chronicles 5:10**

There was nothing in the ark except two tablets which Moses put in Horeb, when the Lord made covenant with the sons of Israel as they came out from the land of Egypt.

**2 Chronicles 5:11**

And it came to pass when priests came out from holy place, because all priests found there had sanctified themselves; they were not arranged by courses.

**2 Chronicles 5:12**

And Levites, singers, all sons of Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and their sons and their brothers, clothed in linen robes with cymbals and harps and lyres, were standing opposite altar, and with them one hundred twenty priests blowing trumpets.

**2 Chronicles 5:13**

And one sound came to be in blowing trumpets and in singing psalms and in sounding one voice, to give thanks and praise to the Lord. And as they raised voice with trumpets and cymbals and instruments of songs and said, Give thanks to the Lord, because he is good, because his mercy is forever, house was filled with cloud of the glory of the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 5:14**

And priests were not able to stand to minister from the presence of cloud, because the glory of the Lord filled the house of God.

#### Chapter 6

**2 Chronicles 6:1**

Then Solomon said, the Lord said he would dwell in thick darkness.

**2 Chronicles 6:2**

And I built holy house to your name for you, ready for dwelling forever.

**2 Chronicles 6:3**

And the king turned his face and blessed all the assembly of Israel, and all the assembly of Israel stood there.

**2 Chronicles 6:4**

And he said, Blessed is the Lord God of Israel, who spoke with his mouth to David my father and with his hands fulfilled it, saying,

**2 Chronicles 6:5**

From the day when I brought my people out of the land of Egypt, I did not choose city from all the tribes of Israel to build a house for to be there, and I did not choose man to be ruler over my people Israel,

**2 Chronicles 6:6**

but I chose Jerusalem for my name to be there, and I chose David to be over my people Israel.

**2 Chronicles 6:7**

And it came upon the heart of David my father to build a house to the name of the Lord God of Israel.

**2 Chronicles 6:8**

And the Lord said to David my father, Because it came upon your heart to build a house to my name, you did well that it came upon your heart.

**2 Chronicles 6:9**

Nevertheless, you shall not build a house, but your son who shall come out from your loins, he shall build a house to my name.

**2 Chronicles 6:10**

And the Lord raised up his word which he spoke, and I came to be in place of David my father and sat upon the throne of Israel, as the Lord spoke, and I built a house to the name of the Lord God of Israel.

**2 Chronicles 6:11**

And there I put ark, in which is the covenant of the Lord which he made with Israel.

**2 Chronicles 6:12**

And he stood before the altar of the Lord in presence of all the assembly of Israel and spread out his hands.

**2 Chronicles 6:13**

For Solomon made bronze platform and set it in the midst of court of sanctuary, its length five cubits and breadth five cubits and height three cubits, and he stood upon it and fell on his knees before all the assembly of Israel and spread out his hands toward heaven.

**2 Chronicles 6:14**

And he said, Lord God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven and on earth, keeping covenant and mercy for your servants walking before you with all their heart,

**2 Chronicles 6:15**

what you kept for your servant David my father, what you spoke to him saying, and you spoke with your mouth and fulfilled with your hands, as this day.

**2 Chronicles 6:16**

And now, Lord God of Israel, keep for your servant David my father what you spoke to him, saying, Man shall not fail for you from before me sitting on the throne of Israel, if only your sons keep their way to walk in my law as you walked before me.

**2 Chronicles 6:17**

And now, Lord God of Israel, let your word be made faithful, which you spoke to your servant David.

**2 Chronicles 6:18**

For will God truly dwell with men upon the earth? If heaven and heaven of heaven are not sufficient for you, then what is this house which I built?

**2 Chronicles 6:19**

And you shall look upon the prayer of your servant and upon my petition, O Lord God, to hear the petition and the prayer which your servant prays before you today,

**2 Chronicles 6:20**

that your eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon this place where you said your name would be called there, to hear the prayer which your servant prays toward this place.

**2 Chronicles 6:21**

And you shall hear petition of your servant and your people Israel, whatever they pray toward this place, and you shall hear from place of your dwelling, from heaven, and you shall hear and be merciful.

**2 Chronicles 6:22**

If man sins against his neighbor and takes oath upon him to swear him, and comes and swears before the altar in this house,

**2 Chronicles 6:23**

then you shall hear from heaven and do and judge your servants, repaying lawless one, to return his ways upon his head, and justifying righteous one, to give to him according to his righteousness.

**2 Chronicles 6:24**

And if your people Israel are crushed before enemy when they sin against you, and they turn and give thanks to your name and pray and entreat before you in this house,

**2 Chronicles 6:25**

then you shall hear from heaven and be merciful to the sins of your people Israel and return them to the land which you gave to them and to their fathers.

**2 Chronicles 6:26**

When heaven is shut and rain does not come because they sin against you, and they pray toward this place and praise your name and turn from their sins because you humbled them,

**2 Chronicles 6:27**

then you shall hear from heaven and be merciful to the sins of your servants and your people Israel, because you will show them good way in which they shall walk, and you will give rain upon your land which you gave to your people for inheritance.

**2 Chronicles 6:28**

If famine comes on the land, if death comes, if blight and jaundice come, locust and caterpillar, if enemy afflicts them before their cities, according to every plague and every pain,

**2 Chronicles 6:29**

then every prayer and every petition which happens to every man and to all your people Israel, if a man knows his own touch and his own weakness and spreads out his hands toward this house,

**2 Chronicles 6:30**

then you shall hear from heaven, from your ready dwelling, and be gracious and give to each man according to his ways, as you know his heart, because you alone know the heart of sons of men,

**2 Chronicles 6:31**

so that they may fear your ways all days which they live upon the face of land which you gave to our fathers.

**2 Chronicles 6:32**

And every foreigner who is not from your people Israel, and comes from far land because of your great name and your strong hand and your uplifted arm, and comes and prays toward this place,

**2 Chronicles 6:33**

then you shall hear from heaven, from your ready dwelling, and do according to all things whatever a foreigner calls upon you for, so that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you as your people Israel do, and know that your name is called upon this house which I built.

**2 Chronicles 6:34**

If your people go out to battle against their enemies on way where you send them, and they pray to you by way of this city which you chose and house which I built to your name,

**2 Chronicles 6:35**

then hear from heaven their petition and their prayer and do their justice.

**2 Chronicles 6:36**

Because they will sin against you, for there will not be man who will not sin, and you will strike them and hand them over before enemies, and those taking them captive shall take them captive to the land of enemies, far or near,

**2 Chronicles 6:37**

and they will turn heart in their land where they were taken, and indeed turn and entreat you in their captivity, saying, We sinned, we acted unjustly, we acted lawlessly,

**2 Chronicles 6:38**

and turn toward you with all their heart and all their soul in the land of those who took them captive, and pray by way of their land which you gave to their fathers and city which you chose and house which I built to your name,

**2 Chronicles 6:39**

then hear from heaven, from your ready dwelling, their prayer and their petition and do judgments and be merciful to your people who sinned against you.

**2 Chronicles 6:40**

Now, Lord, let your eyes be open and your ears attentive to petition of this place.

**2 Chronicles 6:41**

And now rise up, Lord God, into your resting place, you and ark of your strength. Let your priests, Lord God, put on salvation, and let your sons rejoice in good things.

**2 Chronicles 6:42**

Lord God, do not turn away face of your anointed one; remember mercies of David your servant.

#### Chapter 7

**2 Chronicles 7:1**

And when Solomon finished praying, fire came down from heaven and consumed whole burnt offerings and sacrifices, and the glory of the Lord filled the house.

**2 Chronicles 7:2**

And priests were not able to enter the house of the Lord at that time, because the glory of the Lord filled the house.

**2 Chronicles 7:3**

And all sons of Israel saw fire coming down and the glory of the Lord upon the house, and they fell upon face to ground on pavement and worshiped and praised the Lord, because he is good, because his mercy is forever.

**2 Chronicles 7:4**

And the king and all the people were sacrificing sacrifices before the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 7:5**

And Solomon sacrificed sacrifice of twenty-two thousand calves and one hundred twenty thousand cattle, and the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.

**2 Chronicles 7:6**

And priests stood at their charges, and Levites with the instruments of songs of the Lord, of David king, for giving thanks before the Lord, because his mercy is forever, with hymns of David by their hand, and priests were blowing trumpets before them, and all Israel stood.

**2 Chronicles 7:7**

And Solomon sanctified middle of court in the house of the Lord, because there he made whole burnt offerings and fat of offerings of salvation, because bronze altar which Solomon made was not able to receive whole burnt offerings and grain offerings and fats.

**2 Chronicles 7:8**

And Solomon made feast at that time seven days, and all Israel with him, very great assembly, from the entrance of Hamath and as far as river of Egypt.

**2 Chronicles 7:9**

And on the eighth day he made dismissal, because dedication of altar he made seven days, feast.

**2 Chronicles 7:10**

And on twenty-third of seventh month he sent people to their tents rejoicing and with good heart over good things which the Lord did to David and to Solomon and to Israel his people.

**2 Chronicles 7:11**

And Solomon finished house of the Lord and the house of the king, and all things which Solomon desired in his soul to do in the house of the Lord and in his house prospered.

**2 Chronicles 7:12**

And God appeared to Solomon by night and said to him, I heard your prayer and chose in this place for myself as a house of sacrifice.

**2 Chronicles 7:13**

If I shut heaven and rain does not come, and if I command locust to eat tree, and if I send death among my people,

**2 Chronicles 7:14**

and my people upon whom my name has been called are put to shame, and they pray and seek my face and turn from their evil ways, then I will hear from heaven and be merciful to their sins and heal their land.

**2 Chronicles 7:15**

Now my eyes shall be open and my ears attentive to the prayer of this place.

**2 Chronicles 7:16**

And now I have chosen and sanctified this house for my name to be there forever, and my eyes and my heart shall be there all days.

**2 Chronicles 7:17**

And you, if you walk before me as David your father and do according to all things I commanded you and keep my ordinances and my judgments,

**2 Chronicles 7:18**

then I will set up throne of your kingdom as I covenanted with David your father, saying, Man leading in Israel shall not be removed from you.

**2 Chronicles 7:19**

And if you turn away and forsake my ordinances and my commandments which I gave before you and go and serve other gods and worship them,

**2 Chronicles 7:20**

then I will lift you out of land which I gave them, and this house which I sanctified to my name I will cast away from my face and give it for parable and tale among all nations.

**2 Chronicles 7:21**

And this exalted house, everyone passing by it will be astonished and say, For what reason did the Lord do thus to this land and to this house?

**2 Chronicles 7:22**

And they shall say, Because they forsook the Lord God of their fathers, who brought them out from the land of Egypt, and laid hold of other gods and worshiped them and served them, therefore he brought upon them all this evil.

#### Chapter 8

**2 Chronicles 8:1**

And it came to pass after twenty years in which Solomon built the house of the Lord and his own house,

**2 Chronicles 8:2**

and cities which Hiram gave to Solomon, Solomon built them and settled sons of Israel there.

**2 Chronicles 8:3**

And Solomon came to Hamath-Zobah and prevailed over it.

**2 Chronicles 8:4**

And he built Tadmor in the wilderness and all strong cities which he built in Hamath.

**2 Chronicles 8:5**

And he built Bethhoron the upper and Bethhoron the lower, fortified cities, walls, gates, and bars,

**2 Chronicles 8:6**

and Baalath and all strong cities which belonged to Solomon and all cities of chariots and cities of horsemen and whatever Solomon desired according to desire to build in Jerusalem and in Lebanon and in all his kingdom.

**2 Chronicles 8:7**

All the people left over from Hittite and Amorite and Perizzite and Hivite and Jebusite, who were not from Israel,

**2 Chronicles 8:8**

from their sons left after them in the land whom sons of Israel did not destroy, Solomon brought them up as tribute until this day.

**2 Chronicles 8:9**

But from the sons of Israel Solomon did not make servants for his kingdom, because they were men of war and rulers and mighty men and rulers of chariots and horsemen.

**2 Chronicles 8:10**

And these were chiefs of officers of King Solomon, two hundred fifty overseeing work among people.

**2 Chronicles 8:11**

And Solomon brought daughter of Pharaoh up from the City of David into the house which he built for her, because he said, My wife shall not dwell in the City of David king of Israel, because holy is the place where the ark of the Lord entered.

**2 Chronicles 8:12**

Then Solomon brought up whole burnt offerings to the Lord on the altar which he built opposite temple.

**2 Chronicles 8:13**

And according to the matter of each day, for offering according to commandments of Moses, on Sabbaths and on new moons and on feasts three times of year, in the feast of unleavened bread and in the feast of weeks and in the feast of tents.

**2 Chronicles 8:14**

And he established according to the ordinance of David divisions of priests according to their services, and Levites in their charges to praise and minister before priests according to each day's matter on its day, and gatekeepers in their divisions for gate and gate, because thus were commandments of David man of God.

**2 Chronicles 8:15**

They did not pass by commands of the king concerning priests and Levites in every matter and concerning treasuries.

**2 Chronicles 8:16**

And all work was prepared from the day the house was founded until Solomon finished the house of the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 8:17**

Then Solomon went to Eziongeber and to Elath by sea in the land of Edom.

**2 Chronicles 8:18**

And Hiram sent by the hands of his servants ships and servants knowing sea, and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir and took from there four hundred fifty talents of gold and came to King Solomon.

#### Chapter 9

**2 Chronicles 9:1**

And the queen of Sheba heard the name of Solomon and came to test Solomon with riddles in Jerusalem, with very weighty force, and camels carrying spices and gold in abundance and precious stone, and she came to Solomon and spoke with him all things in her soul.

**2 Chronicles 9:2**

And Solomon declared to her all her matters, and no matter passed from Solomon which he did not declare to her.

**2 Chronicles 9:3**

And the queen of Sheba saw the wisdom of Solomon and the house which he built,

**2 Chronicles 9:4**

and foods of his tables and seating of his servants and standing of his ministers and their clothing and his cupbearers and their apparel and whole burnt offerings which he offered in the house of the Lord, and she was beside herself.

**2 Chronicles 9:5**

And she said to the king, True was word which I heard in my land concerning your matters and concerning your wisdom.

**2 Chronicles 9:6**

And I did not believe words until I came and my eyes saw, and behold, half multitude of your wisdom was not reported to me. You added beyond report which I heard.

**2 Chronicles 9:7**

Blessed are your men; blessed are these servants of yours standing before you continually and hearing your wisdom.

**2 Chronicles 9:8**

Blessed be the Lord your God, who delighted in you to set you on his throne as king for the Lord your God. Because the Lord your God loved Israel to establish him forever, he gave you over them as king to do judgment and righteousness.

**2 Chronicles 9:9**

And she gave to the king one hundred twenty talents of gold and spices in very great abundance and precious stone, and there were no spices like those which queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

**2 Chronicles 9:10**

And the servants of Solomon and servants of Hiram were bringing gold to Solomon from Ophir and pine woods and precious stone.

**2 Chronicles 9:11**

And the king made from pine woods stairways for the house of the Lord and for the house of the king and lyres and harps for singers, and such things were not seen before in the land of Judah.

**2 Chronicles 9:12**

And King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desires which she asked, besides all which she brought to King Solomon, and she returned to her land.

**2 Chronicles 9:13**

And weight of gold brought to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,

**2 Chronicles 9:14**

besides what subject men and traders brought, and all kings of Arabia and satraps of land brought gold and silver to King Solomon.

**2 Chronicles 9:15**

And King Solomon made two hundred beaten-gold shields; six hundred pure golds went upon one shield.

**2 Chronicles 9:16**

And three hundred beaten-gold bucklers; three hundred golds went up on each buckler, and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.

**2 Chronicles 9:17**

And the king made great ivory throne and overlaid it with refined gold.

**2 Chronicles 9:18**

And six steps to throne, fastened with gold, and armrests on this side and on that side on the seat of throne, and two lions standing beside armrests.

**2 Chronicles 9:19**

And twelve lions standing there on six steps, on this side and that side. Thus it had not been done in any kingdom.

**2 Chronicles 9:20**

And all vessels of King Solomon were of gold, and all vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon covered with gold; silver was not reckoned in the days of Solomon as anything.

**2 Chronicles 9:21**

Because ships went for the king to Tarshish with the servants of Hiram; once every three years ships came from Tarshish to the king full of gold and silver and ivory and monkeys.

**2 Chronicles 9:22**

And Solomon was magnified above all kings in wealth and wisdom.

**2 Chronicles 9:23**

And all kings of the earth were seeking the face of Solomon to hear his wisdom which God gave in his heart.

**2 Chronicles 9:24**

And they were bringing each his gifts, silver vessels and gold vessels and clothing, myrrh and spices, horses and mules, year by year.

**2 Chronicles 9:25**

And Solomon had four thousand mares for chariots and twelve thousand horsemen, and he put them in the cities of chariots and with the king in Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 9:26**

And he was ruling all kings from the river and as far as land of Philistines and as far as border of Egypt.

**2 Chronicles 9:27**

And the king made gold and silver in Jerusalem like stones, and cedars like sycamines in lowland in abundance.

**2 Chronicles 9:28**

And the export of horses from Egypt was for Solomon, and from all the land.

**2 Chronicles 9:29**

And the rest of matters of Solomon, first and last, behold, written in the words of Nathan prophet and in the words of Ahijah the Shilonite and in visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam son of Nebat.

**2 Chronicles 9:30**

And King Solomon reigned over all Israel forty years.

**2 Chronicles 9:31**

And Solomon slept, and they buried him in the city of David his father, and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.

#### Chapter 10

**2 Chronicles 10:1**

And Rehoboam came to Shechem, because all Israel came to Shechem to make him king.

**2 Chronicles 10:2**

And it came to pass when Jeroboam son of Nebat heard, while he himself was in Egypt, since he fled from before King Solomon, and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt, and Jeroboam returned from Egypt,

**2 Chronicles 10:3**

and they sent and called him, and Jeroboam and all the assembly of Israel came to Rehoboam, saying,

**2 Chronicles 10:4**

Your father made our yoke hard, and now lighten from hard service of your father and from his heavy yoke which he put upon us, and we will serve you.

**2 Chronicles 10:5**

And he said to them, Go for three days and come again to me. And people departed.

**2 Chronicles 10:6**

And King Rehoboam gathered elders who stood before Solomon his father while he lived, saying, How do you counsel to answer word to this people?

**2 Chronicles 10:7**

And they spoke to him, saying, If today you become for good to this people and are pleased and speak good words to them, then they will be your servants all days.

**2 Chronicles 10:8**

But he left counsel of elders who counseled him and took counsel with young men brought up with him, who stood before him.

**2 Chronicles 10:9**

And he said to them, What do you counsel, and what word shall I answer this people who spoke to me saying, Lighten from yoke which your father put upon us?

**2 Chronicles 10:10**

And young men brought up with him spoke to him thus: Thus you shall speak to people who spoke to you saying, Your father made our yoke heavy, and you, lighten from us. Thus you shall say: My little finger is thicker than loins of my father.

**2 Chronicles 10:11**

And now, my father disciplined you with heavy yoke, and I will add upon your yoke. My father disciplined you with whips, but I will discipline you with scorpions.

**2 Chronicles 10:12**

And Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on third day, as king spoke saying, Return to me on third day.

**2 Chronicles 10:13**

And the king answered harshly, and King Rehoboam left counsel of elders.

**2 Chronicles 10:14**

And he spoke to them according to the counsel of younger men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, and I will add upon it. My father disciplined you with whips, but I will discipline you with scorpions.

**2 Chronicles 10:15**

And the king did not listen to people, because turn came from God, so that the Lord might raise up his word which he spoke by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite concerning Jeroboam son of Nebat.

**2 Chronicles 10:16**

And all Israel saw that the king did not listen to them, and people answered the king saying, What share do we have in David and inheritance in son of Jesse? To your tents, Israel. Now see your house, David. And all Israel went to his tents.

**2 Chronicles 10:17**

But over the men of Israel dwelling in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

**2 Chronicles 10:18**

And King Rehoboam sent Hadoram over tribute, and sons of Israel stoned him with stones, and he died. And King Rehoboam hurried to go up into chariot to flee to Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 10:19**

And Israel broke covenant with the house of David until this day.

#### Chapter 11

**2 Chronicles 11:1**

And Rehoboam came to Jerusalem and assembled Judah and Benjamin, one hundred eighty thousand young men making war, and he fought against Israel to return kingdom to Rehoboam.

**2 Chronicles 11:2**

And the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah man of God, saying,

**2 Chronicles 11:3**

Speak to Rehoboam son of Solomon and to all Judah and Benjamin, saying,

**2 Chronicles 11:4**

Thus says the Lord: You shall not go up and shall not fight against your brothers. Return each to his house, because this thing came from me. And they listened to the word of the Lord and turned back from not going against Jeroboam.

**2 Chronicles 11:5**

And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem and built fortified cities in Judah.

**2 Chronicles 11:6**

And he built Bethlehem and Etam and Tekoa,

**2 Chronicles 11:7**

and Bethzur and Socoh and Adullam,

**2 Chronicles 11:8**

and Gath and Mareshah and Ziph,

**2 Chronicles 11:9**

and Adoraim and Lachish and Azekah,

**2 Chronicles 11:10**

and Zorah and Aijalon and Hebron, which are of Judah and Benjamin, fortified cities.

**2 Chronicles 11:11**

And he fortified them with walls and gave leaders in them and stores of foods, oil, and wine,

**2 Chronicles 11:12**

city by city, shields and spears, and strengthened them very greatly, and Judah and Benjamin were his.

**2 Chronicles 11:13**

And priests and Levites who were in all Israel gathered to him from all borders,

**2 Chronicles 11:14**

because Levites left tents of their possession and went to Judah, to Jerusalem, because Jeroboam and his sons cast them out from ministering to the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 11:15**

And he appointed for himself priests of high places and for idols and vanities and calves which Jeroboam made.

**2 Chronicles 11:16**

And he cast out from tribes of Israel those who gave their hearts to seek the Lord God of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem to sacrifice to the Lord God of their fathers.

**2 Chronicles 11:17**

And they strengthened kingdom of Judah and strengthened Rehoboam son of Solomon for three years, because he walked in the ways of David and Solomon three years.

**2 Chronicles 11:18**

And Rehoboam took for himself Mahalath daughter of Jerimoth son of David, Abijah daughter of Eliab son of Jesse.

**2 Chronicles 11:19**

And she bore him sons, Jeush and Shamariah and Zaham.

**2 Chronicles 11:20**

And after these things he took for himself Maachah daughter of Absalom, and she bore him Abijah and Attai and Ziza and Shelomith.

**2 Chronicles 11:21**

And Rehoboam loved Maachah daughter of Absalom above all his wives and concubines, because he had eighteen wives and thirty concubines, and he fathered twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.

**2 Chronicles 11:22**

And Rehoboam appointed Abijah son of Maachah as a ruler, as a leader among his brothers, because he intended to make him king.

**2 Chronicles 11:23**

And he increased above all his sons in all borders of Judah and Benjamin and in fortified cities, and he gave them food in great abundance and sought multitude of wives.

#### Chapter 12

**2 Chronicles 12:1**

And it came to pass, when kingdom of Rehoboam was prepared and as he grew strong, he forsook commandments of the Lord, and all Israel with him.

**2 Chronicles 12:2**

And it came to pass in the fifth year of the reign of Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they sinned against the Lord,

**2 Chronicles 12:3**

with one thousand two hundred chariots and sixty thousand horsemen, and there was no number for multitude coming with him from Egypt: Libyans, Trogodytes, and Ethiopians.

**2 Chronicles 12:4**

And they seized fortified cities that were in Judah and came to Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 12:5**

And Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam and rulers of Judah, those gathered into Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said to them, Thus says the Lord: You forsake me, and I also will forsake you into the hand of Shishak.

**2 Chronicles 12:6**

And the rulers of Israel and the king were put to shame and said, the Lord is righteous.

**2 Chronicles 12:7**

And when the Lord saw that they were put to shame, the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah saying, They were put to shame; I will not destroy them, and I will give them a little salvation, and my wrath shall not drip upon Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 12:8**

For they shall be servants, and they shall know my service and service of kingdom of earth.

**2 Chronicles 12:9**

And Shishak king of Egypt came up and took treasures in the house of the Lord and treasures in the house of the king. He took all, and he took golden shields which Solomon made.

**2 Chronicles 12:10**

And Rehoboam made bronze shields instead of them and set over them Shishak chiefs of runners guarding gate of the king.

**2 Chronicles 12:11**

And whenever king entered the house of the Lord, guards and runners entered and then returned to chamber of runners.

**2 Chronicles 12:12**

And when he was put to shame, the wrath of the Lord turned away from him and not for destruction to end, and indeed in Judah there were good matters.

**2 Chronicles 12:13**

And Rehoboam was strengthened in Jerusalem and reigned. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, in the city which the Lord chose from all the tribes of the sons of Israel to have his name called there, and his mother's name was Naamah the Ammonite.

**2 Chronicles 12:14**

And he did evil, because he did not direct his heart to seek the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 12:15**

And matters of Rehoboam, first and last, behold, are they not written in the words of Shemaiah the prophet and Iddo the seer and his acts? And Rehoboam fought Jeroboam all his days.

**2 Chronicles 12:16**

And Rehoboam died and was buried with his fathers and was buried in the City of David, and Abijah his son reigned in his place.

#### Chapter 13

**2 Chronicles 13:1**

In the eighteenth year of the reign of Jeroboam, Abijah reigned over Judah.

**2 Chronicles 13:2**

He reigned three years in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Maachah daughter of Uriel from Gibeon. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

**2 Chronicles 13:3**

And Abijah drew up battle with a force of mighty warriors, four hundred thousand mighty men, and Jeroboam drew up battle against him with eight hundred thousand mighty warriors.

**2 Chronicles 13:4**

And Abijah stood up from mount Zemaraim, which is in the mountain of Ephraim, and said, Hear, Jeroboam and all Israel.

**2 Chronicles 13:5**

Is it not for you to know that the Lord God of Israel gave kingdom over Israel forever to David and to his sons, covenant of salt?

**2 Chronicles 13:6**

And Jeroboam son of Nebat, servant of Solomon son of David, rose up and rebelled from his lord.

**2 Chronicles 13:7**

And pestilent men, lawless sons, gathered to him and stood against Rehoboam son of Solomon, and Rehoboam was younger and timid in heart and did not stand against him.

**2 Chronicles 13:8**

And now you say you will stand against the kingdom of the Lord by the hand of sons of David, and you are many people, and with you are golden calves which Jeroboam made for you as gods.

**2 Chronicles 13:9**

Did you not cast out priests of the Lord, sons of Aaron, and Levites, and make for yourselves priests from the people of the land? Everyone coming to fill hands with young bull from cattle and seven rams became priest to what was not god.

**2 Chronicles 13:10**

But we have not forsaken the Lord our God, and his priests minister to the Lord, sons of Aaron, and Levites in their courses.

**2 Chronicles 13:11**

They burn to the Lord whole burnt offerings morning and evening and incense of compounded spices and presentations of bread upon pure table, and golden lampstand and its lamps for burning to light at evening, because we keep charges of the Lord God of our fathers, but you forsake him.

**2 Chronicles 13:12**

And behold, with us at beginning is the Lord, and his priests and trumpets of signal to sound against you. Sons of Israel, do not fight against the Lord God of our fathers, because it will not prosper for you.

**2 Chronicles 13:13**

And Jeroboam turned ambush to come upon them from behind, and battle was before Judah and ambush behind them.

**2 Chronicles 13:14**

And Judah turned and behold, battle was before and behind them, and they cried out to the Lord, and priests sounded trumpets.

**2 Chronicles 13:15**

And the men of Judah shouted, and it came to pass when men of Judah shouted, the Lord struck Jeroboam and Israel before Abijah and Judah.

**2 Chronicles 13:16**

And sons of Israel fled from before Judah, and the Lord gave them into their hands.

**2 Chronicles 13:17**

And Abijah and his people struck among them great blow, and five hundred thousand mighty men fell wounded from Israel.

**2 Chronicles 13:18**

And sons of Israel were humbled in that day, and sons of Judah prevailed, because they hoped in the Lord God of their fathers.

**2 Chronicles 13:19**

And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam and seized from him cities: Bethel and its villages, and Isana and its villages, and Ephraim and its villages.

**2 Chronicles 13:20**

And Jeroboam had no more strength all days of Abijah, and the Lord struck him and he died.

**2 Chronicles 13:21**

And Abijah grew strong and took for himself fourteen wives and fathered twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.

**2 Chronicles 13:22**

And the rest of matters of Abijah and his deeds and his words are written in the book of prophet Iddo.

**2 Chronicles 13:23**

And Abijah died with his fathers, and they buried him in the City of David, and Asa his son reigned in his place. In the days of Asa, land of Judah was quiet ten years.

#### Chapter 14

**2 Chronicles 14:1**

And he did good and upright in the sight of the Lord his God.

**2 Chronicles 14:2**

And he removed altars of foreigners and high places and broke pillars and cut down groves.

**2 Chronicles 14:3**

And he told Judah to seek the Lord God of their fathers and to do law and commandments.

**2 Chronicles 14:4**

And he removed from all the cities of Judah altars and idols, and land was at peace.

**2 Chronicles 14:5**

He built fortified cities in the land of Judah, because land was at peace, and there was no war with him in these years, because the Lord gave him rest.

**2 Chronicles 14:6**

And he said to Judah, Let us build these cities and make walls and towers and gates and bars, while we master land, because as we sought the Lord our God, he sought us and gave us rest all around, and he prospered us.

**2 Chronicles 14:7**

And Asa had force of shield-bearers and spear-carriers in the land of Judah, three hundred thousand, and in the land of Benjamin, peltasts and archers, two hundred fifty thousand. All these were mighty men of force.

**2 Chronicles 14:8**

And Zerah the Aithiopian came out against them with force of one million and three hundred chariots and came as far as Mareshah.

**2 Chronicles 14:9**

And Asa went out to meet him and drew up battle in ravine north of Mareshah.

**2 Chronicles 14:10**

And Asa cried to the Lord his God and said, Lord, with you it is not impossible to save with many and with few. Strengthen us, Lord our God, because in you we trust, and in your name we came against this great multitude. Lord our God, let not man prevail against you.

**2 Chronicles 14:11**

And the Lord struck Ethiopians before Judah, and Ethiopians fled.

**2 Chronicles 14:12**

And Asa and his people pursued them as far as Gerar, and Ethiopians fell so that there was no preservation in them, because they were crushed before the Lord and before his force, and they plundered many spoils.

**2 Chronicles 14:13**

And they cut off their villages around Gerar, because terror of the Lord came upon them, and they plundered all their cities, because there became much spoil for them.

**2 Chronicles 14:14**

And indeed they cut off tents of livestock of Amazons and took many sheep and camels and returned to Jerusalem.

#### Chapter 15

**2 Chronicles 15:1**

And Azariah son of Oded, spirit of the Lord came upon him.

**2 Chronicles 15:2**

And he went out to meet Asa and all Judah and Benjamin and said, Hear me, Asa and all Judah and Benjamin: The Lord is with you while you are with him, and if you seek him, he will be found by you, and if you forsake him, he will forsake you.

**2 Chronicles 15:3**

And many days Israel was without true God and without priest showing way and without law.

**2 Chronicles 15:4**

And he will return upon the Lord God of Israel, and he will be found by them.

**2 Chronicles 15:5**

And in that time there is no peace to one going out and to one coming in, because terror of the Lord is upon all dwelling in lands.

**2 Chronicles 15:6**

And nation will fight against nation and city against city, because God troubled them with every affliction.

**2 Chronicles 15:7**

And you, be strong, and do not let your hands be weakened, because there is reward for your work.

**2 Chronicles 15:8**

And when he heard these words and prophecy of Hadad the prophet, he was strengthened and cast out abominations from all the land of Judah and Benjamin and from cities which he seized in the mountain of Ephraim and renewed altar of the Lord which was before the temple of the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 15:9**

And he assembled Judah and Benjamin and sojourners dwelling with him from Ephraim and from Manasseh and from Simeon, because many from Israel joined themselves to him when they saw that the Lord his God was with him.

**2 Chronicles 15:10**

And they were gathered into Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the kingdom of Asa.

**2 Chronicles 15:11**

And they sacrificed to the Lord in that day from spoils they brought, seven hundred calves and seven thousand sheep.

**2 Chronicles 15:12**

And he entered into covenant to seek the Lord God of their fathers with all heart and with all soul.

**2 Chronicles 15:13**

And everyone who would not seek the Lord God of Israel shall die, from younger to elder, from man to woman.

**2 Chronicles 15:14**

And they swore in the Lord with loud voice and with trumpets and with horns.

**2 Chronicles 15:15**

And all Judah rejoiced over oath, because with all their soul they swore and with all their desire sought him, and he was found by them, and the Lord gave them rest all around.

**2 Chronicles 15:16**

And he removed Maachah his mother from not being one serving Ashtaroth, and he cut down idol and burned it in torrent of Kidron.

**2 Chronicles 15:17**

But high places were not removed; there was still in Israel. Yet heart of Asa became full all his days.

**2 Chronicles 15:18**

And he brought in the holy things of David his father and holy things of the house of the Lord God, silver and gold and vessels.

**2 Chronicles 15:19**

And there was no war with him until the thirty-fifth year of the kingdom of Asa.

#### Chapter 16

**2 Chronicles 16:1**

And in the thirty-eighth year of the kingdom of Asa, Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah and built Ramah so as not to give exit and entry to Asa king of Judah.

**2 Chronicles 16:2**
