And Asa took gold and silver from treasures of the house of the Lord and the house of the king and sent to Ben-hadad king of Syria dwelling in Damascus, saying,

**2 Chronicles 16:3**

Make covenant between me and you and between my father and your father. Behold, I sent you gold and silver. Come, scatter away from me Baasha king of Israel, and let him depart from me.

**2 Chronicles 16:4**

And Ben-hadad listened to King Asa and sent chiefs of his force against the cities of Israel, and he struck Ijon and Dan and Abelmaim and all surrounding places of Naphtali.

**2 Chronicles 16:5**

And it came to pass when Baasha heard, he left off building Ramah and stopped his work.

**2 Chronicles 16:6**

And Asa the king took all Judah and took stones of Ramah and its timbers, with which Baasha had built, and built with them Geba and Mizpeh.

**2 Chronicles 16:7**

And at that time Anani the prophet came to Asa king of Judah and said to him, Because you trusted in king of Syria and did not trust in the Lord your God, because of this force of Syria escaped from your hand.

**2 Chronicles 16:8**

Were not Ethiopians and Libyans for very great force, for courage, horsemen in great multitude? Yet when you trusted in the Lord, he gave them into your hands.

**2 Chronicles 16:9**

Because eyes of the Lord look through all the earth to strengthen every heart full toward him. You acted foolishly in this; from now on wars shall be with you.

**2 Chronicles 16:10**

And Asa was angry with prophet and put him in prison, because he was enraged over this, and Asa brought harm among people at that time.

**2 Chronicles 16:11**

And behold, matters of Asa, first and last, are written in the book of kings of Judah and Israel.

**2 Chronicles 16:12**

And Asa became diseased in his feet in the thirty-ninth year of his kingdom, until he was very diseased, and in his disease he did not seek the Lord but physicians.

**2 Chronicles 16:13**

And Asa slept with his fathers and died in the thirty-ninth year of his kingdom.

**2 Chronicles 16:14**

And they buried him in tomb which he dug for himself in the City of David and laid him on bier, and they filled it with spices and kinds of perfumed ointments, and they made for him very great funeral.

#### Chapter 17

**2 Chronicles 17:1**

And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place, and Jehoshaphat prevailed over Israel.

**2 Chronicles 17:2**

And he put force in all fortified cities of Judah and set rulers in all cities of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim which Asa his father seized.

**2 Chronicles 17:3**

And the Lord was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in first ways of his father and did not seek idols,

**2 Chronicles 17:4**

but sought the Lord God of his father and walked in the commandments of his father and not according to the works of Israel.

**2 Chronicles 17:5**

And the Lord directed kingdom in his hand, and all Judah gave gifts to Jehoshaphat, and he had much wealth and glory.

**2 Chronicles 17:6**

And his heart was lifted high in the way of the Lord, and he further removed high places and groves from the land of Judah.

**2 Chronicles 17:7**

And in the third year of his kingdom he sent his rulers and sons of mighty men, Abdian and Zechariah and Nathanael and Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah,

**2 Chronicles 17:8**

and with them Levites Samouias and Nethaniah and Zebadiah and Jaasiel and Shemiramoth and Jonathan and Adonijah and Tobijah, the Levites, and with them Elishama and Jehoram, the priests.

**2 Chronicles 17:9**

And they were teaching in Judah, and with them was the book of the law of the Lord, and they went through the cities of Judah and taught the people.

**2 Chronicles 17:10**

And terror of the Lord came upon all kingdoms of the earth around Judah, and they did not war against Jehoshaphat.

**2 Chronicles 17:11**

And from Philistines they were bringing to Jehoshaphat gifts and silver and tribute, and Arabs brought him seven thousand seven hundred rams of sheep.

**2 Chronicles 17:12**

And Jehoshaphat was becoming greater and greater on high, and he built dwellings in Judah and fortified cities.

**2 Chronicles 17:13**

And many works came to him in Judah, and mighty men of war were strong in Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 17:14**

And this was their number according to the houses of their fathers: for Judah, commanders of thousands: Adnah the chief, and with him three hundred thousand mighty men of force;

**2 Chronicles 17:15**

and with him Jehohanan the leader, and with him two hundred eighty thousand;

**2 Chronicles 17:16**

and with him Amaziah son of Zichri, one willingly given to the Lord, and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of force;

**2 Chronicles 17:17**

and from Benjamin, mighty man of force Eliada, and with him archers and peltasts, two hundred thousand;

**2 Chronicles 17:18**

and with him Jehozabad, and with him one hundred eighty thousand mighty for war.

**2 Chronicles 17:19**

These were those ministering to the king, besides those whom king placed in fortified cities in all Judah.

#### Chapter 18

**2 Chronicles 18:1**

And Jehoshaphat had still much wealth and glory, and he joined by marriage with the house of Ahab.

**2 Chronicles 18:2**

And after the end of years he went down to Ahab in Samaria, and Ahab sacrificed to him many sheep and calves and to people with him, and deceived him to go up with him to Ramoth of Gilead.

**2 Chronicles 18:3**

And Ahab king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, Will you go with me to Ramoth of Gilead? And he said to him, As I am, so are you; as your people, so my people, with you in battle.

**2 Chronicles 18:4**

And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, Seek now today Lord.

**2 Chronicles 18:5**

And the king of Israel gathered prophets, four hundred men, and said to them, Shall I go to Ramoth Gilead for battle, or shall I hold back? And they said, Go up, and God will give into the hands of the king.

**2 Chronicles 18:6**

And Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here still prophet of the Lord, and shall we seek through him?

**2 Chronicles 18:7**

And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, There is still one man through whom to seek the Lord, and I hated him, because he is not prophesying good concerning me, but all his days evil. This is Micaiah son of Imlah. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king speak thus.

**2 Chronicles 18:8**

And the king of Israel called one eunuch and said, Quickly, Micaiah son of Imlah.

**2 Chronicles 18:9**

And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah were sitting each on his throne, clothed in robes, sitting in the broad place of gate of Samaria, and all prophets were prophesying before them.

**2 Chronicles 18:10**

And Zedekiah son of Chenaanah made for himself iron horns and said, Thus says the Lord: With these you shall gore Syria until it is finished.

**2 Chronicles 18:11**

And all prophets were prophesying thus, saying, Go up to Ramoth Gilead and prosper, and the Lord will give into the hands of the king.

**2 Chronicles 18:12**

And messenger who went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, Behold, prophets spoke with one mouth good things about king. Let your words now be like one of them, and you shall speak good things.

**2 Chronicles 18:13**

And Micaiah said, As the Lord lives, whatever God says to me, this I will speak.

**2 Chronicles 18:14**

And he came to the king, and the king said to him, Micaiah, shall I go to Ramoth Gilead for battle, or shall I hold back? And he said, Go up, and you will prosper, and they shall be given into your hands.

**2 Chronicles 18:15**

And the king said to him, How many times shall I make you swear that you speak to me nothing except truth in the name of the Lord?

**2 Chronicles 18:16**

And he said, I saw Israel scattered on mountains like sheep which have no shepherd, and the Lord said, These have no ruler; let each return to his house in peace.

**2 Chronicles 18:17**

And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not say to you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?

**2 Chronicles 18:18**

And he said, Not so. Hear the word of the Lord: I saw the Lord sitting on his throne, and all force of heaven stood at his right and at his left.

**2 Chronicles 18:19**

And the Lord said, Who will deceive Ahab king of Israel, and he will go up and fall in Ramoth Gilead? And one said thus and another said thus.

**2 Chronicles 18:20**

And spirit came out and stood before the Lord and said, I will deceive him. And the Lord said, In what way?

**2 Chronicles 18:21**

And he said, I will go out and be lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, You shall deceive and you shall be able; go out and do so.

**2 Chronicles 18:22**

And now, behold, the Lord has put lying spirit in the mouth of all these prophets of yours, and the Lord spoke evil against you.

**2 Chronicles 18:23**

And Zedekiah son of Chenaanah came near and struck Micaiah on jaw and said to him, By what way did spirit of the Lord pass from me to speak to you?

**2 Chronicles 18:24**

And Micaiah said, Behold, you will see in that day when you enter chamber from chamber to hide yourself.

**2 Chronicles 18:25**

And the king of Israel said, Take Micaiah and return him to Amon ruler of the city and to Joash ruler, son of the king,

**2 Chronicles 18:26**

and say, Thus says king: Put this one into the house of prison, and let him eat bread of affliction and water of affliction until I return in peace.

**2 Chronicles 18:27**

And Micaiah said, If you indeed return in peace, the Lord did not speak in me. Hear, all peoples.

**2 Chronicles 18:28**

And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.

**2 Chronicles 18:29**

And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself and enter into battle, and you put on my clothing. And the king of Israel disguised himself and entered into battle.

**2 Chronicles 18:30**

And the king of Syria commanded chiefs of chariots with him, saying, Do not fight small and great, except the king of Israel only.

**2 Chronicles 18:31**

And it came to pass when the chiefs of chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, It is the king of Israel. And they surrounded him to fight, and Jehoshaphat cried out, and the Lord saved him, and God turned them away from him.

**2 Chronicles 18:32**

And it came to pass when the chiefs of chariots saw that he was not king of Israel, they turned away from him.

**2 Chronicles 18:33**

And a man bent bow by good aim and struck king of Israel between lung and between chest, and he said to driver, Turn your hand and bring me out of battle, because I am in pain.

**2 Chronicles 18:34**

And battle turned in that day, and the king of Israel was standing on chariot until evening against Syria, and he died at setting of sun.

#### Chapter 19

**2 Chronicles 19:1**

And Jehoshaphat king of Judah returned to his house in peace, to Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 19:2**

And Jehu son of Anani the prophet went out to meet him and said to him, King Jehoshaphat, do you help sinner, or make friendship with one hated by the Lord? Because of this wrath came upon you from the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 19:3**

Yet good matters were found in you, because you removed groves from the land of Judah and directed your heart to seek the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 19:4**

And Jehoshaphat dwelt in Jerusalem and again went out to people from Beersheba to the mountain of Ephraim and turned them back to the Lord God of their fathers.

**2 Chronicles 19:5**

And he appointed judges in all fortified cities of Judah, city by city.

**2 Chronicles 19:6**

And he said to judges, See what you do, because you do not judge for man, but for the Lord, and matters of judgment are with you.

**2 Chronicles 19:7**

And now let the fear of the Lord be upon you, and keep and do, because with the Lord our God there is no injustice, nor regard of face, nor taking of gifts.

**2 Chronicles 19:8**

And also in Jerusalem Jehoshaphat appointed from priests and Levites and patriarchs of Israel for the judgment of the Lord and to judge those dwelling in Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 19:9**

And he commanded them, saying, Thus you shall do in the fear of the Lord, in truth and with full heart.

**2 Chronicles 19:10**

Every case that comes upon you from your brothers dwelling in their cities, between blood and blood and between ordinance and commandment and statutes and judgments, you shall make distinction for them, and they shall not sin against the Lord, and wrath shall not be on you and on your brothers. Thus you shall do and you shall not sin.

**2 Chronicles 19:11**

And behold, Amariah the priest is leader over you for every matter of the Lord, and Zebadiah son of Ishmael is leader for the house of Judah for every matter of the king, and scribes and Levites are before you. Be strong and do, and the Lord shall be with good man.

#### Chapter 20

**2 Chronicles 20:1**

And after these things sons of Moab and sons of Ammon and with them from Meunites came against Jehoshaphat for battle.

**2 Chronicles 20:2**

And they came and reported to Jehoshaphat, saying, Great multitude has come against you from beyond sea, from Syria, and behold, they are in Asasanthamar, this is Engedi.

**2 Chronicles 20:3**

And he feared, and Jehoshaphat set his face to seek the Lord and proclaimed fast in all Judah.

**2 Chronicles 20:4**

And Judah gathered to seek the Lord, and from all the cities of Judah they came to seek the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 20:5**

And Jehoshaphat stood in the assembly of Judah in Jerusalem, in the house of the Lord, before new court,

**2 Chronicles 20:6**

and said, Lord God of our fathers, are you not God in heaven, and do you not rule over all kingdoms of nations? And in your hand are strength and power, and none can stand against you.

**2 Chronicles 20:7**

Are you not the Lord who destroyed inhabitants of this land from before your people Israel and gave it to the seed of Abraham your beloved forever?

**2 Chronicles 20:8**

And they dwelt in it and built in it sanctuary to your name, saying,

**2 Chronicles 20:9**

If evils come upon us, sword, judgment, death, famine, we shall stand before this house and before you, because your name is upon this house, and we shall cry to you from affliction, and you will hear and save.

**2 Chronicles 20:10**

And now, behold, sons of Ammon and Moab and mount Seir, through whom you did not allow Israel to pass when they came out from the land of Egypt, because they turned away from them and did not destroy them,

**2 Chronicles 20:11**

and now, behold, they attempt against us, to come cast us out from our inheritance which you gave us.

**2 Chronicles 20:12**

Lord our God, will you not judge among them? Because there is no strength in us to stand against this great multitude that came upon us, and we do not know what we should do, but our eyes are upon you.

**2 Chronicles 20:13**

And all Judah stood before the Lord, and their little children and wives.

**2 Chronicles 20:14**

And upon Uzziel son of Zechariah, from the sons of Benaiah, from the sons of Levite, from Mattaniah the Levite, from the sons of Asaph, spirit of the Lord came in assembly,

**2 Chronicles 20:15**

and he said, Hear, all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem and King Jehoshaphat. Thus says the Lord to you: Do not fear and do not be dismayed before this great multitude, because battle is not yours but God’s.

**2 Chronicles 20:16**

Tomorrow go down against them. Behold, they are going up by ascent of Ziz, and you will find them at the end of the river of the wilderness Jeruel.

**2 Chronicles 20:17**

It is not for you to fight in this. Stand and see salvation of the Lord with you, Judah and Jerusalem. Do not fear and do not be dismayed. Tomorrow go out to meet them, and the Lord is with you.

**2 Chronicles 20:18**

And Jehoshaphat bowed with his face to the ground, and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell before the Lord to worship the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 20:19**

And Levites from the sons of Kohath and from the sons of Kore rose to praise the Lord God of Israel with very great loud voice.

**2 Chronicles 20:20**

And they rose early in the morning and went out into the wilderness of Tekoa, and as they went out, Jehoshaphat stood and cried, saying, Hear me, Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem. Trust in the Lord your God and you shall be trusted; trust in his prophet and you shall prosper.

**2 Chronicles 20:21**

And he took counsel with people and set singers and praisers to give thanks and praise holy things as they went out before force, and they said, Give thanks to the Lord, because his mercy is forever.

**2 Chronicles 20:22**

And when he began praise of thanksgiving, the Lord made sons of Ammon fight against Moab and mount Seir, those coming out against Judah, and they were routed.

**2 Chronicles 20:23**

And sons of Ammon and Moab rose against the inhabitants of mount Seir to destroy and wipe out, and when they finished inhabitants of Seir, they rose against one another for destruction.

**2 Chronicles 20:24**

And Judah came to watchtower of the wilderness and looked, and saw multitude, and behold, all were dead, fallen on ground; there was none being saved.

**2 Chronicles 20:25**

And Jehoshaphat and his people came to plunder their spoils and found many cattle and baggage and spoils and desirable vessels, and they plundered for themselves, and it was three days they plundered spoils, because it was much.

**2 Chronicles 20:26**

And on fourth day they were gathered to the valley of blessing, because there they blessed the Lord. Therefore name of that place was called Valley of Blessing until this day.

**2 Chronicles 20:27**

And every man of Judah returned to Jerusalem, and Jehoshaphat leading them, with great gladness, because the Lord gladdened them from their enemies.

**2 Chronicles 20:28**

And they entered into Jerusalem with harps and lyres and trumpets to the house of the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 20:29**

And terror of the Lord came upon all kingdoms of the earth when they heard that the Lord fought against adversaries of Israel.

**2 Chronicles 20:30**

And kingdom of Jehoshaphat was at peace, and his God gave him rest all around.

**2 Chronicles 20:31**

And Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah, being thirty-five years old when he reigned, and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem, and his mother’s name was Azubah daughter of Shilhi.

**2 Chronicles 20:32**

And he walked in the ways of Asa his father and did not turn aside from doing upright in the sight of the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 20:33**

But high places still existed, and people still did not direct heart toward the Lord God of their fathers.

**2 Chronicles 20:34**

And the rest of matters of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, written in the words of Jehu son of Anani, who wrote book of kings of Israel.

**2 Chronicles 20:35**

And after these things Jehoshaphat king of Judah joined himself with Ahaziah king of Israel, and he acted lawlessly.

**2 Chronicles 20:36**

In making and going with him to make ships to go to Tarshish, he made ships in Eziongeber.

**2 Chronicles 20:37**

And Eliezer son of Dodavah from Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, Because you made friendship with Ahaziah, the Lord broke your work, and your ships were wrecked and were not able to go to Tarshish.

#### Chapter 21

**2 Chronicles 21:1**

And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers and was buried beside his fathers in the City of David, and Jehoram his son reigned in his place.

**2 Chronicles 21:2**

And he had brothers, sons of Jehoshaphat: Azariah and Jehiel and Zechariah and Azariah and Michael and Shephatiah; all these were sons of Jehoshaphat king of Judah.

**2 Chronicles 21:3**

And their father gave them many gifts, silver and gold and weapons, with fortified cities in Judah, but kingdom he gave to Jehoram, because he was firstborn.

**2 Chronicles 21:4**

And Jehoram rose over his kingdom and grew strong and killed all his brothers with sword, and also from rulers of Israel.

**2 Chronicles 21:5**

Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he became king, and eight years he reigned in Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 21:6**

And he walked in the way of kings of Israel, as the house of Ahab did, because daughter of Ahab was his wife, and he did evil before the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 21:7**

And the Lord did not want to destroy the house of David because of covenant which he made with David and as he said to give to him lamp and to his sons all days.

**2 Chronicles 21:8**

In those days Edom rebelled from Judah and made king over themselves.

**2 Chronicles 21:9**

And Jehoram went with rulers and all cavalry with him, and it came to pass, he rose by night and struck Edom encircling him and commanders of chariots, and people fled to their tents.

**2 Chronicles 21:10**

And Edom rebelled from Judah until this day. Then Libnah rebelled at that time from his hand, because he forsook the Lord God of his fathers.

**2 Chronicles 21:11**

And he too made high places in the cities of Judah and prostituted the inhabitants of Jerusalem and led Judah astray.

**2 Chronicles 21:12**

And writing came to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, Thus says the Lord God of David your father: Because you did not walk in the way of Jehoshaphat your father and in the ways of Asa king of Judah,

**2 Chronicles 21:13**

but walked in the ways of kings of Israel and prostituted Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem as the house of Ahab prostituted, and you killed your brothers, sons of your father, those better than you,

**2 Chronicles 21:14**

behold, the Lord will strike you with great plague among your people and among your sons and among your wives and among all your baggage.

**2 Chronicles 21:15**

And you with evil weakness, in disease of belly, until your belly comes out with sickness from day to day.

**2 Chronicles 21:16**

And the Lord stirred up against Jehoram Philistines and Arabs and neighbors of Ethiopians.

**2 Chronicles 21:17**

And they went up against Judah and overpowered and carried away all baggage they found in the house of the king and his sons and his daughters, and no son was left to him except Ahaziah, youngest of his sons.

**2 Chronicles 21:18**

And after all these things the Lord struck him in belly with weakness that had no healing.

**2 Chronicles 21:19**

And it came to pass from days to days, and as time of days came, two days, his belly came out with disease, and he died in evil weakness, and his people did not make funeral for him like the funeral of his fathers.

**2 Chronicles 21:20**

He was thirty-two years old when he reigned, and eight years he reigned in Jerusalem, and he went away without praise and was buried in the City of David, but not in the tombs of kings.

#### Chapter 22

**2 Chronicles 22:1**

And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his son, youngest, king in his place, because raiding band that came upon them, Arabs and Alimazones, killed all elders. And Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.

**2 Chronicles 22:2**

Ahaziah was twenty years old when he reigned, and one year he reigned in Jerusalem, and his mother’s name was Athaliah daughter of Omri.

**2 Chronicles 22:3**

And he walked in the way of the house of Ahab, because his mother was counselor to him in sinning.

**2 Chronicles 22:4**

And he did evil before the Lord like the house of Ahab, because they were counselors to him after the death of his father, to destroy him.

**2 Chronicles 22:5**

And in their counsels he walked and went with Joram son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramah Gilead, and archers struck Joram.

**2 Chronicles 22:6**

And Joram returned to be healed in Jezreel from wounds which Syrians gave him in Ramah when he fought Hazael king of Syria, and Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah came down to visit Joram son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.

**2 Chronicles 22:7**

And from God came destruction of Ahaziah by coming to Joram. And when he came, Joram went out with him toward Jehu son of Nimshi, anointed of the Lord, against the house of Ahab.

**2 Chronicles 22:8**

And it came to pass when Jehu avenged the house of Ahab and found rulers of Judah and brothers of Ahaziah ministering to Ahaziah, he killed them.

**2 Chronicles 22:9**

And he told them to seek Ahaziah, and they seized him while he was being healed in Samaria and brought him to Jehu, and he killed him and buried him, because they said, He is a son of Jehoshaphat who sought the Lord with all his heart. And there was none in the house of Ahaziah strong enough for the kingdom.

**2 Chronicles 22:10**

And Athaliah mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, and she rose and destroyed all royal seed in the house of Judah.

**2 Chronicles 22:11**

And Jehoshabeath daughter of the king took Joash son of Ahaziah and stole him from the midst of the king’s sons who were being put to death and put him and his nurse in chamber of beds. And Jehoshabeath daughter of King Jehoram, sister of Ahaziah, wife of Jehoiada the priest, hid him from before Athaliah, and she did not kill him.

**2 Chronicles 22:12**

And he was with her in the house of God, hidden six years, and Athaliah reigned over the land.

#### Chapter 23

**2 Chronicles 23:1**

And in seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself and took the centurions, Azariah son of Jeroham and Ishmael son of Jehohanan and Azariah son of Obed and Maaseiah son of Adaiah and Elzaphan son of Zechariah, with him into the house.

**2 Chronicles 23:2**

And they went around Judah and gathered Levites from all the cities of Judah and chiefs of fathers of Israel and came to Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 23:3**

And all the assembly of Judah made covenant in the house of God with the king, and he showed them son of the king and said to them, Behold, son of the king, let him reign, as the Lord spoke concerning the house of David.

**2 Chronicles 23:4**

Now this is thing which you shall do: one-third of you entering on Sabbath, of priests and Levites, shall be at the gates of entries,

**2 Chronicles 23:5**

and one-third in the house of the king, and one-third at middle gate, and all the people in the courts of the house of the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 23:6**

And no one shall enter house of the Lord except priests and Levites and ministers of Levites. They shall enter because they are holy, and all the people shall keep charges of the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 23:7**

And Levites shall surround king all around, each man with weapon in his hand, and one entering house shall die, and they shall be with the king when he enters and goes out.

**2 Chronicles 23:8**

And Levites and all Judah did according to all things which Jehoiada the priest commanded, and each took his men from the beginning of Sabbath to the end of Sabbath, because Jehoiada did not dismiss courses.

**2 Chronicles 23:9**

And he gave swords and shields and weapons which belonged to King David in the house of God.

**2 Chronicles 23:10**

And he set all the people, each with his weapons, from the right shoulder of the house to the left shoulder of the altar and the house, around the king.

**2 Chronicles 23:11**

And they brought out son of the king and put kingdom and testimonies upon him, and they made him king and anointed him, Jehoiada and his sons, and said, Let king live.

**2 Chronicles 23:12**

And Athaliah heard the sound of the people running and giving thanks and praising the king and entered to the king in the house of the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 23:13**

And she saw, and behold, the king stood at his station and at the entrance, rulers and trumpets around the king, and all the people of the land rejoiced, and they sounded with trumpets, and singers with the instruments of songs and hymning praise. And Athaliah tore her robe and cried, Conspiracy, conspire!

**2 Chronicles 23:14**

And Jehoiada the priest went out and commanded centurions and leaders of force and said to them, Throw her out beyond house, and whoever enters after her, let him die by sword, because priest said, Let her not die in the house of the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 23:15**

And they gave her free passage, and she went through the horse gate of the house of the king, and they killed her there.

**2 Chronicles 23:16**

And Jehoiada made covenant between himself and people and the king, that they should be people to the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 23:17**

And all the people of the land entered the house of Baal and pulled it down, and his altars and idols they crushed small, and Matthan priest of Baal they killed before his altars.

**2 Chronicles 23:18**

And Jehoiada the priest entrusted works of the house of the Lord by the hand of priests and Levites and restored courses of priests and Levites which David appointed over the house of the Lord, to offer whole burnt offerings to the Lord as written in the law of Moses, with gladness and with songs by the hand of David.

**2 Chronicles 23:19**

And they stationed gatekeepers at the gates of the house of the Lord, and no unclean person in any matter shall enter.

**2 Chronicles 23:20**

And he took patriarchs and mighty men and rulers of the people and all the people of the land, and brought up king to the house of the Lord, and entered by inner gate into the house of the king and seated king upon the throne of kingdom.

**2 Chronicles 23:21**

And all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet, and they killed Athaliah with sword.

#### Chapter 24

**2 Chronicles 24:1**

Joash was seven years old when he reigned, and forty years he reigned in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Shachia from Beersheba.

**2 Chronicles 24:2**

And Joash did upright in the sight of the Lord all days of Jehoiada the priest.

**2 Chronicles 24:3**

And Jehoiada took for him two wives, and he fathered sons and daughters.

**2 Chronicles 24:4**

And after these things it came upon the heart of Joash to repair the house of the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 24:5**

And he gathered priests and Levites and said to them, Go out into the cities of Judah and gather from all Israel silver to strengthen the house of the Lord year by year, and hurry to speak. And Levites did not hurry.

**2 Chronicles 24:6**

And King Joash called Jehoiada the chief and said to him, Why did you not see about Levites to bring from Judah and Jerusalem what was ordained by Moses man of God when he assembled Israel for the tent of testimony?

**2 Chronicles 24:7**

Because Athaliah was lawless, and her sons pulled down the house of God, and indeed holy things of the house of the Lord they made for Baals.

**2 Chronicles 24:8**

And the king said, Let a chest be made and placed at the gate of the house of the Lord outside.

**2 Chronicles 24:9**

And let them proclaim in Judah and in Jerusalem to bring to the Lord as Moses servant of God spoke upon Israel in the wilderness.

**2 Chronicles 24:10**

And all rulers and all the people gave and brought and put into chest until it was full.

**2 Chronicles 24:11**

And whenever chest was brought to the king’s officers by the hand of Levites, and when they saw silver had multiplied, then king’s scribe came and officer of high priest and emptied chest and restored it to its place. Thus they did day by day and gathered much silver.

**2 Chronicles 24:12**

And the king and Jehoiada the priest gave it to those doing works for the work of the house of the Lord, and they hired stonecutters and carpenters to repair the house of the Lord, and workers in iron and bronze to repair the house of the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 24:13**

And workers did work, and length of works went up in their hands, and they restored house of the Lord to its standing and strengthened it.

**2 Chronicles 24:14**

And when they finished, they brought remaining silver to the king and to Jehoiada, and they made vessels for the house of the Lord, ministering vessels for whole burnt offerings and censers of gold and silver, and they offered whole burnt offerings in the house of the Lord continually all days of Jehoiada.

**2 Chronicles 24:15**

And Jehoiada grew old, full of days, and died, being one hundred thirty years old at his death.

**2 Chronicles 24:16**

And they buried him in the City of David with kings, because he did goodness with Israel and with God and his house.

**2 Chronicles 24:17**

And after the death of Jehoiada, rulers of Judah came and bowed to the king; then king listened to them.

**2 Chronicles 24:18**

And they forsook the Lord God of their fathers and served Ashtaroth and idols, and wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem in this day.

**2 Chronicles 24:19**

And he sent prophets to them to return to the Lord, and they did not listen, and they testified to them and they did not listen.

**2 Chronicles 24:20**

And the Spirit of God clothed Azariah son of Jehoiada the priest, and he stood above the people and said, Thus says the Lord: Why do you transgress the commandments of the Lord and not prosper? Because you forsake the Lord, he will forsake you.

**2 Chronicles 24:21**

And they conspired against him and stoned him by the command of King Joash in the court of the house of the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 24:22**

And Joash did not remember mercy which Jehoiada his father did with him and killed his son. And as he was dying, he said, Let the Lord see and judge.

**2 Chronicles 24:23**

And it came to pass after completion of year, force of Syria came up against him and came upon Judah and Jerusalem and destroyed all rulers of the people among people, and all their spoils they sent to the king of Damascus.

**2 Chronicles 24:24**

Because with few men force of Syria came, and God gave into their hands very great force, because they forsook the Lord God of their fathers, and against Joash he made judgments.

**2 Chronicles 24:25**

And after they departed from him, leaving him in great weaknesses, his servants conspired against him over bloods of son of Jehoiada the priest and killed him on his bed, and he died. And they buried him in the City of David, but they did not bury him in tomb of kings.

**2 Chronicles 24:26**

And those conspiring against him were Zabad son of Shimeath the Ammonite and Jehozabad son of Shimrith the Moabite.

**2 Chronicles 24:27**

And all his sons and the five things brought upon him and the rest, behold, written on commentary of kings, and Amaziah his son reigned in his place.

#### Chapter 25

**2 Chronicles 25:1**

Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he reigned, and twenty-nine years he reigned in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Jehoaddan from Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 25:2**

And he did upright in the sight of the Lord, but not with full heart.

**2 Chronicles 25:3**

And it came to pass when kingdom was established in his hand, he killed his servants who killed king his father.

**2 Chronicles 25:4**

But their sons he did not kill, according to the covenant of the law of the Lord, as written, as the Lord commanded, saying, Fathers shall not die for children, and sons shall not die for fathers, but each shall die for his own sin.

**2 Chronicles 25:5**

And Amaziah gathered the house of Judah and set them by the houses of their fathers over thousands and hundreds in all Judah and Jerusalem, and counted them from twenty years old and upward and found them three hundred thousand able to go out to battle, holding spear and shield.

**2 Chronicles 25:6**

And he hired from Israel one hundred thousand mighty men of strength for one hundred talents of silver.

**2 Chronicles 25:7**

And man of God came to him, saying, King, force of Israel shall not go with you, because the Lord is not with Israel, with all sons of Ephraim.

**2 Chronicles 25:8**

Because if you suppose to prevail by these, the Lord will rout you before enemies, because with the Lord there is power both to strengthen and to route.

**2 Chronicles 25:9**

And Amaziah said to the man of God, And what shall I do with hundred talents which I gave to force of Israel? And man of God said, the Lord is able to give you many more than these.

**2 Chronicles 25:10**

And Amaziah separated force that came to him from Ephraim to go to their place, and they were very angry against Judah and returned to their place in the heat of anger.

**2 Chronicles 25:11**

And Amaziah strengthened himself and took his people and went to the valley of salt pits and struck there ten thousand sons of Seir.

**2 Chronicles 25:12**

And ten thousand sons of Judah took captive alive and brought them to the top of cliff and threw them down from the top of cliff, and all were broken apart.

**2 Chronicles 25:13**

And sons of force whom Amaziah sent back from not going with him to war attacked the cities of Judah from Samaria to Bethhoron and struck among them three thousand and plundered much spoil.

**2 Chronicles 25:14**

And it came to pass after Amaziah came from striking Edom, he brought to them gods of sons of Seir and set them up for himself as gods, and bowed before them and burned sacrifice to them.

**2 Chronicles 25:15**

And the anger of the Lord came upon Amaziah and he sent prophets to him and said to him, Why did you seek gods of the people who did not rescue their own people from your hand?

**2 Chronicles 25:16**

And it came to pass as he spoke to him, he said to him, Have I made you counselor of the king? Take heed lest you be whipped. And prophet was silent and said, I know that this was intended against you to destroy you, because you did this and did not listen to my counsel.

**2 Chronicles 25:17**

And Amaziah took counsel and sent to Joash son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu king of Israel, saying, Come, let us look one another in face.

**2 Chronicles 25:18**

And Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, Thornbush in Lebanon sent to cedar in Lebanon, saying, Give your daughter to my son for wife. And behold, beasts of the field in Lebanon came and trampled thornbush.

**2 Chronicles 25:19**

You said, Behold, you struck Edom, and your heavy heart lifts you up. Now sit in your house. Why provoke evil and fall, you and Judah with you?

**2 Chronicles 25:20**

And Amaziah did not listen, because it came from the Lord to hand him over, because he sought gods of Edomites.

**2 Chronicles 25:21**

And Joash king of Israel went up, and they looked one another in face, he and Amaziah king of Judah, at Beth-shemesh, which belongs to Judah.

**2 Chronicles 25:22**

And Judah was routed before Israel, and each fled to his tent.

**2 Chronicles 25:23**

And Joash king of Israel seized Amaziah king of Judah, son of Joash, at Beth-shemesh and brought him to Jerusalem and pulled down from the wall of Jerusalem, from the gate of Ephraim to corner gate, four hundred cubits.

**2 Chronicles 25:24**

And all gold and silver and all vessels found in the house of the Lord and with Obededom and treasures of the house of the king and sons of mixtures, and he returned to Samaria.

**2 Chronicles 25:25**

And Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.

**2 Chronicles 25:26**

And the rest of matters of Amaziah, first and last, behold, written upon the book of kings of Judah and Israel.

**2 Chronicles 25:27**

And at time when Amaziah rebelled from the Lord they conspired against him, and he fled from Jerusalem to Lachish, and they sent after him to Lachish and killed him there.

**2 Chronicles 25:28**

And they carried him upon horses and buried him with his fathers in the City of David.

#### Chapter 26

**2 Chronicles 26:1**

And all the people of the land took Uzziah, and he was sixteen years old, and they made him king in place of his father Amaziah.

**2 Chronicles 26:2**

He built Elath; he restored it to Judah after king slept with his fathers.

**2 Chronicles 26:3**

Uzziah was sixteen years old when he reigned, and fifty-two years he reigned in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Jecoliah from Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 26:4**

And he did upright in the sight of the Lord according to all things Amaziah his father did.

**2 Chronicles 26:5**

And he was seeking the Lord in the days of Zechariah, one understanding in the fear of the Lord, and in his days he sought the Lord and the Lord prospered him.

**2 Chronicles 26:6**

And he went out and fought against Philistines and pulled down walls of Gath and walls of Jabneh and walls of Ashdod and built cities of Ashdod and among Philistines.

**2 Chronicles 26:7**

And the Lord strengthened him against Philistines and against Arabs dwelling upon rock and against Meunites.

**2 Chronicles 26:8**

And Meunites gave gifts to Uzziah, and his name was until entrance of Egypt, because he grew strong exceedingly.

**2 Chronicles 26:9**

And Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem, at corner gate and at valley gate and at corners, and strengthened them.

**2 Chronicles 26:10**

And he built towers in the wilderness and cut many pits, because much cattle belonged to him in lowland and in the plain, and vine-workers in hill-country and in Carmel, because he loved farming.

**2 Chronicles 26:11**

**2 Chronicles 26:12**
