**2 Chronicles 26:13**

And with them military force was three hundred seven thousand five hundred, those doing war with the strength of power to help king against adversaries.

**2 Chronicles 26:14**

And Uzziah prepared for them, for all force, shields and spears and helmets and breastplates and bows and sling-stones.

**2 Chronicles 26:15**

And he made in Jerusalem machines, invented by designer, to be on towers and corners, to cast arrows and large stones, and the sound of their making was heard far away, because he was marvelously helped until he became strong.

**2 Chronicles 26:16**

And when he became strong, his heart was lifted up to ruin, and he acted unjustly against the Lord his God and entered into the temple of the Lord to burn incense on the altar of incense.

**2 Chronicles 26:17**

And Azariah the priest entered after him and with him eighty priests of the Lord, mighty sons.

**2 Chronicles 26:18**

And they stood against Uzziah the king and said to him, Not for you, Uzziah, to burn incense to the Lord, but for priests, sons of Aaron, those sanctified to burn incense. Go out from sanctuary, because you rebelled from the Lord, and this shall not be for glory to you from the Lord God.

**2 Chronicles 26:19**

And Uzziah was angry, and in his hand was censer to burn incense in the temple, and when he was angry with priests, leprosy rose in his forehead before priests in the house of the Lord above altar of incense.

**2 Chronicles 26:20**

And chief priest and priests turned to him, and behold, he was leprous in forehead, and they hurried him out from there, and indeed he himself hurried to go out because the Lord rebuked him.

**2 Chronicles 26:21**

And Uzziah the king was leprous until the day of his death, and as a leper he sat in a separate house, because he was cut off from the house of the Lord, and Jotham his son was over kingdom, judging people of the land.

**2 Chronicles 26:22**

And the rest of matters of Uzziah, first and last, were written by Isaiah the prophet.

**2 Chronicles 26:23**

And Uzziah slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the field of burial of kings, because they said he is leprous, and Jotham his son reigned in his place.

#### Chapter 27

**2 Chronicles 27:1**

Jotham was twenty-five years old when he reigned, and sixteen years he reigned in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Jerusha daughter of Zadok.

**2 Chronicles 27:2**

And he did upright in the sight of the Lord according to all things which Uzziah his father did, but he did not enter into the temple of the Lord, and still people were being corrupted.

**2 Chronicles 27:3**

He built high gate of the house of the Lord, and in the wall of Ophel he built much.

**2 Chronicles 27:4**

And he built cities in the mountain of Judah, and in forests dwellings and towers.

**2 Chronicles 27:5**

He fought against the king of sons of Ammon and prevailed over him, and sons of Ammon gave him year by year one hundred talents of silver and ten thousand kors of wheat and ten thousand of barley. These king of Ammon brought him in the first year and second and third.

**2 Chronicles 27:6**

And Jotham grew strong, because he prepared his ways before the Lord his God.

**2 Chronicles 27:7**

And the rest of matters of Jotham and war and deeds of him, behold, written in the book of kings of Judah and Israel.

**2 Chronicles 27:9**

And Jotham slept with his fathers and was buried in the City of David, and Ahaz his son reigned in his place.

#### Chapter 28

**2 Chronicles 28:1**

Ahaz was twenty years old when he reigned, and sixteen years he reigned in Jerusalem, and he did not do upright in the sight of the Lord like David his father.

**2 Chronicles 28:2**

And he walked according to the ways of kings of Israel, and indeed he made carved things for their idols.

**2 Chronicles 28:3**

And he sacrificed in Gaibennom and brought his children through fire according to the abominations of nations which the Lord destroyed from before the sons of Israel.

**2 Chronicles 28:4**

And he burned incense on high places and on roofs and under every grove tree.

**2 Chronicles 28:5**

And the Lord his God gave him into the hand of the king of Syria, and he struck him and took from them many captives and brought them to Damascus. And indeed into the hands of the king of Israel he gave him, and he struck him with great blow.

**2 Chronicles 28:6**

And Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel killed in Judah in one day one hundred twenty thousand mighty men of strength, because they forsook the Lord God of their fathers.

**2 Chronicles 28:7**

And Zichri, mighty man of Ephraim, killed Maaseiah son of the king and Azrikam ruler of his house and Elkanah successor of the king.

**2 Chronicles 28:8**

And sons of Israel took captive from their brothers three hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters, and they plundered much spoil from them and brought spoil to Samaria.

**2 Chronicles 28:9**

And there was a prophet of the Lord there, Oded his name, and he went out to meet force coming to Samaria and said to them, Behold, the wrath of the Lord God of your fathers came upon Judah and he gave them into your hands, and you killed among them in wrath reaching to heavens.

**2 Chronicles 28:10**

And now sons of Judah and Jerusalem you say to acquire as male and female servants. Behold, am I not with you to testify to the Lord your God?

**2 Chronicles 28:11**

And now hear me and return captivity which you took captive from your brothers, because wrath of heat of the Lord is upon you.

**2 Chronicles 28:12**

And rulers from the sons of Ephraim rose up: Oudia son of Johanan and Berechiah son of Meshillemoth and Ezechias son of Hillel and Amaziah son of Hadlai, against those coming from war.

**2 Chronicles 28:13**

And they said to them, You shall not bring captivity here to us, because you say to add upon our sins and upon our ignorance in sinning to the Lord, because our sin is great, and heat of the wrath of the Lord is upon Israel.

**2 Chronicles 28:14**

And warriors left captivity and spoils before rulers and all the assembly.

**2 Chronicles 28:15**

And men called by name rose and took hold of captivity, and all naked they clothed from spoils and dressed them and shod them and gave them to eat and to be anointed, and took hold of every weak one on the beasts of burden and set them in Jericho, the city of palms, by their brothers, and returned to Samaria.

**2 Chronicles 28:16**

At that time Ahaz sent to the king of Asshur to help him.

**2 Chronicles 28:17**

And also because Edomites attacked and struck in Judah and took captivity.

**2 Chronicles 28:18**

And Philistines attacked cities of the plain and of south of Judah and took Beth-shemesh and Elon and Gederoth and Shocho and its villages and Timnah and its villages and Gimzo and its villages, and they dwelt there.

**2 Chronicles 28:19**

Because the Lord humbled Judah through Ahaz king of Judah, because he rebelled in rebellion from the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 28:20**

And Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria came upon him and struck him.

**2 Chronicles 28:21**

And Ahaz took what was in the house of the Lord and in the house of the king and of rulers and gave to the king of Asshur, and it was not for help to him.

**2 Chronicles 28:22**

But when he was afflicted he added to rebel further from the Lord, and the king said,

**2 Chronicles 28:23**

I will seek gods of Damascus who strike me. And he said, Because gods of the king of Syria strengthened them, therefore I will sacrifice to them and they will help me. But they became to him as a stumbling-block and to all Israel.

**2 Chronicles 28:24**

And Ahaz removed vessels of the house of the Lord and cut them up and shut doors of the house of the Lord and made for himself altars in every corner in Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 28:25**

And in every city of Judah he made high places to burn incense to foreign gods, and they provoked the Lord God of their fathers.

**2 Chronicles 28:26**

And the rest of his matters and his deeds, first and last, behold, written upon the book of kings of Judah and Israel.

**2 Chronicles 28:27**

And Ahaz slept with his fathers and was buried in the City of David, because they did not bring him into tombs of kings of Israel, and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.

#### Chapter 29

**2 Chronicles 29:1**

And Hezekiah reigned, being twenty-five years old, and twenty-nine years he reigned in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Abijah daughter of Zechariah.

**2 Chronicles 29:2**

And he did upright in the sight of the Lord according to all things David his father did.

**2 Chronicles 29:3**

And it came to pass when he stood over his kingdom, in the first month, he opened doors of the house of the Lord and repaired them.

**2 Chronicles 29:4**

And he brought in priests and Levites and stationed them in east court.

**2 Chronicles 29:5**

And he said to them, Hear, Levites. Now sanctify yourselves and sanctify house of the Lord God of your fathers and throw out uncleanness from holy place.

**2 Chronicles 29:6**

Because our fathers rebelled and did evil before the Lord and forsook him and turned face away from the tent of the Lord and gave neck.

**2 Chronicles 29:7**

And they shut doors of the temple and quenched lamps and did not burn incense and did not offer whole burnt offerings in holy place to God of Israel.

**2 Chronicles 29:8**

And the wrath of the Lord was against Judah and Jerusalem, and he gave them to terror and to desolation and to hissing, as you see with your eyes.

**2 Chronicles 29:9**

And behold, your fathers have fallen by sword and your sons and daughters and wives are in captivity in a land not theirs, which even now is so.

**2 Chronicles 29:10**

Upon these things now it is in my heart to make covenant of the Lord God of Israel, and he will turn away heat of his wrath from us.

**2 Chronicles 29:11**

And now do not fail, because the Lord chose in you to stand before him to minister and to be ministers and burners of incense.

**2 Chronicles 29:12**

And Levites rose: Maath son of Amasai and Joel son of Azariah from the sons of Kohath, and from the sons of Merari, Kish son of Abdi and Azariah son of Igal, and from the sons of Gershonites, Igal son of Zemmath and Joadam son of Joah,

**2 Chronicles 29:13**

and from the sons of Elzaphan, Shimri and Jeiel, and from the sons of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah,

**2 Chronicles 29:14**

and from the sons of Heman, Jehiel and Shimei, and from the sons of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.

**2 Chronicles 29:15**

And they gathered their brothers and sanctified themselves according to the command of the king by ordinance of the Lord to cleanse house of the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 29:16**

And priests entered inside the house of the Lord to sanctify it and threw out every uncleanness found in the house of the Lord into the court of the house of the Lord, and Levites received it to throw outside into the torrent of Kidron.

**2 Chronicles 29:17**

And they began on the first day of new moon of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month they entered the temple of the Lord, and they sanctified house of the Lord in eight days, and on the sixteenth day of the first month they finished.

**2 Chronicles 29:18**

And they went inside to Hezekiah the king and said, We sanctified all things in the house of the Lord, altar of whole burnt offering and its vessels and table of presentation and its vessels.

**2 Chronicles 29:19**

And all vessels which King Ahaz defiled in his kingdom in his rebellion we prepared and sanctified. Behold, they are before the altar of the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 29:20**

And Hezekiah the king rose early and gathered rulers of the city and went up to the house of the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 29:21**

And they brought seven calves, seven rams, seven lambs, seven male goats of goats for sin, for the kingdom and for holy things and for Israel, and he told sons of Aaron the priests to go up upon the altar of the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 29:22**

And they slaughtered calves, and priests received blood and poured it upon the altar, and they slaughtered rams and poured blood upon the altar, and they slaughtered lambs and poured blood to the altar.

**2 Chronicles 29:23**

And they brought male goats for sin before the king and assembly, and they put hands upon them.

**2 Chronicles 29:24**

And priests slaughtered them and made atonement with their blood toward altar and made atonement for all Israel, because the king said whole burnt offering and sin offerings were for all Israel.

**2 Chronicles 29:25**

And he stationed Levites in the house of the Lord with cymbals and harps and lyres according to the command of David king and Gad the seer for the king and Nathan the prophet, because ordinance was from the Lord by the hand of prophets.

**2 Chronicles 29:26**

And Levites stood with the instruments of David, and priests with trumpets.

**2 Chronicles 29:27**

And Hezekiah said to offer whole burnt offering upon the altar, and when they began to offer whole burnt offering, they began to sing to the Lord, and trumpets with the instruments of David king of Israel.

**2 Chronicles 29:28**

And all the assembly worshiped, and singers were singing and trumpets sounding, until whole burnt offering was finished.

**2 Chronicles 29:29**

And as they finished offering, king bent knee and all those found with him and worshiped.

**2 Chronicles 29:30**

And Hezekiah the king and rulers told Levites to hymn the Lord in the words of David and Asaph the prophet, and they hymned with gladness and fell and worshiped.

**2 Chronicles 29:31**

And Hezekiah answered and said, Now you have filled your hands to the Lord; come near and bring sacrifices and praises into the house of the Lord. And assembly brought sacrifices and praises into the house of the Lord, and everyone willing in heart brought whole burnt offerings.

**2 Chronicles 29:32**

And number of whole burnt offerings which assembly brought was seventy calves, one hundred rams, two hundred lambs. All these for whole burnt offering to the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 29:33**

And holy things were six hundred calves and three thousand sheep.

**2 Chronicles 29:34**

But priests were few and were not able to flay whole burnt offerings, and their brothers Levites took hold with them until work was finished and until priests were sanctified, because Levites were more willing to sanctify than priests.

**2 Chronicles 29:35**

And whole burnt offering was much, with fats of completion of the offering of salvation and libations of whole burnt offering, and work in the house of the Lord was set right.

**2 Chronicles 29:36**

And Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced because God prepared for people, because word came suddenly.

#### Chapter 30

**2 Chronicles 30:1**

And Hezekiah sent over all Israel and Judah and wrote letters to Ephraim and Manasseh to come to the house of the Lord in Jerusalem to do passover to the Lord God of Israel.

**2 Chronicles 30:2**

And the king and rulers and all the assembly in Jerusalem took counsel to do passover in the second month.

**2 Chronicles 30:3**

For they were not able to do it at that time, because priests had not sanctified themselves enough and people had not been gathered into Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 30:4**

And word pleased king and assembly.

**2 Chronicles 30:5**

And they established word to make proclamation pass through all Israel from Beersheba to Dan, that they should come do passover to the Lord God of Israel in Jerusalem, because multitude did not do it according to writing.

**2 Chronicles 30:6**

And runners went with letters from the king and rulers through all Israel and Judah according to the command of the king, saying, Sons of Israel, return to God of Abraham and Isaac and Israel, and he will return remnant, those left from the hand of the king of Asshur.

**2 Chronicles 30:7**

And do not become like your fathers and your brothers who rebelled from the Lord God of their fathers, and he gave them to desolation, as you see.

**2 Chronicles 30:8**

And now do not harden your necks; give glory to the Lord God, and enter into his sanctuary which he sanctified forever, and serve the Lord your God, and he will turn away fury of wrath from you.

**2 Chronicles 30:9**

Because when you return to the Lord, your brothers and your children shall be in mercies before all who took them captive and he will return to this land, because the Lord our God is merciful and compassionate and will not turn away his face from us if we return to him.

**2 Chronicles 30:10**

And runners were passing from one city to another in hill-country of Ephraim and Manasseh and as far as Zebulun, and they became as a laughingstock and mockery to them.

**2 Chronicles 30:11**

But men from Asher and from Manasseh and from Zebulun were put to shame and came to Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 30:12**

And in Judah the hand of the Lord came to give them one heart, to come do according to the command of the king and rulers in the word of the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 30:13**

And much people gathered into Jerusalem to do feast of unleavened bread in the second month, very great assembly.

**2 Chronicles 30:14**

And they rose and took down altars in Jerusalem, and all things in which they burned incense to false gods they pulled down and threw into the torrent of Kidron.

**2 Chronicles 30:15**

And they sacrificed passover on the fourteenth of the second month, and priests and Levites were put to shame and sanctified themselves and brought whole burnt offerings into the house of the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 30:16**

And they stood at their station according to their ordinance, according to the command of Moses man of God, and priests received blood from the hand of Levites.

**2 Chronicles 30:17**

Because many of the assembly had not sanctified themselves, and Levites were to sacrifice passover for everyone not able to sanctify to the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 30:18**

Because most of the people from Ephraim and Manasseh and Issachar and Zebulun had not sanctified themselves, but they ate passover contrary to writing, and Hezekiah prayed for them, saying, May the good Lord make atonement concerning

**2 Chronicles 30:19**

every heart directing itself to seek the Lord God of their fathers and not according to the purity of holy things.

**2 Chronicles 30:20**

And the Lord listened to Hezekiah and healed people.

**2 Chronicles 30:21**

And sons of Israel found in Jerusalem kept feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness, and priests and Levites hymning to the Lord day by day with instruments to the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 30:22**

And Hezekiah spoke to every heart of Levites, those understanding good understanding for the Lord, and they completed feast of unleavened bread seven days, sacrificing sacrifices of salvation and giving thanks to the Lord God of their fathers.

**2 Chronicles 30:23**

And assembly took counsel together to do another seven days, and they did seven days with gladness.

**2 Chronicles 30:24**

Because Hezekiah contributed to Judah for assembly one thousand calves and seven thousand sheep, and rulers contributed to people one thousand calves and ten thousand sheep, and many holy things for priests.

**2 Chronicles 30:25**

And all the assembly rejoiced, priests and Levites and all the assembly from Judah and those found from Israel and sojourners who came from the land of Israel and those dwelling in Judah.

**2 Chronicles 30:26**

And there was great gladness in Jerusalem; from the days of Solomon son of David king of Israel there had not been such feast in Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 30:27**

And priests the Levites rose and blessed people, and their voice was heard and their prayer came to his holy dwelling, to heaven.

#### Chapter 31

**2 Chronicles 31:1**

And when all these things were finished, all Israel found in the cities of Judah went out and broke pillars and cut down groves and pulled down high places and altars from all Judah and Benjamin and from Ephraim and from Manasseh until end, and all Israel returned each to his inheritance and to their cities.

**2 Chronicles 31:2**

And Hezekiah appointed courses of priests and Levites, each course according to its own service, priests and Levites for whole burnt offering and sacrifice of salvation and to praise and give thanks and minister at gates in the courts of the house of the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 31:3**

And portion of the king from his possessions was for whole burnt offerings, morning and evening, and whole burnt offerings for Sabbaths and new moons and feasts written in the law of the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 31:4**

And he told people dwelling in Jerusalem to give portion of priests and Levites so that they might grow strong in service of the house of the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 31:5**

And as word was commanded, sons of Israel increased firstfruits of grain and wine and oil and honey and every produce of field, and tithes of all things they brought in abundance.

**2 Chronicles 31:6**

Sons of Israel and Judah and those dwelling in the cities of Judah also brought tithes of calves and sheep and tithes of goats and sanctified to the Lord their God and brought in and set in heaps, heaps.

**2 Chronicles 31:7**

In the third month they began to lay foundation of heaps, and in seventh month they finished.

**2 Chronicles 31:8**

And Hezekiah and rulers came and saw heaps and blessed the Lord and his people Israel.

**2 Chronicles 31:9**

And Hezekiah inquired of priests and Levites concerning heaps.

**2 Chronicles 31:10**

And Azariah the chief priest for the house of Zadok said to him, From when firstfruits began to be brought into the house of the Lord, we ate and drank and left over, because the Lord blessed his people, and we still left over this great abundance.

**2 Chronicles 31:11**

And Hezekiah said to prepare storerooms in the house of the Lord, and they prepared them.

**2 Chronicles 31:12**

And they brought there firstfruits and tithes in faithfulness, and over them overseer was Cononiah the Levite and Shimei his brother second.

**2 Chronicles 31:13**

And Jehiel and Azaziah and Nahath and Asahel and Jerimoth and Jozabad and Eliel and Samachia and Maath and Benaiah and his sons were set under Cononiah and Shimei his brother, as King Hezekiah and Azariah leader of the house of the Lord commanded.

**2 Chronicles 31:14**

And Kore son of Imnah the Levite, gatekeeper eastward, was over freewill gifts to give firstfruits to the Lord and holy of holies.

**2 Chronicles 31:15**

By hand of Odom and Benjamin and Joshua and Shemaiah and Amariah and Shecaniah, by the hand of priests in faithfulness, to give to their brothers according to courses, to great and small.

**2 Chronicles 31:16**

Besides genealogy of males from three years and upward, to everyone entering house of the Lord for matter of days day by day, for service in courses of their ordinance.

**2 Chronicles 31:17**

This is reckoning of priests by the houses of fathers, and Levites in their courses from twenty years and upward in their arrangement.

**2 Chronicles 31:18**

In genealogies among all their offspring, their sons and daughters, for all multitude, because in faithfulness they sanctified holy thing.

**2 Chronicles 31:19**

For the sons of Aaron, those serving as priests, and those from their cities in every city and city, men named by name to give portion to every male among priests and to every one counted among Levites.

**2 Chronicles 31:20**

And Hezekiah did thus in all Judah and did good and upright before the Lord his God.

**2 Chronicles 31:21**

And in every work which he began in service in the house of the Lord and in law and in ordinances, he sought his God with all his soul and did it, and he prospered.

#### Chapter 32

**2 Chronicles 32:1**

And after these words and this faithfulness, Sennacherib king of the Assyrians came, and he came against Judah and encamped against fortified cities and said to seize them.

**2 Chronicles 32:2**

And Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib had come and that his face was set to fight against Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 32:3**

And he took counsel with his elders and his mighty men to stop up waters of springs which were outside city, and they strengthened him.

**2 Chronicles 32:4**

And he gathered much people and stopped up waters of springs and river dividing through the city, saying, Lest king of Asshur come and find much water and prevail.

**2 Chronicles 32:5**

And Hezekiah grew strong and built all wall that had been pulled down, and towers, and another outer wall, and strengthened supporting-wall of the City of David, and prepared many weapons.

**2 Chronicles 32:6**

And he set war-captains over people, and they were gathered to him in the broad place of gate of valley, and he spoke to their heart, saying,

**2 Chronicles 32:7**

Be strong and act like men. Do not fear from the face of the king of Asshur and from the face of all nation with him, because more are with us than with him.

**2 Chronicles 32:8**

With him are fleshly arms, but with us is the Lord our God, to save and to fight our battle. And people grew bold upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.

**2 Chronicles 32:9**

And after these things Sennacherib king of the Assyrians sent his servants to Jerusalem, while he himself was at Lachish and all force with him, and he sent to Hezekiah king of Judah and to all Judah in Jerusalem, saying,

**2 Chronicles 32:10**

Thus says Sennacherib king of the Assyrians: Upon what do you trust and remain in siege in Jerusalem?

**2 Chronicles 32:11**

Does not Hezekiah deceive you, to give you over to death and to famine and to thirst, saying, The Lord our God will save us from the hand of the king of Asshur?

**2 Chronicles 32:12**

Is not this Hezekiah himself the one who removed his altars and his high places and said to Judah and to those dwelling in Jerusalem, saying, Before this altar you shall bow down, and upon it you shall burn incense?

**2 Chronicles 32:13**

Will you not know what I and my fathers did to all peoples of lands? Were gods of nations of all the earth at all able to save their people from my hand?

**2 Chronicles 32:14**

Who among all gods of these nations whom my fathers destroyed was unable to save their people from my hand, that your God will be able to save you from my hand?

**2 Chronicles 32:15**

Now let not Hezekiah deceive you, and let him not make you trust according to these things, and do not believe him, because no god of any nation and kingdom was able to save his people from my hand and from the hand of my fathers. So your God will certainly not save you from my hand.

**2 Chronicles 32:16**

And still his servants spoke against the Lord God and against Hezekiah his servant.

**2 Chronicles 32:17**

And he wrote letter to reproach the Lord God of Israel and spoke concerning him, saying, As gods of the nations of the earth did not deliver their peoples from my hand, so God of Hezekiah will certainly not deliver his people from my hand.

**2 Chronicles 32:18**

And he cried with loud voice in Ioudaisti over people of Jerusalem on wall, to frighten them and throw them down, so that they might seize city.

**2 Chronicles 32:19**

And he spoke against God of Jerusalem as also against gods of peoples of earth, works of the hands of men.

**2 Chronicles 32:20**

And Hezekiah king and Isaiah son of Amoz prophet prayed about these things and cried out to heaven.

**2 Chronicles 32:21**

And the Lord sent angel and crushed every mighty warrior and ruler and commander in camp of the king of Asshur, and he returned with the shame of face to his land, and he came into the house of his god, and those coming from his own belly struck him down there with sword.

**2 Chronicles 32:22**

And the Lord saved Hezekiah and those dwelling in Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib king of Asshur and from the hand of all, and gave them rest round about.

**2 Chronicles 32:23**

And many brought gifts to the Lord in Jerusalem, and offerings to Hezekiah king of Judah, and he was lifted up in the eyes of all nations after these things.

**2 Chronicles 32:24**

In those days Hezekiah became sick to point of death, and he prayed to the Lord, and he heard him and gave him sign.

**2 Chronicles 32:25**

And Hezekiah did not repay according to recompense given him, but his heart was lifted up, and wrath came upon him and upon Judah and Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 32:26**

And Hezekiah was humbled from the height of his heart, he and those dwelling in Jerusalem, and the wrath of the Lord did not come upon them in the days of Hezekiah.

**2 Chronicles 32:27**

And there came to Hezekiah very much wealth and glory, and he made for himself treasuries of silver and gold and precious stone and for spices and armories and for desirable vessels,

**2 Chronicles 32:28**

and store-cities for produce of grain and oil and wine, and stalls for every beast and folds for flocks.

**2 Chronicles 32:29**

And he built cities for himself, and possession of sheep and cattle in abundance, because the Lord gave him very much possession.

**2 Chronicles 32:30**

This Hezekiah stopped up upper outlet of water of Gihon and directed them down toward south of the City of David, and Hezekiah prospered in all his works.

**2 Chronicles 32:31**

And so, with ambassadors of rulers from Babylon who had been sent to him to inquire from him about wonder that happened upon earth, the Lord left him to test him, to know things in his heart.

**2 Chronicles 32:32**

And the rest of words of Hezekiah and his mercy, behold, written in prophecy of Isaiah son of Amoz the prophet and in the book of kings of Judah and Israel.

**2 Chronicles 32:33**

And Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in ascent of tombs of sons of David, and all Judah and those dwelling in Jerusalem gave him glory and honor in his death, and Manasseh his son reigned in his place.

#### Chapter 33

**2 Chronicles 33:1**

Manasseh was twelve years old when he reigned, and fifty-five years he reigned in Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 33:2**

And he did evil before the Lord, from all abominations of nations whom the Lord destroyed from before the sons of Israel.

**2 Chronicles 33:3**

And he turned again and rebuilt high places which Hezekiah his father pulled down, and set up pillars to Baalim and made groves and bowed down to all the army of heaven and served them.

**2 Chronicles 33:4**

And he built altars in the house of the Lord, of which the Lord said, In Jerusalem my name will be forever.

**2 Chronicles 33:5**

And he built altars to all the army of heaven in two courts of the house of the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 33:6**

And he himself brought his children through fire in Valley of Ben-Hinnom, and practiced divination and omens and sorcery, and made ventriloquists and enchanters. He multiplied doing evil before the Lord, to provoke him.

**2 Chronicles 33:7**

And he set carved and molten image which he made in the house of God, of which God said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house and Jerusalem, which I chose from all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name forever.

**2 Chronicles 33:8**

And I will not again add to move foot of Israel from the land which I gave to their fathers, only if they keep to do all things which I commanded them, according to all law and ordinances and judgments by the hand of Moses.

**2 Chronicles 33:9**

And Manasseh led Judah and those dwelling in Jerusalem astray, to do evil beyond all nations which the Lord removed from before the sons of Israel.

**2 Chronicles 33:10**

And the Lord spoke against Manasseh and against his people, and they did not listen.

**2 Chronicles 33:11**

And the Lord brought upon them commanders of the force of the king of Asshur, and they seized Manasseh in bonds and bound him in fetters and brought him to Babylon.

**2 Chronicles 33:12**

And when he was afflicted, he sought the face of the Lord his God and humbled himself greatly before God of his fathers.

**2 Chronicles 33:13**

And he prayed to him, and he heard him and heard his cry and restored him to Jerusalem, to his kingdom. And Manasseh knew that Lord, he is God.

**2 Chronicles 33:14**

And after these things he built wall outside the City of David from west toward Gihon in ravine and at those going out of gate round about and to Ophel, and he raised it very high, and set commanders of force in all fortified cities in Judah.

**2 Chronicles 33:15**

And he removed foreign gods and carved thing from the house of the Lord, and all altars which he built on the mountain of the house of the Lord and in Jerusalem, and he threw them outside city.

**2 Chronicles 33:16**

And he restored the altar of the Lord and sacrificed upon it a sacrifice of salvation and of praise, and told Judah to serve the Lord God of Israel.

**2 Chronicles 33:17**

Except that people still sacrificed on high places, only to the Lord their God.

**2 Chronicles 33:18**

And the rest of words of Manasseh and his prayer to God and words of seers speaking to him in the name of the Lord God of Israel, behold, upon records.

**2 Chronicles 33:19**

And his prayer and how he was heard, and all his sins and his rebellions and places on which he built high places and set up groves and carved things before he turned back, behold, written upon the words of seers.

**2 Chronicles 33:20**

And Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in garden of his house, and Amon his son reigned in his place.

**2 Chronicles 33:21**

Amon was twenty-two years old when he reigned, and two years he reigned in Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 33:22**

And he did evil before the Lord as Manasseh his father did, and to all idols which Manasseh his father made Amon sacrificed and served them.

**2 Chronicles 33:23**

And he did not humble himself before the Lord as Manasseh his father humbled himself, because this Amon multiplied trespass.

**2 Chronicles 33:24**

And his servants attacked him and struck him in his house.

**2 Chronicles 33:25**

And the people of the land struck those attacking King Amon, and people of the land made Josiah his son king in his place.

#### Chapter 34

**2 Chronicles 34:1**

Josiah was eight years old when he reigned, and thirty-one years he reigned in Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 34:2**

And he did upright before the Lord and walked in the ways of David his father and did not turn aside right or left.

**2 Chronicles 34:3**

And in the eighth year of his kingdom, while he was still a young boy, he began to seek the Lord God of David his father. And in the twelfth year of his kingdom he began to cleanse Judah and Jerusalem from high places and groves and molten things.

**2 Chronicles 34:4**

And they pulled down before his face altars of Baalim, and high places above them, and he cut down groves, and carved and molten things he crushed and ground small and threw on tombs of those sacrificing to them.

**2 Chronicles 34:5**

And bones of priests he burned upon altars, and he cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 34:6**

And in the cities of Ephraim and Manasseh and Simeon and Naphtali and in their places round about.

**2 Chronicles 34:7**

And he pulled down groves and altars, and idols he cut small, and all high places he cut down from all the land of Israel, and he returned to Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 34:8**

And in the eighteenth year of his kingdom, after cleansing land and house, he sent Shaphan son of Azelia and Maaseiah ruler of the city and Joah son of Jehoahaz his recorder to strengthen the house of the Lord his God.

**2 Chronicles 34:9**

And they came to Hilkiah the high priest and gave money brought into the house of God, which Levites keeping gate gathered from the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim and of rulers and from all remnant in Israel and sons of Judah and Benjamin and those dwelling in Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 34:10**

And they gave it into the hand of workers, those appointed in the house of the Lord, and they gave it to those doing works, who were working in the house of the Lord, to repair and strengthen the house.

**2 Chronicles 34:11**

And they gave to carpenters and builders to buy squared stones and timber for beams, to roof houses which kings of Judah destroyed.

**2 Chronicles 34:12**

And men were faithfully upon works, and overseers over them were Jahath and Obadiah the Levites from the sons of Merari, and Zechariah and Meshullam from the sons of Kohath, to oversee. And every Levite skilled in instruments of songs,

**2 Chronicles 34:13**

and over burden bearers and over all those doing works, work by work. And from Levites were scribes and judges and gatekeepers.

**2 Chronicles 34:14**

And when they were bringing out money brought into the house of the Lord, Hilkiah the priest found the book of the law of the Lord by the hand of Moses.

**2 Chronicles 34:15**

And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe, I found the book of the law in the house of the Lord. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan.

**2 Chronicles 34:16**

And Shaphan brought book to the king and further brought word back to the king: All money placed in the hand of your servants doing work,

**2 Chronicles 34:17**

they melted down money found in the house of the Lord and gave it into the hand of overseers and into the hand of those doing work.

**2 Chronicles 34:18**

And Shaphan the scribe reported to the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest gave me book. And Shaphan read it before the king.

**2 Chronicles 34:19**

And it happened, when the king heard the words of the law, he tore his garments.

**2 Chronicles 34:20**

And the king commanded Hilkiah and Ahikam son of Shaphan and Abdon son of Micah and Shaphan the scribe and Asaiah servant of the king, saying,

**2 Chronicles 34:21**

Go, seek the Lord concerning me and concerning everyone left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of book found, because great wrath of the Lord is kindled among us, because our fathers did not listen to the words of the Lord, to do according to all things written in this book.

**2 Chronicles 34:22**

And Hilkiah and those whom king told went to Olda the prophetess, wife of Hillel son of Thakouath son of Helez, keeper of robes, and she dwelt in Jerusalem in Masena, and they spoke to her according to these things.

**2 Chronicles 34:23**

And she said to them, Thus said the Lord God of Israel: Say to man who sent you to me,

**2 Chronicles 34:24**

Thus says the Lord: Behold, I bring evils upon this place, all words written in book read before the king of Judah,

**2 Chronicles 34:25**

because they forsook me and burned incense to foreign gods, so that they might provoke me in all works of their hands. And my wrath has been kindled in this place and will not be quenched.

**2 Chronicles 34:26**

And to the king of Judah who sent you to seek the Lord, thus you shall say to him: Thus says the Lord God of Israel, concerning words which you heard,

**2 Chronicles 34:27**

because your heart was turned, and you humbled yourself before me when you heard my words against this place and against those dwelling in it, and you humbled yourself before me and tore your garments and wept before me, I also heard, says the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 34:28**

Behold, I will add you to your fathers, and you shall be added to your tombs in peace, and your eyes will not see all evils which I am bringing upon this place and upon those dwelling in it. And they brought word back to the king.

**2 Chronicles 34:29**

And the king sent and gathered elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 34:30**

And the king went up to the house of the Lord, and all Judah and those dwelling in Jerusalem and priests and Levites and all the people, from great to small, and he read in their ears all words of book of covenant found in the house of the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 34:31**

And the king stood upon pillar and made covenant before the Lord, to walk before the Lord, to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his ordinances with all his heart and with all his soul, words of covenant written upon this book.

**2 Chronicles 34:32**

And he made all found in Jerusalem and Benjamin stand to it, and those dwelling in Jerusalem made covenant in the house of the Lord God of their fathers.

**2 Chronicles 34:33**

And Josiah removed all abominations from all the land that belonged to the sons of Israel and made all found in Jerusalem and in Israel serve the Lord their God. All his days they did not turn away from behind the Lord God of their fathers.

#### Chapter 35

**2 Chronicles 35:1**

And Josiah kept Passover to the Lord his God, and they sacrificed Passover on the fourteenth of the first month.

**2 Chronicles 35:2**

And he set priests in their charges and strengthened them for the works of the house of the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 35:3**

And he said to the Levites, mighty in all Israel, when they had sanctified themselves to the Lord and placed the holy ark in the house which Solomon son of David king of Israel built, and the king said, It is not for you to carry anything on your shoulders. Now then minister to the Lord your God and to his people Israel.

**2 Chronicles 35:4**

And prepare yourselves by the houses of your fathers and by your courses, according to the writing of David king of Israel and by the hand of Solomon his son.

**2 Chronicles 35:5**

And stand in the house according to divisions of houses of your fathers, for your brothers, sons of the people, and share of father-house for Levites.

**2 Chronicles 35:6**

And sacrifice Passover and prepare holy things for your brothers, to do according to the word of the Lord by the hand of Moses.

**2 Chronicles 35:7**

And Josiah contributed to the sons of the people sheep and lambs and kids of goats, all for Passover, to all found, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand calves; these were from the king's possessions.

**2 Chronicles 35:8**

And his rulers contributed to people and to priests and Levites. Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, rulers of the house of God, gave to priests for Passover sheep and lambs and kids, two thousand six hundred, and calves three hundred.

**2 Chronicles 35:9**

And Cononiah and Benaiah and Shemaiah and Nathanael his brother and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jehozabad, rulers of the Levites, contributed to the Levites for Passover five thousand sheep and five hundred calves.

**2 Chronicles 35:10**

And service was set right, and priests stood in their station and Levites in their divisions according to the command of the king.

**2 Chronicles 35:11**

And they sacrificed Passover, and priests poured out blood from their hand, and Levites flayed them.

**2 Chronicles 35:12**

And they prepared whole burnt offering to give to them according to division by the houses of fathers for the sons of the people, to bring to the Lord, as written in the book of Moses, and thus till morning.

**2 Chronicles 35:13**

And they roasted Passover in fire according to ordinance, and holy things they boiled in bronze pots and cauldrons, and it went well, and they ran to all the sons of the people.

**2 Chronicles 35:14**

And after preparing for themselves and for priests, because priests were in offering fats and whole burnt offerings until night, Levites prepared for themselves and for their brothers, sons of Aaron.

**2 Chronicles 35:15**

And singers sons of Asaph were at their station according to commands of David and Asaph and Heman and Jeduthun prophets of the king, and rulers and gatekeepers at gate and gate. There was no need for them to move from service of holy things, because their brothers the Levites prepared for them.

**2 Chronicles 35:16**

And all service of the Lord was set right and prepared on that day, to keep Passover and to offer whole burnt offerings upon the altar of the Lord according to the command of King Josiah.

**2 Chronicles 35:17**

And sons of Israel found there kept Passover at that time and feast of unleavened bread seven days.

**2 Chronicles 35:18**

And no Passover like it came to be in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet, and all kings of Israel did not keep such Passover as Josiah kept, and priests and Levites and all Judah and Israel found there and those dwelling in Jerusalem, to the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 35:19**

In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah this Passover was kept.

**2 Chronicles 35:20**

And Pharaoh Necho king of Egypt went up against the king of the Assyrians at river Euphrates, and King Josiah went to meet him.

**2 Chronicles 35:21**

And he sent messengers to him, saying, What to me and to you, king of Judah? I do not come against you today to make war, and God said to hurry me. Pay attention to God with me, lest he destroy you.

**2 Chronicles 35:22**

And Josiah did not turn his face away from him, but strengthened himself to fight him, and did not listen to the words of Necho from the mouth of God, and came to fight in the plain of Megiddo.

**2 Chronicles 35:23**

And archers shot at King Josiah, and the king said to his servants, Bring me out, because I am badly wounded.

**2 Chronicles 35:24**

And his servants brought him out from chariot and lifted him onto second chariot which was his and brought him to Jerusalem, and he died and was buried with his fathers. And all Judah and Jerusalem mourned over Josiah.

**2 Chronicles 35:25**

And Jeremiah lamented over Josiah, and all rulers and ruling women spoke lament over Josiah until this day, and they gave it as ordinance upon Israel, and behold, written upon laments.

**2 Chronicles 35:26**

And words of Josiah and his hope are written in the law of the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 35:27**

And his first words and his last, behold, written upon the book of kings of Israel and Judah.

#### Chapter 36

**2 Chronicles 36:1**

And the people of the land took Jehoahaz son of Josiah and anointed him and made him king in place of his father in Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 36:2**

Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he reigned, and three months he reigned in Jerusalem. And the name of his mother was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah. And he did evil before the Lord according to all things his fathers did. And Pharaoh Necho bound him in Riblah in the land of Hamath, so that he should not reign in Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 36:3**

And the king removed him to Egypt and imposed tribute on the land, one hundred talents of silver and one talent of gold.

**2 Chronicles 36:4**

And Pharaoh Necho made Eliakim son of Josiah king of Judah in place of Josiah his father and changed his name to Jehoiakim, and Pharaoh Necho took Jehoahaz his brother and brought him into Egypt, and he died there. And they gave silver and gold to Pharaoh. Then land began to be taxed, to give silver according to the mouth of Pharaoh, and each man required silver and gold from the people of the land according to ability, to give to Pharaoh Necho.

**2 Chronicles 36:5**

Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he reigned, and eleven years he reigned in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother was Zechora daughter of Nerias from Ramah. And he did evil before the Lord according to all things his fathers did. In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came into the land, and he was serving him three years, and he rebelled from him. And the Lord sent against them Chaldeans and raiding bands of Syrians and raiding bands of Moabites and sons of Ammon and of Samaria, and they revolted after this word according to the word of the Lord by the hand of his servants the prophets. Yet anger of the Lord was against Judah, to remove him from his face, because of the sins of Manasseh in all things he did, and in innocent blood which Jehoiakim poured out, and he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and the Lord did not wish to destroy them.

**2 Chronicles 36:6**

And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against him and bound him in bronze fetters and brought him to Babylon.

**2 Chronicles 36:7**

And he carried part of vessels of the house of the Lord to Babylon and put them in his temple in Babylon.

**2 Chronicles 36:8**

And the rest of words of Jehoiakim and all things he did, are not these written upon the book of words of days for kings of Judah? And Jehoiakim slept with his fathers and was buried in Ganoza with his fathers, and Jeconiah his son reigned in his place.

**2 Chronicles 36:9**

Jeconiah was eighteen years old when he reigned, and three months and ten days he reigned in Jerusalem, and he did evil before the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 36:10**

And when year turned, King Nebuchadnezzar sent and brought him into Babylon with desirable vessels of the house of the Lord, and he made Zedekiah his father's brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 36:11**

Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he reigned, and eleven years he reigned in Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 36:12**

And he did evil before the Lord his God. He was not ashamed before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from the mouth of the Lord.

**2 Chronicles 36:13**

And in that he broke with King Nebuchadnezzar what he had sworn him by God, he hardened his neck and strengthened his heart, so as not to turn back to the Lord God of Israel.

**2 Chronicles 36:14**

And all glorious men of Judah and priests and people of the land multiplied to break faith with faithless acts of abominations of nations, and they defiled house of the Lord in Jerusalem.

**2 Chronicles 36:15**

And the Lord God of their fathers sent by the hand of prophets, rising early and sending his messengers, because he was sparing his people and his holy place.

**2 Chronicles 36:16**

But they kept mocking his messengers and despising his words and playing with his prophets, until the wrath of the Lord rose upon his people, until there was no healing.

**2 Chronicles 36:17**

And he brought upon them king of Chaldeans, and he killed their young men with sword in the house of his holy place, and he did not spare young man or virgin or elder, but gave all into their hands.

**2 Chronicles 36:18**

And all vessels of the house of God, great and small, and treasures and all treasures of the king and nobles, he brought all into Babylon.

**2 Chronicles 36:19**

And he burned the house of the Lord and broke down the wall of Jerusalem, and her towers he burned in fire, and every beautiful vessel to destruction.

**2 Chronicles 36:20**

And he transported remnant to Babylon, and they were servants to him and to his sons until kingdom of Medes,

**2 Chronicles 36:21**

to fulfill the word of the Lord by the mouth of Jeremiah, until land welcomed its Sabbaths. All days of its desolation it kept Sabbaths to fulfill seventy years.

**2 Chronicles 36:22**

In the first year of Cyrus king of the Persians, after the word of the Lord by the mouth of Jeremiah was fulfilled, the Lord stirred the spirit of Cyrus king of the Persians, and he proclaimed to cry out in all his kingdom, also in writing, saying,

**2 Chronicles 36:23**

Thus says Cyrus king of the Persians: The Lord God of heaven gave me all kingdoms of the earth, and he himself commanded me to build for him a house in Jerusalem in Judah. Whoever among you is from all his people, his God shall be with him, and let him go up.

### Ezra

#### Chapter 1

**Ezra 1:1**

And in the first year of Cyrus king of the Persians, for fulfillment of the word of the Lord from the mouth of Jeremiah, the Lord stirred the spirit of Cyrus king of the Persians, and he proclaimed with a voice through all his kingdom, also in writing, saying,

**Ezra 1:2**

Thus said Cyrus king of the Persians: The Lord God of heaven gave me all kingdoms of the earth, and he charged me to build for him a house in Jerusalem, the one in Judah.

**Ezra 1:3**

Who among you is from all his people? Let his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem in Judah and build the house of God of Israel. He is the God in Jerusalem.

**Ezra 1:4**

And everyone left behind from all the places where he sojourns there, let men of his place support him with silver and gold and goods and cattle, besides the voluntary gift for the house of God in Jerusalem.

**Ezra 1:5**

Then the heads of father-houses of Judah and Benjamin rose up, and priests and Levites, all whose spirit God stirred to go up to build the house of the Lord in Jerusalem.

**Ezra 1:6**

And all around them strengthened their hands with silver vessels, with gold, with goods and cattle and gifts, besides all the voluntary offerings.

**Ezra 1:7**

And King Cyrus brought out vessels of the house of the Lord, which Nebuchadnezzar took from Jerusalem and placed in the house of his god.

**Ezra 1:8**

And Cyrus king of the Persians brought them out by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer and counted them out to Sheshbazzar, governor of Judah.

**Ezra 1:9**

And this their number: thirty golden basins, one thousand silver basins, twenty-nine substitute vessels,

**Ezra 1:10**

thirty golden bowls, two hundred silver bowls, and one thousand other vessels.

**Ezra 1:11**

All the vessels, in gold and silver, were five thousand four hundred. Sheshbazzar brought them all up with those coming up from captivity, from Babylon to Jerusalem.
