If you do not turn back, he will polish his sword, stretch his bow, and prepare it.

**Psalms 7:14**

And in it he prepared instruments of death; his arrows he worked out for burning ones.

**Psalms 7:15**

Behold, he travailed with injustice, conceived toil, and gave birth to lawlessness.

**Psalms 7:16**

He dug pit and scooped it out, and he will fall into hole which he made.

**Psalms 7:17**

His toil will return upon his head, and his injustice will come down upon his crown.

**Psalms 7:18**

I will confess to the Lord according to his righteousness, and I will sing praise to the name of the Lord Most High.

#### Chapter 8

**Psalms 8:1**

For end. Concerning winepresses. Psalm of David.

**Psalms 8:2**

Lord, our Lord, how wondrous your name in all the earth, because your magnificence was lifted above heavens.

**Psalms 8:3**

Out of mouth of infants and nursing ones you prepared praise, because of your enemies, to tear down enemy and avenger.

**Psalms 8:4**

Because I will see heavens, works of your fingers, moon and stars which you founded.

**Psalms 8:5**

What is man, that you remember him, or son of man, that you visit him?

**Psalms 8:6**

You lessened him a little from angels; with glory and honor you crowned him.

**Psalms 8:7**

And you set him over the works of your hands; all things you subjected under his feet:

**Psalms 8:8**

sheep and oxen, all of them, and also beasts of the field,

**Psalms 8:9**

birds of heaven and fish of the sea, things passing through paths of seas.

**Psalms 8:10**

Lord, our Lord, how wondrous your name in all the earth.

#### Chapter 9

**Psalms 9:1**

For end. Concerning hidden things of son. Psalm of David.

**Psalms 9:2**

I will confess to you, Lord, with all my heart; I will recount all your wondrous deeds.

**Psalms 9:3**

I will be glad and rejoice in you; I will sing praise to your name, Most High,

**Psalms 9:4**

when my enemy turns back. They will grow weak and perish from your face,

**Psalms 9:5**

because you made my judgment and my case. You sat upon a throne, judging righteousness.

**Psalms 9:6**

You rebuked nations, and the ungodly man perished. Their name you wiped out into age and into age of age.

**Psalms 9:7**

The swords of the enemy failed to end, and you pulled down cities. Their memorial perished with noise.

**Psalms 9:8**

But the Lord remains into age; he prepared his throne in judgment.

**Psalms 9:9**

And he himself will judge inhabited world in righteousness; he will judge peoples in uprightness.

**Psalms 9:10**

And the Lord became a refuge for the poor man, a helper in opportunities, in affliction.

**Psalms 9:11**

And let those knowing your name hope upon you, because you did not forsake those seeking you, Lord.

**Psalms 9:12**

Sing praise to the Lord dwelling in Zion; announce among nations his deeds.

**Psalms 9:13**

Because, seeking out their bloods, he remembered; he did not forget the cry of poor men.

**Psalms 9:14**

Have mercy on me, Lord; see my humiliation from my enemies, you lifting me up from the gates of death,

**Psalms 9:15**

so that I may declare all your praises in the gates of daughter of Zion. I will rejoice in your salvation.

**Psalms 9:16**

Nations were trapped in corruption which they made; in this snare which they hid, their foot was caught.

**Psalms 9:17**

The Lord is known, making judgments; in the works of his hands the sinner was caught. Song of interlude.

**Psalms 9:18**

Let sinners turn back into Hades, all nations forgetting God.

**Psalms 9:19**

Because the poor man will not be forgotten to the end, and endurance of poor men will not perish into age.

**Psalms 9:20**

Rise up, Lord; let not man prevail. Let nations be judged before you.

**Psalms 9:21**

Appoint lawgiver over them, Lord; let nations know that they are men. Interlude.

**Psalms 9:22**

Why, Lord, have you stood far off, overlooking in opportunities, in affliction?

**Psalms 9:23**

When the ungodly man acts proudly, the poor man is set on fire; they are caught in schemes which they devise.

**Psalms 9:24**

Because the sinner is praised in the desires of his soul, and the unjust man is blessed.

**Psalms 9:25**

The sinner provoked the Lord; according to the multitude of his anger he will not seek him. God is not before him.

**Psalms 9:26**

His ways are profaned in every season; your judgments are taken away from before him. He will dominate all his enemies.

**Psalms 9:27**

For he said in his heart, I will not be shaken from generation to generation, without evil.

**Psalms 9:28**

His mouth is full of curse and bitterness and deceit; under his tongue are toil and pain.

**Psalms 9:29**

He sits in ambush with rich men in hidden places to kill an innocent man; his eyes look toward the poor man.

**Psalms 9:30**

He lies in ambush in a hidden place like a lion in its den, lying in ambush to seize a poor man, to seize a poor man by dragging him away.

**Psalms 9:31**

In his snare he will humble him; he will crouch and fall when he dominates poor men.

**Psalms 9:32**

For he said in his heart, God has forgotten; he turned away his face so as never to see.

**Psalms 9:33**

Rise up, Lord God; let your hand be lifted high. Do not forget poor men.

**Psalms 9:34**

For what reason did the ungodly man provoke God? For he said in his heart, He will not seek out.

**Psalms 9:35**

You see, because you observe toil and wrath, to hand them over into your hands. To you the poor man is left; you were a helper to an orphan.

**Psalms 9:36**

Break the arm of the sinner and evil man; his sin will be sought and by no means found because of it.

**Psalms 9:37**

The Lord will reign into age and into age of age; nations, you will perish from his land.

**Psalms 9:38**

The Lord heard the desire of poor men; your ear attended to the preparation of their heart,

**Psalms 9:39**

to judge an orphan and a lowly man, so that man upon earth may no longer add to acting great.

#### Chapter 10

**Psalms 10:1**

For end. Psalm of David. In the Lord I trusted. How will you say to my soul, Migrate to mountains like a sparrow?

**Psalms 10:2**

Because behold, sinners stretched bow, prepared arrows in quiver, to shoot in darkness at upright ones in heart.

**Psalms 10:3**

Because what you fitted together they tore down; but the righteous man, what did he do?

**Psalms 10:4**

The Lord is in his holy temple; the Lord's throne is in heaven. His eyes look toward the poor man; his eyelids examine sons of men.

**Psalms 10:5**

The Lord examines the righteous man and the ungodly man, but one loving injustice hates his own soul.

**Psalms 10:6**

He will rain snares upon sinners, fire and sulfur and blast of storm, the portion of their cup.

**Psalms 10:7**

Because the Lord is righteous and loved righteousnesses; his face saw uprightness.

#### Chapter 11

**Psalms 11:1**

For end. Concerning eighth. Psalm of David.

**Psalms 11:2**

Save me, Lord, because holy man failed, because truths were diminished from the sons of men.

**Psalms 11:3**

Each spoke vain things to his neighbor; with deceitful lips, with heart and heart they spoke.

**Psalms 11:4**

May the Lord utterly destroy all deceitful lips and tongue speaking great things,

**Psalms 11:5**

those saying, We will magnify our tongue; our lips are with us; who is lord over us?

**Psalms 11:6**

Because of misery of poor men and groaning of needy men, now I will rise up, says the Lord; I will set him in salvation; I will speak boldly in him.

**Psalms 11:7**

The words of the Lord are pure words, silver refined by fire, tested in earth, purified sevenfold.

**Psalms 11:8**

You, Lord, will guard us and preserve us from this generation and into age.

**Psalms 11:9**

Ungodly men walk around in circle; according to your height you made sons of men much observed.

#### Chapter 12

**Psalms 12:1**

For end. Psalm of David.

**Psalms 12:2**

Until when, Lord, will you forget me to end? Until when will you turn your face from me?

**Psalms 12:3**

Until when will I place counsels in my soul, pains in my heart by day? Until when will my enemy be lifted up over me?

**Psalms 12:4**

Look, hear me, Lord my God. Enlighten my eyes, lest I sleep into death,

**Psalms 12:5**

lest my enemy say, I prevailed against him. Those afflicting me will rejoice if I am shaken.

**Psalms 12:6**

But I hoped in your mercy; my heart will rejoice in your salvation. I will sing to the Lord who did good to me, and sing praise to the name of the Lord Most High.

#### Chapter 13

**Psalms 13:1**

For end. Psalm of David. The fool said in his heart, There is no God. They were corrupted and became abominable in pursuits; there is none doing kindness, there is not even one.

**Psalms 13:2**

The Lord looked down from heaven upon the sons of men to see if there is one understanding or seeking God.

**Psalms 13:3**

All turned aside; together they became useless. There is none doing kindness, there is not even one. Their throat open grave; with their tongues they dealt deceitfully; venom of asps under their lips; whose mouth is full of curse and bitterness; their feet sharp to pour out blood.

**Psalms 13:4**

Will not all workers of lawlessness know, those eating my people as food of bread? They did not call upon the Lord.

**Psalms 13:5**

There they feared with fear where there was no fear, because God is in righteous generation.

**Psalms 13:6**

You shamed counsel of a poor man, because the Lord is his hope.

**Psalms 13:7**

Who will give from Zion salvation of Israel? When the Lord turns back captivity of his people, let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad.

#### Chapter 14

**Psalms 14:1**

Psalm of David. Lord, who will sojourn in your tent, and who will camp on your holy mountain?

**Psalms 14:2**

One walking blamelessly and working righteousness, speaking truth in his heart,

**Psalms 14:3**

who did not deal deceitfully with his tongue, nor do evil to his neighbor, and did not take reproach against those near him.

**Psalms 14:4**

Evildoer is despised before him, but those fearing the Lord he glorifies; one swearing to his neighbor and not setting it aside,

**Psalms 14:5**

his silver he did not give at interest, and did not take gifts against innocent men. One doing these things will not be shaken into age.

#### Chapter 15

**Psalms 15:1**

Inscription of David. Guard me, Lord, because upon you I hoped.

**Psalms 15:2**

I said to the Lord, You are my Lord, because you have no need of my good things.

**Psalms 15:3**

To holy ones in his land he made all his wills wondrous in them.

**Psalms 15:4**

Their weaknesses were multiplied; after these things they hastened. I will by no means gather their gatherings from bloods, nor by any means remember their names with my lips.

**Psalms 15:5**

Lord, portion of my inheritance and of my cup, you are one restoring my inheritance to me.

**Psalms 15:6**

Measuring lines fell to me among best things, and indeed my inheritance is best to me.

**Psalms 15:7**

I will bless the Lord who gave me understanding; and still, until night, my kidneys disciplined me.

**Psalms 15:8**

I foresaw the Lord before me through all things, because he is at my right hand so that I may not be shaken.

**Psalms 15:9**

Because of this my heart was gladdened and my tongue rejoiced; and still my flesh will camp in hope,

**Psalms 15:10**

because you will not forsake my soul to Hades, nor will you give your holy one to see corruption.

**Psalms 15:11**

You made known to me ways of life; you will fill me with gladness with your face; delights at your right hand to end.

#### Chapter 16

**Psalms 16:1**

Prayer of David. Hear, Lord, my righteousness; attend to my petition; give ear to my prayer, not with deceitful lips.

**Psalms 16:2**

Let my judgment come out from your face; let my eyes see straight things.

**Psalms 16:3**

You tested my heart, visited by night, refined me, and injustice was not found in me.

**Psalms 16:4**

So that my mouth might not speak works of men, because of words of your lips I kept hard ways.

**Psalms 16:5**

Set right my steps in your tracks, so that my steps may not be shaken.

**Psalms 16:6**

I cried out because you heard me, God. Incline your ear to me and hear my words.

**Psalms 16:7**

Make your mercies wondrous, you saving those hoping upon you from those standing against your right hand.

**Psalms 16:8**

Guard me as apple of eye; in the shelter of your wings you will cover me

**Psalms 16:9**

from the face of ungodly men who distressed me. My enemies enclosed my soul.

**Psalms 16:10**

Their fat they shut up; their mouth spoke arrogance.

**Psalms 16:11**

Casting me out, now they encircled me; their eyes they set to turn aside into earth.

**Psalms 16:12**

They took me up like a lion ready for the hunt and like a lion-cub dwelling in hidden places.

**Psalms 16:13**

Rise up, Lord; get before them and trip them up. Rescue my soul from ungodly men, your sword, from enemies of your hand,

**Psalms 16:14**

Lord, from few men of earth divide them in their life; and with your hidden things their belly was filled. They were satisfied with sons and left remainders to their little ones.

**Psalms 16:15**

But I in righteousness will appear before your face; I will be satisfied when your glory appears.

#### Chapter 17

**Psalms 17:1**

For end. To the servant of the Lord, David, what he spoke to the Lord, words of this song, on the day when the Lord rescued him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.

**Psalms 17:2**

And he said, I will love you, Lord, my strength.

**Psalms 17:3**

Lord my firm place and my refuge and my rescuer, my God my helper, and I will hope upon him, my defender and horn of my salvation, my supporter.

**Psalms 17:4**

Praising, I will call upon the Lord, and from my enemies I will be saved.

**Psalms 17:5**

The pangs of death enclosed me, and torrents of lawlessness troubled me.

**Psalms 17:6**

The pangs of Hades surrounded me; snares of death came before me.

**Psalms 17:7**

And in my affliction I called upon the Lord, and to my God I cried out. He heard my voice from his holy temple, and my cry before him will enter into his ears.

**Psalms 17:8**

And earth was shaken and became trembling; foundations of mountains were troubled and shaken, because God was angered with them.

**Psalms 17:9**

Smoke went up in his anger, and fire from his face flamed up; coals were kindled from him.

**Psalms 17:10**

And he bent heaven and came down, and gloom under his feet.

**Psalms 17:11**

And he mounted cheroub and flew; he flew upon the wings of winds.

**Psalms 17:12**

And he made darkness his hiding place; around him his tent, dark water in the clouds of air.

**Psalms 17:13**

From brightness before him clouds passed through, hail and coals of fire.

**Psalms 17:14**

And the Lord thundered from heaven, and Most High gave his voice.

**Psalms 17:15**

And he sent out arrows and scattered them; he multiplied lightnings and threw them into confusion.

**Psalms 17:16**

And the fountains of waters were seen, and the foundations of the inhabited world were uncovered from your rebuke, Lord, from the breath of the spirit of your wrath.

**Psalms 17:17**

He sent from on high and took me; he received me out of many waters.

**Psalms 17:18**

He will rescue me from my strong enemies and from those hating me, because they were stronger than I.

**Psalms 17:19**

They came before me in the day of my affliction, and the Lord became my support.

**Psalms 17:20**

And he brought me out into broad place; he will rescue me because he desired me.

**Psalms 17:21**

And the Lord will repay me according to my righteousness, and according to the purity of my hands he will repay me,

**Psalms 17:22**

because I kept ways of the Lord and did not act ungodly from my God.

**Psalms 17:23**

Because all his judgments were before me, and his ordinances I did not turn away from me.

**Psalms 17:24**

And I will be blameless with him, and guard myself from my lawlessness.

**Psalms 17:25**

And the Lord will repay me according to my righteousness and according to the purity of my hands before his eyes.

**Psalms 17:26**

With holy one you will be holy, and with innocent man you will be innocent.

**Psalms 17:27**

And with chosen one you will be chosen, and with crooked one you will twist.

**Psalms 17:28**

Because you will save humble people and humble eyes of proud men.

**Psalms 17:29**

Because you will light my lamp, Lord; my God, you will light my darkness.

**Psalms 17:30**

Because in you I will be rescued from trap, and in my God I will leap over wall.

**Psalms 17:31**

My God, his way blameless; the words of the Lord refined by fire. He is defender of all hoping upon him.

**Psalms 17:32**

Because who is God besides Lord, and who is God besides our God?

**Psalms 17:33**

God who girds me with strength and set my way blameless,

**Psalms 17:34**

fitting my feet like deer and setting me upon heights,

**Psalms 17:35**

teaching my hands for war, and you made my arms bronze bow.

**Psalms 17:36**

And you gave me defense of my salvation, and your right hand held me up, and your discipline set me straight to end, and this discipline of yours will teach me.

**Psalms 17:37**

You widened my steps under me, and my tracks did not weaken.

**Psalms 17:38**

I will pursue my enemies and overtake them, and I will not turn back until they fail.

**Psalms 17:39**

I will crush them and they will not be able to stand; they will fall under my feet.

**Psalms 17:40**

And you girded me with strength for war; you shackled under me all rising against me.

**Psalms 17:41**

And my enemies you gave to me back, and those hating me you destroyed.

**Psalms 17:42**

They cried out, and there was none saving, to the Lord, and he did not hear them.

**Psalms 17:43**

And I will pulverize them like dust before wind; like mud of streets I will smooth them down.

**Psalms 17:44**

Rescue me from contradictions of the people; you will set me as head of nations. People whom I did not know served me.

**Psalms 17:45**

At the hearing of ear they obeyed me; foreign sons lied to me.

**Psalms 17:46**

Foreign sons grew old and limped from their paths.

**Psalms 17:47**

The Lord lives, and blessed is my God, and let God of my salvation be exalted,

**Psalms 17:48**

God giving vengeance to me and subjecting peoples under me,

**Psalms 17:49**

my rescuer from angry enemies. From those rising against me you will lift me up; from unjust man you will rescue me.

**Psalms 17:50**

Because of this I will confess to you among nations, Lord, and to your name I will sing praise,

**Psalms 17:51**

magnifying salvations of his king and doing mercy to his Anointed, to David and to his seed into age.

#### Chapter 18

**Psalms 18:1**

For end. Psalm of David.

**Psalms 18:2**

Heavens recount the glory of God, and firmament announces making of his hands.

**Psalms 18:3**

Day to day gushes word, and night to night announces knowledge.

**Psalms 18:4**

There are no speeches nor words where their voices are not heard.

**Psalms 18:5**

Into all the earth their sound went out, and to the ends of inhabited world their words. In sun he set his tent.

**Psalms 18:6**

And he as bridegroom coming out of bridal chamber will rejoice like a giant to run his course.

**Psalms 18:7**

From the edge of heaven is his going out, and his return to edge of heaven, and there is none who will hide from his heat.

**Psalms 18:8**

The law of the Lord is blameless, turning souls back; the testimony of the Lord is faithful, making little ones wise.

**Psalms 18:9**

The ordinances of the Lord are straight, gladdening heart; the command of the Lord is radiant, enlightening eyes.

**Psalms 18:10**

The fear of the Lord is pure, remaining into age of age; judgments of the Lord are true, justified together.

**Psalms 18:11**

More to be desired than gold and much precious stone, and sweeter than honey and honeycomb.

**Psalms 18:12**

And indeed your servant guards them; in guarding them, much repayment.

**Psalms 18:13**

Who will understand trespasses? From my hidden ones cleanse me,

**Psalms 18:14**

and from strangers spare your servant. If they do not dominate me, then I will be blameless, and I will be cleansed from great sin.

**Psalms 18:15**

And words of my mouth and meditation of my heart will be for favor before you through all things, Lord, my helper and my redeemer.

#### Chapter 19

**Psalms 19:1**

For end. Psalm of David.

**Psalms 19:2**

May the Lord hear you in the day of affliction; may the name of God of Jacob defend you.

**Psalms 19:3**

May he send you help from holy place, and from Zion may he support you.

**Psalms 19:4**

May he remember all your sacrifice and let your whole burnt offering be fat. Interlude.

**Psalms 19:5**

May he give you according to your heart and fulfill all your counsel.

**Psalms 19:6**

We will rejoice in your salvation, and in the name of our God we will be magnified. May the Lord fulfill all your requests.

**Psalms 19:7**

Now I knew that the Lord saved his Anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven. Salvation of his right hand is in the acts of power.

**Psalms 19:8**

These in chariots and these in horses, but we in the name of the Lord our God will be magnified.

**Psalms 19:9**

They were shackled and fell, but we rose and were set upright.

**Psalms 19:10**

Lord, save your king, and hear us in whatever day we call upon you.

#### Chapter 20

**Psalms 20:1**

For end. Psalm of David.

**Psalms 20:2**

Lord, in your strength king will be gladdened, and in your salvation he will greatly rejoice.

**Psalms 20:3**

The desire of his soul you gave to him, and longing of his lips you did not deprive him of. Interlude.

**Psalms 20:4**

Because you got before him with blessings of goodness; you set upon his head crown from precious stone.

**Psalms 20:5**

He asked life from you, and you gave it to him, length of days into age of age.

**Psalms 20:6**

Great his glory in your salvation; glory and magnificence you will place upon him.

**Psalms 20:7**

Because you will give him blessing into age of age; you will gladden him with joy with your face.

**Psalms 20:8**

Because the king hopes upon the Lord, and in the mercy of Most High he will by no means be shaken.

**Psalms 20:9**

May your hand be found by all your enemies; may your right hand find all hating you.

**Psalms 20:10**

You will set them like a furnace of fire in the time of your face; The Lord in his anger will trouble them, and fire will devour them.

**Psalms 20:11**

Their fruit from earth you will destroy, and their seed from the sons of men,

**Psalms 20:12**

because they bent evils toward you; they devised counsel which they will not be able to establish.

**Psalms 20:13**

Because you will set them as back in your remnants; you will prepare their face.

**Psalms 20:14**

Be exalted, Lord, in your strength; we will sing and praise your mighty acts.

#### Chapter 21

**Psalms 21:1**

For end. Concerning morning help. Psalm of David.

**Psalms 21:2**

God, my God, attend to me. Why did you forsake me? Far from my salvation are words of my trespasses.

**Psalms 21:3**

My God, I will cry by day and you will not hear, and by night, and it is not folly to me.

**Psalms 21:4**

But you dwell among holy ones, praise of Israel.

**Psalms 21:5**

Upon you our fathers hoped; they hoped and you rescued them.

**Psalms 21:6**

To you they cried and were saved; upon you they hoped and were not ashamed.

**Psalms 21:7**

But I am worm and not man, reproach of man and despising of the people.

**Psalms 21:8**

All seeing me mocked me; they spoke with lips, they shook head,

**Psalms 21:9**

He hoped upon the Lord; let him rescue him, let him save him, because he wants him.

**Psalms 21:10**

Because you are one drawing me out from womb, my hope from the breasts of my mother.

**Psalms 21:11**

Upon you I was cast from womb; from the belly of my mother you are my God.

**Psalms 21:12**

Do not stand far from me, because affliction is near, because there is no helper.

**Psalms 21:13**

Many calves encircled me; fat bulls surrounded me.

**Psalms 21:14**

They opened their mouth upon me like a lion seizing and roaring.

**Psalms 21:15**

Like water I was poured out, and all my bones were scattered; my heart became like wax melting in the midst of my belly.

**Psalms 21:16**

My strength dried up like potsherd, and my tongue was glued to my throat, and you brought me down into dust of death.

**Psalms 21:17**

Because many dogs encircled me; gathering of evildoers surrounded me; they dug my hands and feet.

**Psalms 21:18**

I counted all my bones, and they observed and looked on me.

**Psalms 21:19**

They divided my garments among themselves, and cast lot upon my clothing.

**Psalms 21:20**

But you, Lord, do not put my help far away; attend to my support.

**Psalms 21:21**

Rescue my soul from sword, and my only one from the hand of dog.

**Psalms 21:22**

Save me from the mouth of lion, and my humiliation from horns of unicorns.

**Psalms 21:23**

I will recount your name to my brothers; in the midst of assembly I will hymn you.

**Psalms 21:24**

You fearing Lord, praise him; all seed of Jacob, glorify him; let all seed of Israel fear him,

**Psalms 21:25**

because he did not despise nor loathe petition of a poor man, nor turn his face from me, and when I cried to him he heard me.

**Psalms 21:26**

From you my praise in great assembly; my vows I will repay before those fearing him.

**Psalms 21:27**

Poor men will eat and be filled, and those seeking him will praise the Lord; their hearts will live into age of age.

**Psalms 21:28**

All ends of the earth will remember and turn to the Lord, and all families of nations will worship before you.

**Psalms 21:29**

Because the kingdom belongs to the Lord, and he rules over the nations.

**Psalms 21:30**

All fat ones of earth ate and worshiped; before him all going down into earth will fall down, and my soul lives to him.

**Psalms 21:31**

And my seed will serve him; coming generation will be announced to the Lord.

**Psalms 21:32**

And they will announce his righteousness to people being born, because the Lord did it.

#### Chapter 22

**Psalms 22:1**

Psalm of David. The Lord shepherds me, and nothing will be lacking to me.

**Psalms 22:2**

Into place of grass there he camped me; beside water of rest he nourished me.

**Psalms 22:3**

He turned my soul back; he led me upon tracks of righteousness for the sake of his name.

**Psalms 22:4**

For even if I walk in the midst of the shadow of death, I will not fear evils, because you are with me; your rod and your staff, these comforted me.

**Psalms 22:5**

You prepared table before me opposite those afflicting me; you anointed my head with oil, and your cup intoxicates me, how excellent.

**Psalms 22:6**

And your mercy will pursue me all days of my life, and my dwelling in the house of the Lord to the length of days.

#### Chapter 23

**Psalms 23:1**

Psalm of David. Of first of Sabbaths. Earth belongs to the Lord and its fullness, inhabited world and all dwelling in it.

**Psalms 23:2**

He founded it upon seas and prepared it upon rivers.

**Psalms 23:3**

Who will go up to the mountain of the Lord, and who will stand in his holy place?

**Psalms 23:4**

Innocent in hands and clean in heart, who did not take his soul upon vanity and did not swear in deceit to his neighbor.

**Psalms 23:5**

This one will receive blessing from the Lord and mercy from God his savior.

**Psalms 23:6**

This is generation of those seeking him, seeking face of God of Jacob. Interlude.

**Psalms 23:7**

Lift up gates, your rulers, and be lifted up, everlasting gates, and the king of glory will enter.

**Psalms 23:8**

Who is this king of glory? The Lord, strong and mighty; the Lord, mighty in war.

**Psalms 23:9**

Lift up gates, your rulers, and be lifted up, everlasting gates, and the king of glory will enter.

**Psalms 23:10**

Who is this king of glory? The Lord of hosts, he is the king of glory.

#### Chapter 24

**Psalms 24:1**

Psalm of David. To you, Lord, I lifted my soul, O my God.

**Psalms 24:2**

Upon you I trusted; may I not be ashamed, nor let my enemies mock me.

**Psalms 24:3**

For indeed all enduring you will by no means be ashamed; let all acting lawlessly for nothing be ashamed.

**Psalms 24:4**

Your ways, Lord, make known to me, and your paths teach me.

**Psalms 24:5**

Lead me upon your truth and teach me, because you are God my savior, and I endured you all day.

**Psalms 24:6**

Remember your compassions, Lord, and your mercies, because they are from age.

**Psalms 24:7**

Sins of my youth and my ignorances do not remember; according to your mercy remember me, because of your goodness, Lord.

**Psalms 24:8**

Good and upright is the Lord; because of this he will give law to sinners in way.

**Psalms 24:9**

He will guide meek ones in judgment; he will teach meek ones his ways.

**Psalms 24:10**

All ways of the Lord are mercy and truth to those seeking out his covenant and his testimonies.

**Psalms 24:11**

For the sake of your name, Lord, you will be propitious to my sin, because it is great.

**Psalms 24:12**

Who is man fearing Lord? He will give law to him in way which he chose.

**Psalms 24:13**

His soul will lodge among good things, and his seed will inherit earth.

**Psalms 24:14**

The Lord is stronghold of those fearing him, and the name of the Lord belongs to those fearing him, and his covenant to show it to them.

**Psalms 24:15**

My eyes are always toward the Lord, because he will draw my feet out of snare.

**Psalms 24:16**

Look upon me and have mercy on me, because I am only one and poor.

**Psalms 24:17**

Afflictions of my heart were widened; out of my necessities bring me out.

**Psalms 24:18**

See my humiliation and my toil, and forgive all my sins.

**Psalms 24:19**

See my enemies, because they were multiplied and hated me with unjust hatred.

**Psalms 24:20**

Guard my soul and rescue me; may I not be ashamed, because I hoped upon you.

**Psalms 24:21**

Blameless and upright men clung to me, because I endured you, Lord.

**Psalms 24:22**

Redeem, O God, Israel from all his afflictions.

#### Chapter 25

**Psalms 25:1**

Of David. Judge me, Lord, because I walked in my innocence, and hoping upon the Lord I will by no means weaken.

**Psalms 25:2**

Test me, Lord, and try me; refine my kidneys and my heart.

**Psalms 25:3**

Because your mercy is before my eyes, and I was well-pleasing in your truth.

**Psalms 25:4**

I did not sit with the assembly of vanity, and with lawless men I will by no means enter.

**Psalms 25:5**

I hated assembly of evildoers, and with ungodly men I will by no means sit.

**Psalms 25:6**

I will wash my hands among innocent ones, and circle your altar, Lord,

**Psalms 25:7**

to hear the voice of praise and recount all your wondrous deeds.

**Psalms 25:8**

Lord, I loved beauty of your house and place of tent of your glory.

**Psalms 25:9**

Do not destroy my soul together with ungodly men, nor my life with men of bloods,

**Psalms 25:10**

in whose hands are lawless acts, and their right hand was filled with gifts.

**Psalms 25:11**

But I walked in my innocence; redeem me and have mercy on me.

**Psalms 25:12**

For my foot stood in uprightness; in assemblies I will bless you, Lord.

#### Chapter 26

**Psalms 26:1**

Of David, before being anointed. The Lord is my illumination and my savior; whom shall I fear? The Lord is defender of my life; from whom shall I be afraid?

**Psalms 26:2**

When evildoers draw near upon me to eat my flesh, those afflicting me and my enemies, they weakened and fell.

**Psalms 26:3**

If camp should line up against me, my heart will not fear. If war rise up against me, in this I hope.

**Psalms 26:4**

One thing I asked from the Lord; this I will seek out: to dwell me in the house of the Lord all days of my life, to behold delight of the Lord and visit his temple.

**Psalms 26:5**

Because he hid me in tent in the day of my evils; he sheltered me in the hidden place of his tent; on rock he lifted me up.

**Psalms 26:6**

And now behold, he lifted my head over enemies around me. I went around and sacrificed in his tent sacrifice of shouting; I will sing and praise the Lord.

**Psalms 26:7**

Hear, Lord, my voice with which I cried out; have mercy on me and hear me.

**Psalms 26:8**

To you my heart said, My face sought your face; your face, Lord, I will seek.

**Psalms 26:9**

Do not turn your face from me, nor turn away in anger from your servant. Become my helper; do not cast me off and do not forsake me, God my savior.

**Psalms 26:10**

Because my father and my mother forsook me, but the Lord took me in.

**Psalms 26:11**

Give me law, Lord, in your way, and lead me in straight path because of my enemies.

**Psalms 26:12**

Do not hand me over to the souls of those afflicting me, because unjust witnesses rose against me and injustice lied to itself.

**Psalms 26:13**

I believe to see good things of the Lord in the land of living ones.

**Psalms 26:14**

Endure Lord; act like a man, and let your heart be strengthened, and endure Lord.

#### Chapter 27

**Psalms 27:1**

Of David. To you, Lord, I cried out. My God, do not be silent from me, lest if you be silent from me, I become like those going down into pit.

**Psalms 27:2**

Hear voice of my petition when I beg to you, when I lift my hands toward your holy temple.

**Psalms 27:3**

Do not drag my soul away with sinners, and do not destroy me together with those working injustice, those speaking peace with their neighbors while evils are in their hearts.

**Psalms 27:4**

Give to them according to their works and according to evil of their pursuits; according to the works of their hands give to them; repay to them their repayment.

**Psalms 27:5**

Because they did not understand works of the Lord and works of his hands, you will pull them down and by no means build them up.

**Psalms 27:6**

Blessed is the Lord, because he heard the voice of my petition.

**Psalms 27:7**

Lord my helper and my defender; upon him my heart hoped and I was helped, and my flesh bloomed again, and by my will I will confess to him.

**Psalms 27:8**

The Lord is strength of his people, and defender of salvations of his Anointed is he.

**Psalms 27:9**

Save your people and bless your inheritance, and shepherd them and lift them up until age.

#### Chapter 28

**Psalms 28:1**

Psalm of David. Of exiting tent. Bring to the Lord, sons of God; bring to the Lord sons of rams; bring to the Lord glory and honor.

**Psalms 28:2**

Bring to the Lord glory to his name; worship the Lord in his holy court.

**Psalms 28:3**

The voice of the Lord is upon waters; God of glory thundered; Lord upon many waters.

**Psalms 28:4**

The voice of the Lord is in strength; the voice of the Lord is in magnificence.

**Psalms 28:5**

The voice of the Lord shattering cedars, and the Lord will shatter cedars of Lebanon.

**Psalms 28:6**

And he will pulverize them like a calf, Lebanon, and the beloved one like son of unicorns.

**Psalms 28:7**

The voice of the Lord cutting through flame of fire.

**Psalms 28:8**

The voice of the Lord shaking wilderness, and the Lord will shake wilderness of Kadesh.

**Psalms 28:9**

The voice of the Lord fitting deer and uncovering forests; and in his temple every one says, Glory.

**Psalms 28:10**

The Lord will dwell over flood, and the Lord will sit king into age.

**Psalms 28:11**

The Lord will give strength to his people; The Lord will bless his people in peace.

#### Chapter 29

**Psalms 29:1**

For end. Psalm, song of dedication of the house, of David.

**Psalms 29:2**

I will exalt you, Lord, because you took me up and did not gladden my enemies over me.

**Psalms 29:3**

Lord my God, I cried to you and you healed me.

**Psalms 29:4**

Lord, you brought up my soul from Hades; you saved me from those going down into pit.

**Psalms 29:5**

Sing praise to the Lord, his holy ones, and confess to remembrance of his holiness.

**Psalms 29:6**

Because anger in his wrath and life in his will. At evening weeping will lodge, and by morning glad shouting.

**Psalms 29:7**

But I said in my prosperity, I will by no means be shaken into age.

**Psalms 29:8**

Lord, in your will you supplied strength to my beauty; but you turned your face away and I became troubled.

**Psalms 29:9**

To you, Lord, I will cry, and to my God I will beg.

**Psalms 29:10**

What profit in my blood, in my going down into corruption? Will dust confess to you or announce your truth?

**Psalms 29:11**

The Lord heard and had mercy on me; The Lord became my helper.

**Psalms 29:12**

You turned my mourning into dance for me; you tore my sackcloth and girded me with gladness,

**Psalms 29:13**

so that my glory might sing to you and by no means be pierced through. Lord my God, into age I will confess to you.

#### Chapter 30

**Psalms 30:1**

For end. Psalm of David, of ecstasy.

**Psalms 30:2**

Upon you, Lord, I hoped; may I not be ashamed into age. In your righteousness rescue me and deliver me.

**Psalms 30:3**

Incline your ear to me; hurry to deliver me. Become to me God defender and a house of refuge to save me.

**Psalms 30:4**

Because you are my strength and my refuge, and for the sake of your name you will lead me and nourish me.

**Psalms 30:5**

You will bring me out from this snare which they hid for me, because you are my defender.

**Psalms 30:6**

Into your hands I will entrust my spirit. You redeemed me, Lord, God of truth.

**Psalms 30:7**

You hated those keeping worthless vanities for nothing, but I hoped upon the Lord.

**Psalms 30:8**

I will rejoice and be glad in your mercy, because you looked upon my humiliation; you saved my soul from necessities.

**Psalms 30:9**

And you did not shut me up into enemy hands; you set my feet in broad place.

**Psalms 30:10**

Have mercy on me, Lord, because I am afflicted; my eye was troubled in anger, my soul and my belly.

**Psalms 30:11**

Because my life failed in pain and my years in groanings; my strength weakened in poverty and my bones were troubled.

**Psalms 30:12**

Beyond all my enemies I became a reproach, and greatly to my neighbors, and fear to those known to me; those seeing me outside fled from me.

**Psalms 30:13**

I was forgotten like a dead man from heart; I became like a ruined vessel.

**Psalms 30:14**

Because I heard blame of many dwelling around, when they gathered together against me, they planned to take my soul.

**Psalms 30:15**

But I hoped upon you, Lord; I said, You are my God.

**Psalms 30:16**

My times in your hands. Rescue me from the hand of my enemies and from those pursuing me.

**Psalms 30:17**

Shine your face upon your servant; save me in your mercy.

**Psalms 30:18**

Lord, may I not be ashamed, because I called upon you. Let ungodly men be ashamed and brought down into Hades.

**Psalms 30:19**

Let deceitful lips become dumb, those speaking lawlessness against the righteous man in pride and contempt.

**Psalms 30:20**

How much the multitude of your goodness, Lord, which you hid for those fearing you; you worked it out for those hoping upon you before the sons of men.

**Psalms 30:21**

You will hide them in the hidden place of your face from disturbance of men; you will shelter them in tent from contradiction of tongues.

**Psalms 30:22**

Blessed is the Lord, because he made his mercy wondrous in the city of enclosure.

**Psalms 30:23**

But I said in my ecstasy, So then I am cast away from the face of your eyes. Because of this you heard the voice of my petition when I cried out to you.

**Psalms 30:24**

Love Lord, all his holy ones, because the Lord seeks truths and repays those doing pride beyond measure.

**Psalms 30:25**

Act like men and let your heart be strengthened, all hoping upon the Lord.

#### Chapter 31

**Psalms 31:1**

Of David. Of understanding. Blessed are those whose lawless acts were forgiven and whose sins were covered.

**Psalms 31:2**

Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will by no means count sin, nor is deceit in his mouth.

**Psalms 31:3**

Because I was silent, my bones grew old from my crying all day.

**Psalms 31:4**

Because day and night your hand grew heavy upon me; I was turned into misery when thorn was fixed in. Interlude.

**Psalms 31:5**

My sin I made known, and my lawlessness I did not cover. I said, I will confess against myself my lawlessness to the Lord, and you forgave ungodliness of my sin. Interlude.

**Psalms 31:6**

Because of this every holy one will pray to you in fitting season. Yet in flood of many waters they will not come near him.

**Psalms 31:7**

You are my refuge from affliction surrounding me, my joy. Redeem me from those encircling me. Interlude.

**Psalms 31:8**

I will make you understand and instruct you in this way which you will go; I will fix my eyes upon you.

**Psalms 31:9**

Do not become like horse and mule, which have no understanding, in bridle and bit to clamp their jaws, of those not drawing near to you.

**Psalms 31:10**

Many scourges belong to sinner, but mercy will encircle one hoping upon the Lord.

**Psalms 31:11**

Be glad in the Lord and rejoice, righteous ones, and boast, all upright in heart.

#### Chapter 32

**Psalms 32:1**

Of David. Rejoice in the Lord, righteous ones; praise is fitting for upright ones.

**Psalms 32:2**

Confess to the Lord with harp; with ten-stringed psaltery sing to him.

**Psalms 32:3**

Sing to him new song; play well with shouting.

**Psalms 32:4**

Because the word of the Lord is straight, and all his works in faithfulness.

**Psalms 32:5**

He loves mercy and judgment; earth full of mercy of the Lord.

**Psalms 32:6**

By the word of the Lord the heavens were made firm, and by the spirit of his mouth all their power.

**Psalms 32:7**

Gathering waters of sea like a wineskin, putting deeps in treasuries.

**Psalms 32:8**

Let all the earth fear Lord, and from him let all dwelling inhabited world be shaken,

**Psalms 32:9**

because he said and they came to be; he commanded and they were created.

**Psalms 32:10**

The Lord scatters counsels of nations, sets aside reasonings of peoples, and sets aside counsels of rulers.

**Psalms 32:11**

But counsel of the Lord remains into age, reasonings of his heart from generation to generation.

**Psalms 32:12**

Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord, people whom he chose for inheritance to himself.

**Psalms 32:13**

From heaven the Lord looked down; he saw all sons of men.

**Psalms 32:14**

From his prepared dwelling he looked upon all dwelling earth,

**Psalms 32:15**

he who formed their hearts one by one, he who understands all their works.

**Psalms 32:16**

King is not saved by much power, and giant will not be saved by the multitude of his strength.

**Psalms 32:17**

Horse false thing for salvation, and in the multitude of its power it will not be saved.

**Psalms 32:18**

Behold, eyes of the Lord upon those fearing him, those hoping upon his mercy,

**Psalms 32:19**

to rescue their souls from death and nourish them in famine.

**Psalms 32:20**

Our soul endures for the Lord, because he is our helper and defender.

**Psalms 32:21**

Because in him our heart will be gladdened, and in his holy name we hoped.

**Psalms 32:22**

Let your mercy, Lord, be upon us, just as we hoped upon you.

#### Chapter 33

**Psalms 33:1**

Of David, when he altered his face before Abimelech, and he released him and he went away.

**Psalms 33:2**

I will bless the Lord in every season; continually his praise in my mouth.

**Psalms 33:3**

In the Lord my soul will be praised; let meek hear and be glad.

**Psalms 33:4**

Magnify the Lord with me, and let us lift up his name together.

**Psalms 33:5**

I sought out Lord, and he heard me, and rescued me from all my sojournings.

**Psalms 33:6**

Draw near to him and be enlightened, and your faces will by no means be ashamed.

**Psalms 33:7**

This poor man cried out, and the Lord heard him and saved him from all his afflictions.

**Psalms 33:8**

Angel of the Lord will encamp around those fearing him and will rescue them.

**Psalms 33:9**

Taste and see that the Lord is good; blessed is the man who hopes upon him.

**Psalms 33:10**

Fear the Lord, his holy ones, because there is no lack to those fearing him.

**Psalms 33:11**

Rich men became poor and hungry, but those seeking the Lord will not be diminished of any good thing. Interlude.

**Psalms 33:12**

Come, children, hear me; The fear of the Lord I will teach you.

**Psalms 33:13**

Who is man wanting life, loving days to see good things?

**Psalms 33:14**

Stop your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking deceit.

**Psalms 33:15**

Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.

**Psalms 33:16**

The eyes of the Lord are upon righteous ones and his ears toward their petition.

**Psalms 33:17**

But the face of the Lord against those doing evils, to destroy their memorial from earth.

**Psalms 33:18**

The righteous cried out and the Lord heard them, and rescued them from all their afflictions.

**Psalms 33:19**

The Lord near to those crushed in heart, and he will save humble in spirit.

**Psalms 33:20**

Many are the afflictions of the righteous ones, and from all of them he will rescue them.

**Psalms 33:21**

The Lord guards all their bones; not one of them will be broken.

**Psalms 33:22**

The death of sinners is evil, and those hating the righteous man will go astray.

**Psalms 33:23**

The Lord will redeem souls of his servants, and all hoping upon him will by no means go astray.

#### Chapter 34

**Psalms 34:1**

Of David. Judge, Lord, those doing me injustice; war against those warring against me.

**Psalms 34:2**

Take hold of weapon and shield, and rise up for my help.

**Psalms 34:3**

Pour out sword and shut off those opposite my pursuers; say to my soul, I am your salvation.

**Psalms 34:4**

Let those seeking my soul be ashamed and put to shame; let those devising evils for me turn backward and be ashamed.

**Psalms 34:5**

Let them become like chaff before wind, and angel of the Lord afflicting them.

**Psalms 34:6**

Let their way become darkness and slipperiness, and angel of the Lord pursuing them.

**Psalms 34:7**

Because without cause they hid for me destruction of their snare; in vain they reproached my soul.

**Psalms 34:8**

Let snare come upon them which they do not know, and hunt which they hid catch them, and in that snare let them fall.

**Psalms 34:9**

But my soul will rejoice in the Lord, delighting in his salvation.

**Psalms 34:10**

All my bones will say, Lord, who like you, rescuing a poor man from the hand of those stronger than he, and a poor and needy one from those plundering him?

**Psalms 34:11**

Unjust witnesses rising up asked me things I did not know.

**Psalms 34:12**

They repaid me evils for good things and childlessness to my soul.

**Psalms 34:13**

But when they troubled me, I clothed myself in sackcloth and humbled my soul in fasting, and my prayer will return into my bosom.

**Psalms 34:14**

Like neighbor, like our brother, so I was pleasing; like mourning and glooming, so I humbled myself.

**Psalms 34:15**

And against me they rejoiced and gathered together; scourges gathered upon me and I did not know; they were torn apart and were not pierced through.

**Psalms 34:16**

They tested me, mocked me with mocking, gnashed their teeth at me.

**Psalms 34:17**

Lord, when will you look? Restore my soul from their villainies, my only one from lions.

**Psalms 34:18**

I will confess to you, Lord, in great assembly; among heavy people I will praise you.

**Psalms 34:19**

Let those hating me unjustly not rejoice over me, those hating me without cause and winking with eyes,

**Psalms 34:20**

because to me they spoke peaceful things, and in anger they devised deceits.

**Psalms 34:21**

And they opened wide their mouth upon me; they said, Good, good, our eyes saw.

**Psalms 34:22**

You saw, Lord; do not be silent. Lord, do not stand far from me.

**Psalms 34:23**

Wake up, Lord, and attend to my judgment, my God and my Lord, to my case.

**Psalms 34:24**

Judge me according to your righteousness, Lord my God, and let them not rejoice over me.

**Psalms 34:25**

Let them not say in their hearts, Good, good, to our soul, nor say, We swallowed him up.

**Psalms 34:26**

Let those rejoicing at my evils be ashamed and put to shame together; let those speaking great things against me be clothed with shame and embarrassment.

**Psalms 34:27**

Let those wanting my righteousness rejoice and be glad, and let them always say, Let the Lord be magnified, those wanting peace of his servant.

**Psalms 34:28**

And my tongue will meditate your righteousness, all day your praise.

#### Chapter 35

**Psalms 35:1**

For end. To the servant of the Lord, David.

**Psalms 35:2**

The lawless man says of sinning within himself, There is no fear of God before his eyes.

**Psalms 35:3**

Because he dealt deceitfully before him, to find his lawlessness and hate it.

**Psalms 35:4**

The words of his mouth lawlessness and deceit; he did not wish to understand so as to do good.

**Psalms 35:5**

He devised lawlessness upon his bed; he stood upon every way not good, and he did not loathe evil.

**Psalms 35:6**

Lord, in heaven your mercy and your truth up to clouds.

**Psalms 35:7**

Your righteousness like mountains of God; your judgments great deep. Men and cattle you will save, Lord.

**Psalms 35:8**

How you multiplied your mercy, God; but sons of men will hope in the shelter of your wings.

**Psalms 35:9**

They will be intoxicated from richness of your house, and you will give them drink from torrent of your delight.

**Psalms 35:10**

Because with you spring of life; in your light we will see light.

**Psalms 35:11**

Stretch out your mercy to those knowing you and your righteousness to upright in heart.

**Psalms 35:12**

Let the foot of pride not come to me, and the hand of sinners not shake me.

**Psalms 35:13**

There the workers of lawlessness fell; they were thrust out and will not be able to stand.

#### Chapter 36

**Psalms 36:1**

Of David. Do not be jealous among evildoers, nor envy those doing lawlessness,

**Psalms 36:2**

because like grass they will quickly dry up, and like green herbs they will quickly fall away.

**Psalms 36:3**

Hope upon the Lord and do kindness, and dwell in earth, and you will be shepherded upon its wealth.

**Psalms 36:4**

Take delight in the Lord, and he will give you requests of your heart.

**Psalms 36:5**

Reveal your way to the Lord and hope upon him, and he will do it.

**Psalms 36:6**

And he will bring out your righteousness like light and your judgment like noonday.

**Psalms 36:7**

Be subjected to the Lord and entreat him. Do not be jealous in one prospering in his way, in man doing lawless things.

**Psalms 36:8**

Cease from anger and leave wrath behind; do not be jealous so as to do evil.

**Psalms 36:9**

Because evildoers will be utterly destroyed, but those enduring Lord, they will inherit earth.

**Psalms 36:10**

And still a little, and sinner will by no means exist; and you will seek his place and by no means find it.

**Psalms 36:11**

But meek ones will inherit earth and take delight in the abundance of peace.

**Psalms 36:12**

The sinner will watch a righteous man and gnash his teeth upon him.

**Psalms 36:13**

But the Lord will laugh at him, because he foresees that his day will come.

**Psalms 36:14**

Sinners drew sword and stretched their bow, to cast down poor and needy, to slaughter upright in heart.

**Psalms 36:15**

Their sword may enter into their heart, and their bows may be broken.

**Psalms 36:16**

Better a little thing to the righteous man than much wealth of sinners,

**Psalms 36:17**

because the arms of sinners will be broken, but the Lord supports righteous ones.

**Psalms 36:18**

The Lord knows ways of blameless ones, and their inheritance will be into age.

**Psalms 36:19**

They will not be ashamed in evil season, and in the days of famine they will be filled.

**Psalms 36:20**

Because sinners will perish, and enemies of the Lord, when they are glorified and lifted up, failing away like smoke they failed away.

**Psalms 36:21**

The sinner borrows and will not repay, but a righteous man has compassion and gives.

**Psalms 36:22**

Because those blessing him will inherit earth, but those cursing him will be utterly destroyed.

**Psalms 36:23**

From the Lord the steps of a man are directed straight, and he will desire his way.

**Psalms 36:24**

When he falls, he will not be dashed down, because the Lord supports his hand.

**Psalms 36:25**

I became younger and indeed I grew old, and I did not see a righteous man forsaken, nor his seed seeking breads.

**Psalms 36:26**

All day he has mercy and lends, and his seed will be into blessing.

**Psalms 36:27**

Turn away from evil and do good, and dwell into age of age,

**Psalms 36:28**

because the Lord loves judgment and will not forsake his holy ones. Into age they will be guarded, but lawless men will be driven out, and the seed of ungodly men will be utterly destroyed.

**Psalms 36:29**

But righteous ones will inherit earth and dwell upon it into age of age.

**Psalms 36:30**

The mouth of a righteous man will meditate wisdom, and his tongue will speak judgment.

**Psalms 36:31**

The law of his God is in his heart, and his steps will not be tripped up.

**Psalms 36:32**

The sinner watches a righteous man and seeks to put him to death.

**Psalms 36:33**

But the Lord will by no means forsake him into his hands, nor by any means condemn him when judgment comes to him.

**Psalms 36:34**

Wait for the Lord and keep his way, and he will lift you up to inherit earth; when sinners are utterly destroyed you will see.

**Psalms 36:35**

I saw an ungodly man highly exalted and lifted up like cedars of Lebanon.

**Psalms 36:36**

And I passed by, and behold, he was not; and I sought him, and his place was not found.

**Psalms 36:37**

Guard innocence and see uprightness, because there is remnant for peaceful man.

**Psalms 36:38**

But lawless men will be utterly destroyed together; the remnants of ungodly men will be utterly destroyed.

**Psalms 36:39**

But salvation of the righteous ones is from the Lord, and he is their defender in the time of affliction.

**Psalms 36:40**

And the Lord will help them and rescue them and deliver them from sinners and save them, because they hoped upon him.

#### Chapter 37

**Psalms 37:1**

Psalm of David, for remembrance concerning Sabbath.

**Psalms 37:2**

Lord, do not reprove me in your fury, nor discipline me in your anger,

**Psalms 37:3**

because your arrows were fixed in me and you set your hand firmly upon me.

**Psalms 37:4**

There is no healing in my flesh from the face of your wrath; no peace to my bones from the face of my sins.

**Psalms 37:5**

Because my lawless acts rose above my head; like heavy burden they weighed heavily upon me.

**Psalms 37:6**

My wounds stank and rotted from the face of my foolishness.

**Psalms 37:7**

I was miserable and bent down to end; all day mourning-faced I went about.

**Psalms 37:8**

Because my loins were filled with mockings, and there is no healing in my flesh.

**Psalms 37:9**

I was afflicted and humbled beyond measure; I roared from groaning of my heart.

**Psalms 37:10**

Lord, all my desire before you, and my groaning was not hidden from you.

**Psalms 37:11**

My heart was troubled; my strength forsook me, and light of my eyes, even this not with me.

**Psalms 37:12**

My friends and my neighbors drew near opposite me and stood, and my near ones stood far off.

**Psalms 37:13**

And those seeking my soul used violence, and those seeking my evils spoke vanities and meditated deceits all day.

**Psalms 37:14**

But I like a deaf man was not hearing, and like mute not opening his mouth.

**Psalms 37:15**

And I became like a man not hearing and not having reproofs in his mouth.

**Psalms 37:16**

Because upon you, Lord, I hoped; you will hear, Lord my God.

**Psalms 37:17**

Because I said, Lest my enemies rejoice over me, and when my feet are shaken they spoke great things against me.

**Psalms 37:18**

Because I am ready for scourges, and my pain before me always.

**Psalms 37:19**

Because my lawlessness I will announce, and I will be anxious concerning my sin.

**Psalms 37:20**

But my enemies live and are stronger than I, and those hating me unjustly were multiplied.

**Psalms 37:21**

Those repaying evil for good slandered me because I pursued righteousness and cast me away, beloved one, like a dead man abhorred.

**Psalms 37:22**

Do not forsake me, Lord my God; do not stand far from me.

**Psalms 37:23**

Attend to my help, Lord of my salvation.

#### Chapter 38

**Psalms 38:1**

For end. To Jeduthun. Song of David.

**Psalms 38:2**

I said, I will guard my ways so as not to sin with my tongue; I set guard for my mouth when sinner stood opposite me.

**Psalms 38:3**

I became mute and humbled and was silent from good things, and my pain was renewed.

**Psalms 38:4**

My heart grew hot within me, and in my meditation fire will blaze; I spoke with my tongue,

**Psalms 38:5**

Make known to me, Lord, my end and number of my days, what it is, that I may know what I lack.

**Psalms 38:6**

Behold, you made my days old-span lengths, and my existence like nothing before you. Yet all things vanity, every living man. Interlude.

**Psalms 38:7**

Surely man passes by in image; yet in vain they are troubled; he stores up and does not know for whom he will gather them.

**Psalms 38:8**

And now what is my endurance? Is it not Lord? And my substance is from you.

**Psalms 38:9**

From all my lawless acts rescue me; you gave me as reproach to fool.

**Psalms 38:10**

I became mute and did not open my mouth, because you are one who made me.

**Psalms 38:11**

Remove your scourges from me; from the strength of your hand I failed away.

**Psalms 38:12**

With reproofs over lawlessness you disciplined man and melted his soul like a spider. Yet in vain every man is troubled. Interlude.

**Psalms 38:13**

Hear my prayer, Lord, and give ear to my petition. Do not be silent at my tears, because I am sojourner with you and passing resident, like all my fathers.

**Psalms 38:14**

Leave me, that I may be refreshed before I depart and no longer exist.

#### Chapter 39

**Psalms 39:1**

For end. Psalm of David.

**Psalms 39:2**

Waiting, I waited for the Lord, and he attended to me and heard my petition.

**Psalms 39:3**

And he brought me up from pit of misery and from mud of mire and set my feet upon rock and straightened my steps.

**Psalms 39:4**

And he threw into my mouth new song, hymn to our God. Many will see and fear and hope upon the Lord.

**Psalms 39:5**

Blessed is the man whose hope is the name of the Lord, and did not look toward vanities and false frenzies.

**Psalms 39:6**

Many things you did, Lord my God, your wonders; and in your reasonings there is none who will be likened to you. I declared and spoke; they were multiplied beyond number.

**Psalms 39:7**

Sacrifice and offering you did not want, but ears you fitted for me; whole burnt offering and concerning sin you did not ask.

**Psalms 39:8**

Then I said, Behold, I came. In head-roll of book it is written concerning me.

**Psalms 39:9**

To do your will, O my God, I wanted, and your law in the midst of my belly.

**Psalms 39:10**

I proclaimed righteousness in great assembly; behold, my lips I will by no means restrain. Lord, you knew.

**Psalms 39:11**

Your righteousness I did not hide in my heart; your truth and your salvation I spoke; I did not hide your mercy and your truth from great gathering.

**Psalms 39:12**

But you, Lord, do not keep your compassions far from me; your mercy and your truth always supported me.

**Psalms 39:13**

Because evils without number enclosed me; my lawless acts overtook me and I was not able to look. They were multiplied beyond hairs of my head, and my heart forsook me.

**Psalms 39:14**

Be pleased, Lord, to rescue me; Lord, attend to help me.

**Psalms 39:15**

Let those seeking my soul to take it away be ashamed and put to shame together; let those wanting evils for me turn backward and be put to shame.

**Psalms 39:16**

Let those saying to me, Good, good, carry away at once their shame.

**Psalms 39:17**

Let all seeking you rejoice and be glad upon you, Lord, and let those loving your salvation always say, Let the Lord be magnified.

**Psalms 39:18**

But I am poor and needy; The Lord will care for me. My helper and my defender are you; my God, do not delay.

#### Chapter 40

**Psalms 40:1**

For end. Psalm of David.

**Psalms 40:2**

Blessed is the one understanding concerning poor and needy man; in evil day the Lord will rescue him.

**Psalms 40:3**

The Lord guard him and make him live and bless him in earth and not hand him over into the hands of his enemy.

**Psalms 40:4**

The Lord help him upon the bed of his pain; you turned all his bed in his sickness.

**Psalms 40:5**

I said, Lord, have mercy on me; heal my soul, because I sinned against you.

**Psalms 40:6**

My enemies spoke evils to me: When will he die and his name perish?

**Psalms 40:7**

And if he entered to see, he spoke vain things; his heart gathered lawlessness to itself; he went outside and spoke.

**Psalms 40:8**

Together all my enemies whispered against me; against me they reasoned evils for me:

**Psalms 40:9**

They set lawless word against me: Will not one lying down add to rise again?

**Psalms 40:10**

And indeed man of my peace, upon whom I hoped, one eating my breads, magnified heel-tripping against me.

**Psalms 40:11**

But you, Lord, have mercy on me and raise me up, and I will repay them.

**Psalms 40:12**

In this I knew that you wanted me, because my enemy will by no means rejoice over me.

**Psalms 40:13**

But of me, because of my innocence, you took hold and established me before you into age.

**Psalms 40:14**

Blessed is the Lord God of Israel from age and into age. Let it be, let it be.

#### Chapter 41

**Psalms 41:1**

For end, for understanding, for the sons of Korah.

**Psalms 41:2**

As deer longs for springs of waters, so my soul longs for you, O God.

**Psalms 41:3**

My soul thirsted for living God; when will I come and appear before the face of God?

**Psalms 41:4**

My tears became bread to me day and night, while they say to me each day, Where is your God?

**Psalms 41:5**

These things I remembered, and I poured out my soul upon me, because I will pass through into place of wondrous tent, as far as the house of God, with the voice of exultation and confession, the sound of festival-keepers.

**Psalms 41:6**

Why are you sorrowful, my soul, and why do you trouble me? Hope upon God, because I will yet confess to him, salvation of my face, my God.

**Psalms 41:7**

Toward myself my soul was troubled; therefore I will remember you from the land of Jordan and Hermoniim, from little mountain.

**Psalms 41:8**

Abyss calls abyss at the sound of your cataracts; all your surges and your waves passed over me.

**Psalms 41:9**

By day the Lord will command his mercy, and by night his song with me, prayer to God of my life.

**Psalms 41:10**

I will say to God, my supporter, Why did you forget me? Why do I go gloomy when enemy afflicts me?

**Psalms 41:11**

When my bones were crushed, those afflicting me reproached me, while they say to me each day, Where is your God?

**Psalms 41:12**

Why are you sorrowful, my soul, and why do you trouble me? Hope upon God, because I will yet confess to him, salvation of my face, my God.

#### Chapter 42

**Psalms 42:1**

Psalm of David. Judge me, O God, and judge my case from nation not holy; from unjust and deceitful man rescue me.

**Psalms 42:2**

Because you are God, my strength. Why did you reject me? Why do I go gloomy when enemy afflicts me?

**Psalms 42:3**

Send out your light and your truth; they guided me and brought me to your holy mountain and to your tabernacles.

**Psalms 42:4**

And I will go in to the altar of God, to God gladdening my youth; I will confess to you with harp, O God, my God.

**Psalms 42:5**

Why are you sorrowful, my soul, and why do you trouble me? Hope upon God, because I will yet confess to him, salvation of my face, my God.

#### Chapter 43

**Psalms 43:1**

For end, for the sons of Korah, for understanding, psalm.

**Psalms 43:2**

O God, with our ears we heard; our fathers told us work you worked in their days, in ancient days.

**Psalms 43:3**

Your hand destroyed nations, and you planted them; you afflicted peoples and cast them out.

**Psalms 43:4**

Because not by their sword did they inherit land, and their arm did not save them, but your right hand and your arm and light of your face, because you took pleasure in them.

**Psalms 43:5**

You are same my king and my God, one commanding salvations of Jacob.

**Psalms 43:6**

In you we will gore our enemies, and in your name we will despise those rising against us.

**Psalms 43:7**

Because not in my bow will I hope, and my sword will not save me.

**Psalms 43:8**

Because you saved us from those afflicting us, and those hating us you shamed.

**Psalms 43:9**

In God we will boast whole day, and in your name we will confess forever. Interlude.

**Psalms 43:10**

But now you rejected and shamed us, and you will not go out with our powers.

**Psalms 43:11**

You turned us back before our enemies, and those hating us plundered for themselves.

**Psalms 43:12**

You gave us like sheep for food, and among nations you scattered us.

**Psalms 43:13**

You sold your people without price, and there was no multitude in their exchanges.

**Psalms 43:14**

You made us reproach to our neighbors, mockery and derision to those around us.

**Psalms 43:15**

You made us proverb among nations, shaking of head among peoples.

**Psalms 43:16**

Whole day my shame before me, and shame of my face covered me,

**Psalms 43:17**

from the voice of reproacher and slanderer, from the face of enemy and pursuer.

**Psalms 43:18**

All these things came upon us, and we did not forget you, and we did not act unjustly in your covenant.

**Psalms 43:19**

And our heart did not turn back, and you turned our paths aside from your way,

**Psalms 43:20**

because you humbled us in place of affliction, and the shadow of death covered us.

**Psalms 43:21**

If we forgot name of our God and stretched out our hands to strange god,

**Psalms 43:22**

will not God seek these things out? For he knows hidden things of heart.

**Psalms 43:23**

Because for your sake we are put to death whole day; we were counted as sheep of slaughter.

**Psalms 43:24**

Awake. Why do you sleep, Lord? Rise up and do not reject to end.

**Psalms 43:25**

Why do you turn away your face, forgetting our poverty and our affliction?

**Psalms 43:26**

Because our soul was humbled into dust; our belly clung to earth.

**Psalms 43:27**

Rise up, Lord, help us, and redeem us for the sake of your name.

#### Chapter 44

**Psalms 44:1**

For end, concerning those to be changed, for the sons of Korah, for understanding, song concerning beloved.

**Psalms 44:2**

My heart poured forth good word; I speak my works to the king; my tongue reed of swift-writing scribe.

**Psalms 44:3**

Beautiful in form beyond sons of men; grace was poured upon your lips; therefore God blessed you forever.

**Psalms 44:4**

Gird your sword upon thigh, mighty one, in your beauty and your loveliness.

**Psalms 44:5**

And draw, and prosper, and reign, because of truth and meekness and righteousness, and your right hand will guide you wondrously.

**Psalms 44:6**

Your arrows sharpened, mighty one; peoples will fall under you, in the heart of enemies of the king.

**Psalms 44:7**

Your throne, O God, forever and ever; rod of uprightness rod of your kingdom.

**Psalms 44:8**

You loved righteousness and hated lawlessness; therefore God, your God, anointed you with the oil of exultation beyond your companions.

**Psalms 44:9**

Myrrh and stacte and cassia from your garments, from ivory palaces from which they gladdened you.

**Psalms 44:10**

Daughters of kings in your honor; queen stood at your right hand, clothed in gold-woven garments, adorned with many colors.

**Psalms 44:11**

Hear, daughter, and see, and incline your ear, and forget your people and house of your father,

**Psalms 44:12**

because the king desired your beauty, because he is your lord.

**Psalms 44:13**

And daughters of Tyre will worship him with gifts; rich ones of the people will entreat your face.

**Psalms 44:14**

All glory of daughter of the king within, clothed in golden fringes, adorned with many colors.

**Psalms 44:15**

Virgins after her will be brought to the king; her companions will be brought to you.

**Psalms 44:16**

They will be brought in gladness and exultation; they will be led into the temple of the king.

**Psalms 44:17**

In place of your fathers sons were born to you; you will appoint them rulers over all the earth.

**Psalms 44:18**

They will remember your name in every generation and generation; therefore peoples will confess to you forever, even forever and ever.

#### Chapter 45

**Psalms 45:1**

For end, for the sons of Korah, concerning hidden things, psalm.

**Psalms 45:2**

God ours refuge and strength, helper in afflictions that found us greatly.

**Psalms 45:3**

Therefore we will not fear when earth is shaken and mountains are shifted into hearts of seas.

**Psalms 45:4**

Their waters roared and were troubled; mountains were troubled by his might. Interlude.

**Psalms 45:5**

Rushings of the river gladden the city of God; Most High sanctified his dwelling.

**Psalms 45:6**

God is in the midst of her; she will not be shaken. God will help her toward morning.

**Psalms 45:7**

Nations were troubled, kingdoms bowed; he gave his voice, earth was shaken.

**Psalms 45:8**

The Lord of hosts is with us; our supporter God of Jacob. Interlude.

**Psalms 45:9**

Come, see works of the Lord, what wonders he set upon earth,

**Psalms 45:10**

doing away wars to the ends of the earth. He will break bow and shatter weapon and burn shields in fire.

**Psalms 45:11**

Be still and know that I am God; I will be exalted among nations, I will be exalted in earth.

**Psalms 45:12**

The Lord of hosts is with us; our supporter God of Jacob.

#### Chapter 46

**Psalms 46:1**

For end, for the sons of Korah, psalm.

**Psalms 46:2**

All nations, clap hands; shout to God with the voice of exultation.

**Psalms 46:3**

Because the Lord Most High is fearsome, a great king over all the earth.

**Psalms 46:4**

He subjected peoples to us and nations under our feet.

**Psalms 46:5**

He chose for us his inheritance, beauty of Jacob which he loved. Interlude.

**Psalms 46:6**

God went up with a shout, the Lord with the voice of a trumpet.

**Psalms 46:7**

Sing to our God, sing; sing to our king, sing.

**Psalms 46:8**

Because God king of all the earth, sing with understanding.

**Psalms 46:9**

God reigned over nations; God sits upon his holy throne.

**Psalms 46:10**

The rulers of peoples gathered with the God of Abraham, because the mighty ones of the earth belong to God; they were greatly exalted.

#### Chapter 47

**Psalms 47:1**

Psalm of song for the sons of Korah, second of Sabbath.

**Psalms 47:2**

Great is the Lord and greatly praised in the city of our God, his holy mountain,

**Psalms 47:3**

well-rooted, joy of all the earth. Mounts of Zion, sides of north, city of great king.

**Psalms 47:4**

God in her citadels is known when he takes hold of her.

**Psalms 47:5**

Because behold, kings gathered; they came together.

**Psalms 47:6**

They, seeing thus, were astonished, were troubled, were shaken.

**Psalms 47:7**

Trembling seized them there, pangs as of a woman giving birth.

**Psalms 47:8**

With violent wind you will shatter ships of Tarshish.

**Psalms 47:9**

As we heard, so we saw in the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God; God founded her forever. Interlude.

**Psalms 47:10**

We received, O God, your mercy in the midst of your temple.

**Psalms 47:11**

According to your name, O God, so also your praise to the ends of the earth; your right hand full of righteousness.

**Psalms 47:12**

Let Mount Zion rejoice; let daughters of Judah exult because of your judgments, Lord.

**Psalms 47:13**

Encircle Zion and surround her; tell in her towers.

**Psalms 47:14**

Set your hearts on her power and pass through her citadels, so that you may tell to another generation.

**Psalms 47:15**

Because this is God, our God forever and ever; he will shepherd us forever.

#### Chapter 48

**Psalms 48:1**

For end, for the sons of Korah, psalm.

**Psalms 48:2**

Hear these things, all nations; give ear, all inhabiting world,

**Psalms 48:3**

both earthborn and sons of men together, rich and poor.

**Psalms 48:4**

My mouth will speak wisdom, and meditation of my heart understanding.

**Psalms 48:5**

I will incline my ear into parable; I will open my riddle on harp.

**Psalms 48:6**

Why do I fear in evil day? Lawlessness of my heel will surround me,

**Psalms 48:7**

those trusting in their strength and boasting in the abundance of their wealth.

**Psalms 48:8**

Brother is not redeemed; will man redeem? He will not give to God his atonement,

**Psalms 48:9**

even price of redemption of his soul,

**Psalms 48:10**

and he labored forever, and he will live to end. He will not see corruption when he sees wise men dying.

**Psalms 48:11**

Together fool and senseless will perish and leave their wealth to strangers.

**Psalms 48:12**

And their graves their houses forever, their dwellings from generation to generation; they called their names upon their lands.

**Psalms 48:13**

But man in honor did not understand; he was compared with mindless cattle and was made like them.

**Psalms 48:14**

This way of theirs stumbling-block to them, and after these things they will delight in their mouth. Interlude.

**Psalms 48:15**

Like sheep they were set in Hades; death will shepherd them, and upright ones will lord over them in morning, and their help will grow old in Hades, away from their glory.

**Psalms 48:16**

But God will redeem my soul from the hand of Hades when he receives me. Interlude.

**Psalms 48:17**

Do not fear when man becomes rich and glory of his house is multiplied,

**Psalms 48:18**

because when he dies he will take nothing; his glory will not go down with him.

**Psalms 48:19**

Because his soul in his life will be blessed; he will confess to you when you do good to him.

**Psalms 48:20**

He will go in as far as generation of his fathers; forever he will not see light.

**Psalms 48:21**

Man in honor did not understand; he was compared with mindless cattle and was made like them.

#### Chapter 49

**Psalms 49:1**

Psalm of Asaph. The God of gods, the Lord, spoke and called earth from the rising of sun to its setting.

**Psalms 49:2**

Out of Zion comeliness of his beauty; God will come openly.

**Psalms 49:3**

Our God will come and will not keep silent; fire before him will burn, and around him storm exceedingly.

**Psalms 49:4**

He will call heaven above and earth to judge his people.

**Psalms 49:5**

Gather to him his holy ones, those making his covenant upon sacrifices.

**Psalms 49:6**

And heavens will declare his righteousness, because God is judge. Interlude.

**Psalms 49:7**

Hear, my people, and I will speak to you; Israel, and I will testify to you: God, your God, am I.

**Psalms 49:8**

Not concerning your sacrifices will I rebuke you, and your whole burnt offerings are before me continually.

**Psalms 49:9**

I will not receive calves from your house, nor he-goats from your flocks,

**Psalms 49:10**

because all wild animals of the forest are mine, cattle on mountains and oxen.

**Psalms 49:11**

I knew all birds of heaven, and beauty of field with me.

**Psalms 49:12**

If I hunger, I will not tell you, because inhabited world is mine and its fullness.

**Psalms 49:13**

Will I eat flesh of bulls, or drink blood of goats?

**Psalms 49:14**

Sacrifice to God sacrifice of praise, and pay to Most High your vows.

**Psalms 49:15**

And call upon me in the day of affliction, and I will deliver you, and you will glorify me. Interlude.

**Psalms 49:16**

But to sinner God said, Why do you recount my righteous acts and take up my covenant in your mouth,

**Psalms 49:17**

but you hated instruction and cast my words behind you?

**Psalms 49:18**

If you saw thief, you ran with him, and with adulterers you set your share.

**Psalms 49:19**

Your mouth abounded in evil, and your tongue wove deceit.

**Psalms 49:20**

Sitting, you spoke against your brother, and against son of your mother you set stumbling-block.

**Psalms 49:21**

These things you did, and I kept silent. You supposed lawlessness, that I would be like you. I will rebuke you and set them before your face.

**Psalms 49:22**

Understand these things, you forgetting God, lest he seize, and there be none rescuing.

**Psalms 49:23**

A sacrifice of praise will glorify me, and there is way by which I will show him salvation of God.

#### Chapter 50

**Psalms 50:1**

For end. Psalm of David.

**Psalms 50:2**

When Nathan the prophet came to him, when he went in to Beersheba.

**Psalms 50:3**

Have mercy on me, O God, according to your great mercy, and according to the multitude of your compassions blot out my lawlessness.

**Psalms 50:4**

Wash me more and more from my lawlessness and cleanse me from my sin,

**Psalms 50:5**

because I know my lawlessness, and my sin before me continually.

**Psalms 50:6**

Against you only I sinned and did evil before you, so that you may be justified in your words and prevail when you are judged.

**Psalms 50:7**

For behold, in lawlessnesses I was conceived, and in sins my mother conceived me.

**Psalms 50:8**

For behold, you loved truth; hidden and secret things of your wisdom you showed me.

**Psalms 50:9**

You will sprinkle me with hyssop, and I will be cleansed; you will wash me, and beyond snow I will be whitened.

**Psalms 50:10**

You will make me hear exultation and gladness; humbled bones will exult.

**Psalms 50:11**

Turn your face away from my sins, and blot out all my lawlessnesses.

**Psalms 50:12**

Create in me clean heart, O God, and renew right spirit in my inward parts.

**Psalms 50:13**

Do not cast me away from your face, and do not take your Holy Spirit from me.

**Psalms 50:14**

Restore to me exultation of your salvation, and strengthen me with guiding spirit.

**Psalms 50:15**

I will teach lawless ones your ways, and ungodly ones will turn back to you.

**Psalms 50:16**

Rescue me from bloodguilt, O God, God of my salvation; my tongue will exult in your righteousness.

**Psalms 50:17**

Lord, you will open my lips, and my mouth will declare your praise.

**Psalms 50:18**

Because if you wanted sacrifice, I would give it; in whole burnt offerings you will not delight.

**Psalms 50:19**

Sacrifice to God crushed spirit; crushed and humbled heart God will not despise.

**Psalms 50:20**

Do good, Lord, in your good pleasure to Zion, and let walls of Jerusalem be built.

**Psalms 50:21**

Then you will delight in sacrifice of righteousness, offering and whole burnt offerings; then they will offer calves upon your altar.

#### Chapter 51

**Psalms 51:1**

For end. For understanding. Of David.

**Psalms 51:2**

When Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul and said to him, David came into the house of Abimelech.

**Psalms 51:3**

Why do you boast in evil, mighty one, in lawlessness whole day?

**Psalms 51:4**
