Your tongue devised injustice; like sharpened razor you worked deceit.

**Psalms 51:5**

You loved evil beyond goodness, injustice beyond speaking righteousness. Interlude.

**Psalms 51:6**

You loved all words of engulfing, a deceitful tongue.

**Psalms 51:7**

Therefore God will tear you down to end; may he pluck you out and remove you from tent, and your root from the land of living. Interlude.

**Psalms 51:8**

And righteous ones will see and fear, and over him they will laugh and say,

**Psalms 51:9**

Behold man who did not make God his helper, but hoped in the multitude of his wealth and was strengthened in his vanity.

**Psalms 51:10**

But I like a fruitful olive tree in the house of God; I hoped in the mercy of God forever and forever of forever.

**Psalms 51:11**

I will confess to you forever, because you did it, and I will wait for your name, because good before your holy ones.

#### Chapter 52

**Psalms 52:1**

For end, concerning Mahalath. For understanding. Of David.

**Psalms 52:2**

The fool said in his heart, There is no God. They were corrupted and became abominable in lawlessnesses; there is none doing good.

**Psalms 52:3**

God looked down from heaven upon the sons of men to see whether there is one understanding or seeking God.

**Psalms 52:4**

All turned aside; together they became worthless; there is none doing good, there is not even one.

**Psalms 52:5**

Will not all workers of lawlessness know, those eating my people as eating bread? They did not call upon God.

**Psalms 52:6**

**Psalms 52:7**

Who will give out of Zion salvation of Israel? When the Lord turns back captivity of his people, Jacob will exult and Israel will rejoice.

#### Chapter 53

**Psalms 53:1**

For end, in hymns. For understanding. Of David.

**Psalms 53:2**

When Ziphites came and said to Saul, Is not David hidden among us?

**Psalms 53:3**

O God, in your name save me, and in your power judge me.

**Psalms 53:4**

O God, hear my prayer; give ear to the words of my mouth.

**Psalms 53:5**

Because strangers rose up against me, and strong men sought my soul; they did not set God before them. Interlude.

**Psalms 53:6**

For behold, God helps me, and the Lord supporter of my soul.

**Psalms 53:7**

He will turn evils back on my enemies; in your truth destroy them.

**Psalms 53:8**

Willingly I will sacrifice to you; I will confess your name, Lord, because good,

**Psalms 53:9**

#### Chapter 54

**Psalms 54:1**

For end, in hymns. For understanding. Of David.

**Psalms 54:2**

Give ear, O God, to my prayer, and do not overlook my supplication.

**Psalms 54:3**

Attend to me and hear me; I was grieved in my musing and was troubled

**Psalms 54:4**

from the voice of enemy and from the affliction of sinner, because they bent lawlessness upon me and in wrath were enraged against me.

**Psalms 54:5**

My heart was troubled in me, and dread of death fell upon me.

**Psalms 54:6**

Fear and trembling came upon me, and darkness covered me.

**Psalms 54:7**

And I said, Who will give me wings like a dove, and I will fly away and be at rest?

**Psalms 54:8**

Behold, I went far away in fleeing and lodged in the wilderness. Interlude.

**Psalms 54:9**

I waited for one saving me from faintheartedness and storm.

**Psalms 54:10**

Drown them, Lord, and divide their tongues, because I saw lawlessness and contradiction in the city.

**Psalms 54:11**

Day and night it will encircle her upon her walls; lawlessness and labor in the midst of her,

**Psalms 54:12**

and injustice. And usury and deceit did not fail from her squares.

**Psalms 54:13**

Because if enemy reproached me, I would bear it; and if one hating me spoke great words against me, I would hide from him.

**Psalms 54:14**

But you, man equal-souled, my guide and my acquaintance,

**Psalms 54:15**

who together with me sweetened foods; in the house of God we walked in concord.

**Psalms 54:16**

Let death come upon them, and let them go down living to Hades, because evils in their dwellings, in the midst of them.

**Psalms 54:17**

But I cried to God, and the Lord heard me.

**Psalms 54:18**

Evening and morning and midday I will tell and declare, and he will hear my voice.

**Psalms 54:19**

He will redeem my soul in peace from those drawing near to me, because among many they were with me.

**Psalms 54:20**

God will hear and humble them, he who exists before ages. Interlude. Because there is no change for them, and they did not fear God.

**Psalms 54:21**

He stretched out his hand in repaying; they profaned his covenant.

**Psalms 54:22**

They were divided by wrath of his face, and his heart drew near. His words were softened beyond oil, and they are darts.

**Psalms 54:23**

Cast your care upon the Lord, and he will sustain you; he will not give shaking to a righteous one forever.

**Psalms 54:24**

But you, O God, will bring them down into the pit of corruption; men of bloods and deceit will not halve their days, but I will hope upon you, Lord.

#### Chapter 55

**Psalms 55:1**

For end, concerning people removed far from holy places. Of David, for inscription, when Philistines seized him in Gath.

**Psalms 55:2**

Have mercy on me, Lord, because man trampled me; whole day, warring, he afflicted me.

**Psalms 55:3**

My enemies trampled me whole day, because many warring against me from height.

**Psalms 55:4**

In day I fear, I will hope upon you.

**Psalms 55:5**

In God I will praise my words; whole day in God I hoped; I will not fear what flesh will do to me.

**Psalms 55:6**

Whole day they were abhorring my words; all their thoughts against me for evil.

**Psalms 55:7**

They will dwell as strangers and hide themselves; they will watch my heel, just as they waited for my soul.

**Psalms 55:8**

For the sake of nothing will you save them? In wrath you will bring down peoples, O God.

**Psalms 55:9**

My life I told to you; set my tears before you, as also in your promise.

**Psalms 55:10**

My enemies will turn back in whatever day I call on you; behold, I knew that you are my God.

**Psalms 55:11**

In God I will praise word; in the Lord I will praise saying.

**Psalms 55:12**

In God I hoped; I will not fear what man will do to me.

**Psalms 55:13**

In me, O God, are vows; I will repay praises to you,

**Psalms 55:14**

because you rescued my soul from death and my feet from slipping, so that I may be well-pleasing before God in the light of living ones.

#### Chapter 56

**Psalms 56:1**

For end, do not destroy. Of David, for inscription, when he fled from the face of Saul into cave.

**Psalms 56:2**

Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy on me, because my soul has trusted in you, and in the shadow of your wings I will hope until lawlessness passes by.

**Psalms 56:3**

I will cry to God Most High, to God who benefited me.

**Psalms 56:4**

He sent from heaven and saved me; he gave reproach to those trampling me. Interlude. God sent his mercy and his truth.

**Psalms 56:5**

And he rescued my soul from the midst of lion-cubs. I slept troubled. Sons of men: their teeth weapon and arrows, and their tongue sharp sword.

**Psalms 56:6**

Be exalted above heavens, O God, and over all the earth your glory.

**Psalms 56:7**

They prepared snare for my feet and bent down my soul; they dug pit before my face and fell into it. Interlude.

**Psalms 56:8**

Ready my heart, O God, ready my heart; I will sing and make melody.

**Psalms 56:9**

Awake, my glory; awake, harp and lyre; I will awake at dawn.

**Psalms 56:10**

I will confess to you among peoples, Lord; I will sing to you among nations.

**Psalms 56:11**

Because your mercy was magnified unto heavens and your truth unto clouds.

**Psalms 56:12**

Be exalted above heavens, O God, and over all the earth your glory.

#### Chapter 57

**Psalms 57:1**

For end, do not destroy. Of David, for inscription.

**Psalms 57:2**

If truly indeed you speak righteousness, judge straight things, sons of men.

**Psalms 57:3**

For even in heart you work lawlessnesses; in earth your hands weave together injustice.

**Psalms 57:4**

Sinners were estranged from womb, they went astray from belly, they spoke lies.

**Psalms 57:5**

Their fury according to the likeness of serpent, like a deaf asp stopping its ears,

**Psalms 57:6**

which will not hear the voice of charmers, of drug mixed by wise enchanter.

**Psalms 57:7**

God shattered their teeth in their mouth; The Lord crushed fangs of lions.

**Psalms 57:8**

They will be despised like water passing by; he will bend his bow until they grow weak.

**Psalms 57:9**

Like wax melting they will be done away; fire fell, and they did not see sun.

**Psalms 57:10**

Before your thorns understand bramble, as living ones, as in wrath, he will swallow you up.

**Psalms 57:11**

The righteous one will rejoice when he sees vengeance of the ungodly; he will wash his hands in the blood of sinner.

**Psalms 57:12**

And man will say, Then there is fruit for righteous one; then there is God judging them in earth.

#### Chapter 58

**Psalms 58:1**

For end, do not destroy. Of David, for inscription, when Saul sent and watched his house to kill him.

**Psalms 58:2**

Rescue me from my enemies, O God, and redeem me from those rising against me.

**Psalms 58:3**

Deliver me from those working lawlessness, and save me from the men of bloods.

**Psalms 58:4**

Because behold, they hunted my soul; strong men attacked me, neither my lawlessness nor my sin, Lord.

**Psalms 58:5**

Without lawlessness I ran and went straight; awake to meet me and see.

**Psalms 58:6**

And you, Lord God of hosts, God of Israel, attend to visit all nations; do not pity all workers of lawlessness. Interlude.

**Psalms 58:7**

They will return at evening and hunger like a dog and encircle city.

**Psalms 58:8**

Behold, they will utter with their mouth, and sword on their lips, because who heard?

**Psalms 58:9**

But you, Lord, will laugh at them; you will despise all nations.

**Psalms 58:10**

My strength, toward you I will keep watch, because God my supporter.

**Psalms 58:11**

My God, his mercy will go before me; God will show me among my enemies.

**Psalms 58:12**

Do not kill them, lest they forget my people. Scatter them in your power and bring them down, my defender, Lord.

**Psalms 58:13**

Sin of their mouth, word of their lips. Let them be caught in their pride, and from curse and lie they will be proclaimed in endings.

**Psalms 58:14**

In wrath of ending, and they will be no more; and they will know that God rules Jacob to the ends of the earth. Interlude.

**Psalms 58:15**

They will return at evening and hunger like a dog and encircle city.

**Psalms 58:16**

They will be scattered to eat; if they are not filled, they will also grumble.

**Psalms 58:17**

But I will sing of your power and exult in morning in your mercy, because you became my supporter and refuge in the day of my affliction.

**Psalms 58:18**

My helper, to you I will sing, because God my supporter, my God, my mercy.

#### Chapter 59

**Psalms 59:1**

For end, concerning those to be changed, yet for inscription, of David, for teaching.

**Psalms 59:2**

When he burned Mesopotamia of Syria and Syria of Zobah, and Joab returned and struck valley of salt, twelve thousand.

**Psalms 59:3**

O God, you rejected us and pulled us down; you were angry and had compassion on us.

**Psalms 59:4**

You shook earth and troubled it; heal its fractures, because it was shaken.

**Psalms 59:5**

You showed your people hard things; you made us drink wine of staggering.

**Psalms 59:6**

You gave signal to those fearing you, to flee from the face of bow. Interlude.

**Psalms 59:7**

So that your beloved ones may be rescued, save with your right hand and hear me.

**Psalms 59:8**

God spoke in his holy place: I will exult and divide Shechem, and valley of tents I will measure out.

**Psalms 59:9**

Gilead mine and Manasseh mine, and Ephraim strength of my head, Judah my king.

**Psalms 59:10**

Moab cauldron of my hope; upon Edom I will stretch out my sandal; foreigners were subjected to me.

**Psalms 59:11**

Who will bring me into fortified city? Who will guide me as far as Edom?

**Psalms 59:12**

Is it not you, O God, who rejected us? And God will not go out in our powers.

**Psalms 59:13**

Give us help out of affliction, because salvation of man is vain.

**Psalms 59:14**

In God we will do mighty deed, and he will despise those afflicting us.

#### Chapter 60

**Psalms 60:1**

For end, in hymns. Of David.

**Psalms 60:2**

Hear, O God, my supplication; attend to my prayer.

**Psalms 60:3**

From the ends of the earth I cried to you when my heart grew faint; on rock you lifted me up.

**Psalms 60:4**

You guided me, because you became my hope, tower of strength from the face of enemy.

**Psalms 60:5**

I will sojourn in your tent forever; I will be sheltered in cover of your wings. Interlude.

**Psalms 60:6**

Because you, God, heard my vows; you gave inheritance to those fearing your name.

**Psalms 60:7**

Days upon days of the king you will add; his years until days of generation and generation.

**Psalms 60:8**

He remains forever before God; his mercy and truth, who will seek out?

**Psalms 60:9**

Thus I will sing to your name forever and forever, to pay my vows day from day.

#### Chapter 61

**Psalms 61:1**

For end, concerning Jeduthun. Psalm of David.

**Psalms 61:2**

Will not my soul be subjected to God? For from him my salvation.

**Psalms 61:3**

For he my God and my savior, my supporter; I will not be shaken much.

**Psalms 61:4**

How long do you attack man? You all murder, like leaning wall and thrust fence.

**Psalms 61:5**

Only my honor they planned to cast away; they ran in lie. With their mouth they blessed and with their heart they cursed. Interlude.

**Psalms 61:6**

Only be subjected to God, my soul, because from him my endurance.

**Psalms 61:7**

Because he my God and savior, my supporter; I will not be moved away.

**Psalms 61:8**

Upon God my salvation and my glory, God of my help and my hope upon God.

**Psalms 61:9**

Hope upon him, every assembly of the people; pour out your hearts before him; God our helper. Interlude.

**Psalms 61:10**

But vain sons of men, false sons of men, in balances to do injustice; they together from vanity.

**Psalms 61:11**

Do not hope in injustice, and do not desire plunder; if wealth flows, do not set heart on it.

**Psalms 61:12**

Once God spoke; these two things I heard:

**Psalms 61:13**

because strength belongs to God, and to you, Lord, mercy, because you will repay each one according to his works.

#### Chapter 62

**Psalms 62:1**

Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah.

**Psalms 62:2**

O God, my God, to you I rise early. My soul thirsted for you; how much my flesh also for you, in a desert and trackless and waterless land.

**Psalms 62:3**

Thus in holy place I appeared to you, to see your power and your glory.

**Psalms 62:4**

Because your mercy better than lives; my lips will praise you.

**Psalms 62:5**

Thus I will bless you in my life; in your name I will lift my hands.

**Psalms 62:6**

Let my soul be filled as with fat and richness, and with lips of exultation my mouth will praise you.

**Psalms 62:7**

If I remembered you upon my bed, at dawns I meditated on you.

**Psalms 62:8**

Because you became my helper, and in the shelter of your wings I will exult.

**Psalms 62:9**

My soul clung after you; your right hand took hold of me.

**Psalms 62:10**

But they in vain sought my soul; they will enter into lowest parts of earth.

**Psalms 62:11**

They will be handed over into the hands of sword; they will be portions for foxes.

**Psalms 62:12**

But the king will rejoice in God; everyone swearing by him will be praised, because mouth of those speaking unjust things was stopped.

#### Chapter 63

**Psalms 63:1**

For end. Psalm of David.

**Psalms 63:2**

Hear, O God, my voice in my supplication; from fear of enemy rescue my soul.

**Psalms 63:3**

You sheltered me from conspiracy of evil-doers, from the multitude of workers of lawlessness,

**Psalms 63:4**

who sharpened their tongues like a sword, bent their bow, bitter thing,

**Psalms 63:5**

to shoot blameless one in secret places. Suddenly they will shoot him and will not fear.

**Psalms 63:6**

They strengthened for themselves evil word; they told of hiding snares. They said, Who will see them?

**Psalms 63:7**

They searched out lawlessnesses; they failed, searching out searchings. Man will come near, and heart deep.

**Psalms 63:8**

And God will be exalted; arrows of infants were their wounds.

**Psalms 63:9**

And their tongues grew weak against them; all seeing them were troubled.

**Psalms 63:10**

And every man feared, and they declared works of God and understood his deeds.

**Psalms 63:11**

The righteous one will rejoice in the Lord and hope upon him, and all straight in heart will be praised.

#### Chapter 64

**Psalms 64:1**

For end. Psalm of David. Song of Jeremiah and Ezekiel from word of the sojourning when they were about to go out.

**Psalms 64:2**

Hymn fits you, O God, in Zion, and vow will be paid to you in Jerusalem.

**Psalms 64:3**

Hear my prayer; to you all flesh will come.

**Psalms 64:4**

The words of lawless men overpowered us, and our ungodlinesses you will propitiate.

**Psalms 64:5**

Blessed is the one whom you chose and took to yourself; he will dwell in your courts. We will be filled with good things of your house; holy is your temple, wondrous in righteousness.

**Psalms 64:6**

Hear us, God our savior, hope of all ends of the earth and of those far off in sea,

**Psalms 64:7**

preparing mountains in his strength, girded about in dominion,

**Psalms 64:8**

troubling depth of sea, the sound of its waves. Nations will be troubled.

**Psalms 64:9**

And those inhabiting ends will fear at your signs; goings out of morning and evening you will gladden.

**Psalms 64:10**

You visited earth and made it drunk; you multiplied to enrich it. The river of God was filled with waters; you prepared their food, because thus your preparation.

**Psalms 64:11**

Make her furrows drunk; multiply her produce; in its drops that springing thing will rejoice.

**Psalms 64:12**

You will bless crown of year of your goodness, and your plains will be filled with richness.

**Psalms 64:13**

The beauties of the wilderness will grow fat, and the hills will gird themselves with exultation.

**Psalms 64:14**

Rams of sheep clothed themselves, and valleys will multiply grain; they will cry out, yes, they will sing hymns.

#### Chapter 65

**Psalms 65:1**

For end. Song of psalm of resurrection. Shout to God, all the earth.

**Psalms 65:2**

Sing indeed to his name; give glory to his praise.

**Psalms 65:3**

Say to God, How fearful your works. In the multitude of your power your enemies will lie to you.

**Psalms 65:4**

Let all the earth worship you and sing to you; let them sing to your name. Interlude.

**Psalms 65:5**

Come and see works of God, fearful in counsels beyond sons of men,

**Psalms 65:6**

who turns sea into dry land; in the river they will pass through on foot; there we will rejoice in him,

**Psalms 65:7**

the one ruling in his dominion forever. His eyes look upon nations; those provoking must not exalt themselves. Interlude.

**Psalms 65:8**

Bless our God, nations, and make voice of his praise heard,

**Psalms 65:9**

who set my soul into life and did not give my feet to shaking.

**Psalms 65:10**

Because you tested us, O God; you purified us as silver is purified.

**Psalms 65:11**

You brought us into snare; you laid afflictions upon our back.

**Psalms 65:12**

You made men ride upon our heads; we went through fire and water, and you brought us out into refreshment.

**Psalms 65:13**

I will enter into your house with whole burnt offerings; I will pay you my vows,

**Psalms 65:14**

which my lips uttered and my mouth spoke in my affliction.

**Psalms 65:15**

Fattened whole burnt offerings I will offer to you with incense and rams; I will offer oxen with he-goats. Interlude.

**Psalms 65:16**

Come, hear, and I will tell, all fearing God, whatever he did for my soul.

**Psalms 65:17**

To him with my mouth I cried, and I exalted under my tongue.

**Psalms 65:18**

If I saw injustice in my heart, let not the Lord hear me.

**Psalms 65:19**

Therefore God heard me; he attended to the voice of my supplication.

**Psalms 65:20**

Blessed be God, who did not turn away my prayer and his mercy from me.

#### Chapter 66

**Psalms 66:1**

For end, in hymns. Psalm of song.

**Psalms 66:2**

May God have compassion on us and bless us; may he make his face shine upon us. Interlude.

**Psalms 66:3**

So as to know your way in earth, your salvation among all nations.

**Psalms 66:4**

Let peoples confess to you, O God; let all peoples confess to you.

**Psalms 66:5**

Let nations rejoice and exult, because you judge peoples in uprightness and will guide nations upon earth. Interlude.

**Psalms 66:6**

Let peoples confess to you, O God; let all peoples confess to you.

**Psalms 66:7**

Earth gave her fruit; may God, our God, bless us.

**Psalms 66:8**

May God bless us, and let all ends of the earth fear him.

#### Chapter 67

**Psalms 67:1**

For end. Of David. Psalm of song.

**Psalms 67:2**

Let God arise, and let his enemies be scattered, and let those hating him flee from before him.

**Psalms 67:3**

As smoke fails, let them fail; as wax melts from the face of fire, so let sinners perish from the face of God.

**Psalms 67:4**

But let righteous ones rejoice; let them exult before God; let them delight in gladness.

**Psalms 67:5**

Sing to God, make melody to his name; make way for one riding upon westlands. The Lord is his name, and exult before him; they will be troubled from before his face,

**Psalms 67:6**

father of orphans and judge of widows, God in his holy place.

**Psalms 67:7**

God settles solitary ones in a house, bringing out chained ones in manliness, likewise those provoking, those dwelling in tombs.

**Psalms 67:8**

O God, when you go out before your people, when you pass through wilderness. Interlude.

**Psalms 67:9**

Earth was shaken, for even heavens dripped from the face of God, this Sinai, from the face of God of Israel.

**Psalms 67:10**

You will set apart willing rain, O God, for your inheritance; and it grew weak, but you restored it.

**Psalms 67:11**

Your living creatures dwell in it; in your goodness you prepared for the poor one, O God.

**Psalms 67:12**

The Lord will give word to those bringing good news with much power.

**Psalms 67:13**

King of forces of beloved one, and in beauty of the house to divide spoils.

**Psalms 67:14**

If you sleep between the lots, wings of dove silvered, and her back parts in green sheen of gold. Interlude.

**Psalms 67:15**

When heavenly one scatters kings upon her, they will be snow-white in Zalmon.

**Psalms 67:16**

The mountain of God, rich mountain; curdled mountain, rich mountain.

**Psalms 67:17**

Why do you suppose, curdled mountains, mountain in which God delighted to dwell? And indeed the Lord will tabernacle to end.

**Psalms 67:18**

Chariot of God ten-thousandfold, thousands prospering; Lord among them in Sinai, in holy place.

**Psalms 67:19**

You went up on high, you led captivity captive; you received gifts in man, for even disobedient ones, for the Lord God to dwell. Blessed.

**Psalms 67:20**

Blessed is the Lord day by day; the God of our salvations will make a straight way for us. Interlude.

**Psalms 67:21**

Our God is God of saving, and exits from death belong to the Lord, Lord.

**Psalms 67:22**

But God will crush heads of his enemies, hairy crown of those going on in their trespasses.

**Psalms 67:23**

The Lord said, From Bashan I will turn back, I will turn back in the depths of sea,

**Psalms 67:24**

so that your foot may be dipped in blood, tongue of your dogs from enemies, from him.

**Psalms 67:25**

Your goings were seen, O God, goings of my God, my king, in holy place.

**Psalms 67:26**

Princes went before, close behind singers, in the midst of young women beating tambourines.

**Psalms 67:27**

In assemblies bless God, Lord, from the springs of Israel.

**Psalms 67:28**

There Benjamin, younger one, in ecstasy, princes of Judah, their leaders, princes of Zebulun, princes of Naphtali.

**Psalms 67:29**

Command, O God, your strength; strengthen, O God, this which you worked for us.

**Psalms 67:30**

From your temple over Jerusalem kings will bring gifts to you.

**Psalms 67:31**

Rebuke beasts of reed, gathering of bulls among calves of peoples, so as not to shut out those tested by silver. Scatter nations wanting wars.

**Psalms 67:32**

Envoys will come from Egypt; Ethiopia will hasten her hand to God.

**Psalms 67:33**

Kingdoms of earth, sing to God; make melody to the Lord. Interlude.

**Psalms 67:34**

Sing to God, to one riding on heaven of heaven toward east; behold, he will give to his voice a voice of power.

**Psalms 67:35**

Give glory to God; over Israel his magnificence and his power in clouds.

**Psalms 67:36**

Wonderful God in his holy ones; God of Israel, he will give power and strengthening to his people. Blessed be God.

#### Chapter 68

**Psalms 68:1**

For end, concerning those to be changed. Of David.

**Psalms 68:2**

Save me, O God, because waters came in as far as my soul.

**Psalms 68:3**

I was stuck in mud of deep, and no standing-place; I came into the depths of sea, and storm sank me.

**Psalms 68:4**

I grew weary crying; my throat grew hoarse; my eyes failed from hoping upon my God.

**Psalms 68:5**

Those hating me without cause multiplied beyond hairs of my head; my enemies, unjustly pursuing me, were strengthened. What I did not seize, then I was repaying.

**Psalms 68:6**

O God, you knew my foolishness, and my trespasses were not hidden from you.

**Psalms 68:7**

Let not those waiting for you be shamed because of me, Lord, Lord of hosts; let not those seeking you be disgraced because of me, God of Israel.

**Psalms 68:8**

Because for your sake I bore reproach; shame covered my face.

**Psalms 68:9**

I became estranged to my brothers and foreign to the sons of my mother,

**Psalms 68:10**

because zeal of your house consumed me, and reproaches of those reproaching you fell upon me.

**Psalms 68:11**

And I bent my soul in fasting, and it became a reproach to me.

**Psalms 68:12**

And I made my clothing sackcloth, and I became proverb to them.

**Psalms 68:13**

Those sitting in gate were talking against me, and those drinking wine were singing about me.

**Psalms 68:14**

But as for me, my prayer is to you, Lord, at a time of good pleasure. O God, in the multitude of your mercy hear me in the truth of your salvation.

**Psalms 68:15**

Save me from mire so that I may not be stuck; let me be delivered from those hating me and from depth of waters.

**Psalms 68:16**

Let not storm of water sink me, nor let deep swallow me, nor let pit close its mouth over me.

**Psalms 68:17**

Hear me, Lord, because your mercy kind; according to the multitude of your compassions look upon me.

**Psalms 68:18**

Do not turn your face away from your servant, because I am afflicted; quickly hear me.

**Psalms 68:19**

Draw near to my soul and redeem it; because of my enemies rescue me.

**Psalms 68:20**

For you know my reproach and my shame and my dishonor; before you all afflicting me.

**Psalms 68:21**

My soul expected reproach and misery, and I waited for one grieving with me, and there was none, and for comforters, and I found none.

**Psalms 68:22**

And they gave gall for my food, and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

**Psalms 68:23**

Let their table become snare before them, and retribution and stumbling-block.

**Psalms 68:24**

Let their eyes be darkened so as not to see, and bend down their back continually.

**Psalms 68:25**

Pour out your wrath upon them, and let fury of your anger overtake them.

**Psalms 68:26**

Let their homestead become desolate, and in their tents let there be none dwelling.

**Psalms 68:27**

Because one you struck, they themselves pursued, and to pain of your wounded ones they added.

**Psalms 68:28**

Add lawlessness upon their lawlessness, and let them not enter into your righteousness.

**Psalms 68:29**

Let them be blotted out from the book of the living, and with the righteous let them not be written.

**Psalms 68:30**

But I poor and pained; salvation of your face, O God, took hold of me.

**Psalms 68:31**

I will praise the name of God with song; I will magnify him with praise.

**Psalms 68:32**

And it will please God beyond young bull bringing forth horns and hoofs.

**Psalms 68:33**

Let poor see and rejoice; seek God, and your soul will live.

**Psalms 68:34**

Because the Lord heard poor ones and did not despise his chained ones.

**Psalms 68:35**

Let heavens and earth praise him, sea and all creeping things in them,

**Psalms 68:36**

because God will save Zion and the cities of Judah will be built, and they will dwell there and inherit her.

**Psalms 68:37**

And seed of his servants will possess her, and those loving his name will dwell in her.

#### Chapter 69

**Psalms 69:1**

For end. Of David, for remembrance.

**Psalms 69:2**

For the Lord to save me. O God, attend to my help.

**Psalms 69:3**

Let those seeking my soul be shamed and disgraced; let those wanting evils for me be turned back and shamed.

**Psalms 69:4**

Let those saying to me, Good, good, be turned back immediately, being shamed.

**Psalms 69:5**

Let all seeking you exult and rejoice in you, and let those loving your salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.

**Psalms 69:6**

But I poor and needy; O God, help me. My helper and deliverer you are, Lord; do not delay.

#### Chapter 70

**Psalms 70:1**

Of David, of sons of Jonadab, and of first captives. O God, on you I hoped; let me not be shamed forever.

**Psalms 70:2**

In your righteousness rescue me and deliver me; incline your ear to me and save me.

**Psalms 70:3**

Become to me God defender and fortified place to save me, because you are my firm place and refuge.

**Psalms 70:4**

My God, rescue me from the hand of sinner, from the hand of law-breaking and unjust man.

**Psalms 70:5**

Because you are my endurance, Lord, Lord, my hope from my youth.

**Psalms 70:6**

On you I was supported from womb; from the belly of my mother you are my protector; in you my hymn continually.

**Psalms 70:7**

I became like wonder to many, and you strong helper.

**Psalms 70:8**

Let my mouth be filled with praise, so that I may hymn your glory, all day your magnificence.

**Psalms 70:9**

Do not cast me away in the time of old age; when my strength fails, do not forsake me.

**Psalms 70:10**

Because my enemies spoke against me, and those watching my soul took counsel together,

**Psalms 70:11**

saying, God forsook him; pursue and seize him, because there is no rescuer.

**Psalms 70:12**

O God, do not be far from me; my God, attend to my help.

**Psalms 70:13**

Let those slandering my soul be shamed and fail; let those seeking evils for me be clothed with shame and dishonor.

**Psalms 70:14**

But I will hope continually and will add upon all your praise.

**Psalms 70:15**

My mouth will declare your righteousness, all day your salvation, because I did not know writings.

**Psalms 70:16**

I will go in by dominion of the Lord, Lord; I will remember your righteousness, yours alone.

**Psalms 70:17**

You taught me, O God, from my youth, and until now I declare your wonders.

**Psalms 70:18**

And until old age and gray hair, O God, do not forsake me, until I declare your arm to every coming generation, your dominion and your righteousness,

**Psalms 70:19**

O God, unto heights, what great things you did; O God, who like you?

**Psalms 70:20**

How many afflictions, many and evil, you showed me; and turning back, you made me live, and from the depths of earth again you brought me up.

**Psalms 70:21**

You multiplied your greatness, and turning back you comforted me, and from the depths of earth again you brought me up.

**Psalms 70:22**

And indeed I will confess to you with instrument of psalm your truth, O God; I will sing to you with lyre, O Holy One of Israel.

**Psalms 70:23**

My lips will exult when I sing to you, and my soul which you redeemed.

**Psalms 70:24**

And still my tongue all day will meditate on your righteousness, when those seeking evils for me are shamed and disgraced.

#### Chapter 71

**Psalms 71:1**

Of Solomon. O God, give your judgment to the king and your righteousness to son of the king,

**Psalms 71:2**

to judge your people in righteousness and your poor ones in judgment.

**Psalms 71:3**

Let mountains take up peace for your people, and hills in righteousness.

**Psalms 71:4**

He will judge poor ones of the people and save sons of needy ones and humble slanderer.

**Psalms 71:5**

And he will continue along with the sun and before the moon for generations of generations.

**Psalms 71:6**

And he will come down like rain upon fleece and like drops dripping upon earth.

**Psalms 71:7**

Righteousness will rise in his days and abundance of peace until the moon is removed.

**Psalms 71:8**

And he will rule from sea to sea and from the river to the ends of inhabited world.

**Psalms 71:9**

Before him Ethiopians will fall, and his enemies will lick dust.

**Psalms 71:10**

The kings of Tarshish and islands will bring gifts; kings of Arabians and Sheba will bring presents.

**Psalms 71:11**

And all kings will worship him; all nations will serve him.

**Psalms 71:12**

Because he rescued a poor man from the hand of a ruler and a needy one to whom no helper existed.

**Psalms 71:13**

He will spare poor and needy and save souls of needy ones.

**Psalms 71:14**

From usury and from injustice he will redeem their souls, and their name precious before him.

**Psalms 71:15**

And he will live, and from gold of Arabia it will be given to him, and they will pray concerning him continually; all day they will bless him.

**Psalms 71:16**

There will be support in earth on the tops of mountains; his fruit will be lifted above Lebanon, and they will flower from the city like grass of earth.

**Psalms 71:17**

Let his name be blessed forever; before sun his name remains, and in him all tribes of earth will be blessed; all nations will count him blessed.

**Psalms 71:18**

Blessed is the Lord God, God of Israel, who alone does wonders.

**Psalms 71:19**

And blessed name of his glory forever and forever of forever, and all the earth will be filled with his glory. Amen, amen.

**Psalms 71:20**

Hymns of David son of Jesse came to end.

#### Chapter 72

**Psalms 72:1**

Psalm of Asaph. How good God to Israel, to those straight in heart.

**Psalms 72:2**

But as for me, my feet were almost shaken; my steps all but poured out.

**Psalms 72:3**

Because I was jealous over lawless ones, seeing the peace of sinners.

**Psalms 72:4**

Because there is no relenting in their death and firmness in their scourge.

**Psalms 72:5**

In labors of men they are not, and with men they will not be scourged.

**Psalms 72:6**

Therefore pride took hold of them; they clothed themselves with their injustice and ungodliness.

**Psalms 72:7**

Their injustice will go out as from fatness; they passed into purpose of heart.

**Psalms 72:8**

They thought and spoke in evil, they spoke injustice on high.

**Psalms 72:9**

They set their mouth into heaven, and their tongue passed through earth.

**Psalms 72:10**

Therefore my people will return here, and full days will be found for them.

**Psalms 72:11**

And they said, How did God know? And is there knowledge in Most High?

**Psalms 72:12**

Behold, these sinners prosper forever and possessed wealth.

**Psalms 72:13**

And I said, Then in vain I made my heart righteous and washed my hands among innocent ones.

**Psalms 72:14**

And I became scourged whole day, and my reproof unto mornings.

**Psalms 72:15**

If I said, I will tell thus, behold, against generation of your sons I acted treacherously.

**Psalms 72:16**

And I undertook to know this; it is trouble before me,

**Psalms 72:17**

until I enter into sanctuary of God and understand their last things.

**Psalms 72:18**

Surely because of their deceits you set things for them; you cast them down in their being lifted up.

**Psalms 72:19**

How they came to desolation suddenly; they failed, they perished because of their lawlessness.

**Psalms 72:20**

Like dream of one waking, Lord, in your city you will despise their image.

**Psalms 72:21**

Because my heart burned and my kidneys were altered,

**Psalms 72:22**

and I, being despised, did not know; I became beastlike beside you.

**Psalms 72:23**

And I continually with you; you held my right hand.

**Psalms 72:24**

In your counsel you guided me, and with glory you received me.

**Psalms 72:25**

For what exists for me in heaven? And besides you what did I desire upon the earth?

**Psalms 72:26**

My heart and my flesh failed; God of my heart and my portion, God forever.

**Psalms 72:27**

Because behold, those distancing themselves from you will perish; you destroyed everyone prostituting himself away from you.

**Psalms 72:28**

But for me, clinging to God good; to place hope in the Lord, to declare all your praises in the gates of daughter of Zion.

#### Chapter 73

**Psalms 73:1**

For understanding. Of Asaph. Why, O God, did you reject to end? Your anger burned against sheep of your pasture.

**Psalms 73:2**

Remember your congregation which you acquired from the beginning; you redeemed rod of your inheritance, this Mount Zion in which you dwelt.

**Psalms 73:3**

Lift up your hands against their pride to end, against all evil enemy did in your holy places.

**Psalms 73:4**

And those hating you boasted in the midst of your feast; they set their signs as signs and did not know,

**Psalms 73:5**

as at entrance above.

**Psalms 73:6**

As in the forest of woods with axes they cut down her doors together; with hatchet and stone-cutter tool they broke her down.

**Psalms 73:7**

They burned your sanctuary with fire; to ground they profaned tabernacle of your name.

**Psalms 73:8**

They said in their heart, their whole kin together, Come, let us burn all feasts of God from earth.

**Psalms 73:9**

Our signs we did not see; there is no longer prophet, and he will not know us any longer.

**Psalms 73:10**

How long, O God, will enemy reproach? Will adversary provoke your name to end?

**Psalms 73:11**

Why do you turn away your hand and your right hand from the midst of your bosom to end?

**Psalms 73:12**

But God our king before age worked salvation in the midst of earth.

**Psalms 73:13**

You strengthened sea in your power; you crushed heads of dragons upon water.

**Psalms 73:14**

You crushed heads of dragon; you gave him as food to Ethiopian peoples.

**Psalms 73:15**

You split open springs and torrents; you dried up rivers of Etham.

**Psalms 73:16**

Yours day and yours night; you prepared light and sun.

**Psalms 73:17**

You made all boundaries of earth; summer and spring you formed them.

**Psalms 73:18**

Remember this: enemy reproached Lord, and foolish people provoked your name.

**Psalms 73:19**

Do not hand over to beasts soul confessing to you; souls of your poor ones do not forget to end.

**Psalms 73:20**

Look upon your covenant, because dark places of earth were filled with houses of lawlessness.

**Psalms 73:21**

Let humbled one not turn back shamed; poor and needy will praise your name.

**Psalms 73:22**

Rise up, O God, judge your case; remember your reproaches from fool all day.

**Psalms 73:23**

Do not forget voice of your suppliants; pride of those hating you went up continually toward you.

#### Chapter 74

**Psalms 74:1**

For end, do not destroy. Psalm of Asaph. Song.

**Psalms 74:2**

We will confess to you, O God, we will confess, and we will call on your name.

**Psalms 74:3**

I will tell all your wonders when I receive appointed time; I will judge uprightnesses.

**Psalms 74:4**

Earth melted, and all inhabiting it; I strengthened its pillars. Interlude.

**Psalms 74:5**

I said to law-breakers, Do not break law, and to sinners, Do not lift horn.

**Psalms 74:6**

Do not raise your horn on high; do not speak injustice against God.

**Psalms 74:7**

Because neither from exits nor from wests nor from desert mountains,

**Psalms 74:8**

because God is judge; this one he humbles and this one he exalts.

**Psalms 74:9**

Because cup in the hand of the Lord, of unmixed wine full of mixture, and he tilted from this into that, but its dregs were not emptied; all sinners of earth will drink.

**Psalms 74:10**

But I will exult forever; I will sing to God of Jacob.

**Psalms 74:11**

And all the horns of sinners I will shatter, and the horns of the righteous one will be exalted.

#### Chapter 75

**Psalms 75:1**

For end, in hymns. Psalm of Asaph. Song against Assyrian.

**Psalms 75:2**

In Judah God known; in Israel great his name.

**Psalms 75:3**

And his place came to be in peace, and his dwelling-place in Zion.

**Psalms 75:4**

There he crushed strengths of bows, weapon and sword and war. Interlude.

**Psalms 75:5**

You shine wondrously from everlasting mountains.

**Psalms 75:6**

All senseless in heart were troubled; they slept their sleep and found nothing, all men of wealth, in their hands.

**Psalms 75:7**

From your rebuke, God of Jacob, riders of horses grew drowsy.

**Psalms 75:8**

You fearful, and who will stand against you from then on, from your anger?

**Psalms 75:9**

From heaven you made judgment heard; earth feared and was still,

**Psalms 75:10**

when God rose to judgment, to save all meek of earth. Interlude.

**Psalms 75:11**

Because the thought of man will confess to you, and the remnant of thought will celebrate feast to you.

**Psalms 75:12**

Vow and pay to the Lord your God; all around him will bring gifts

**Psalms 75:13**

to one fearful and removing spirits of rulers, fearful beyond kings of the earth.

#### Chapter 76

**Psalms 76:1**

For end, concerning Jeduthun. Of Asaph. Psalm.

**Psalms 76:2**

My voice cried to the Lord, my voice to God, and he attended to me.

**Psalms 76:3**

In the day of my affliction I sought God; my hands by night before him, and I was not deceived. My soul refused to be comforted.

**Psalms 76:4**

I remembered God and was gladdened; I mused and my spirit grew fainthearted. Interlude.

**Psalms 76:5**

My eyes seized first watches; I was troubled and did not speak.

**Psalms 76:6**

I considered ancient days, and years of old I remembered and meditated.

**Psalms 76:7**

By night with my heart I mused, and my spirit searched out.

**Psalms 76:8**

Will the Lord reject forever and add no more to take pleasure still?

**Psalms 76:9**

Or will he cut off his mercy to end, from generation to generation?

**Psalms 76:10**

Will God forget to show compassion, or will he hold back his compassions in his anger? Interlude.

**Psalms 76:11**

And I said, Now I began; this change belongs to right hand of Most High.

**Psalms 76:12**

I remembered works of the Lord, because I will remember from the beginning your wonders.

**Psalms 76:13**

And I will meditate on all your works and muse on your practices.

**Psalms 76:14**

O God, your way in holy place; what god great as our God?

**Psalms 76:15**

You are God doing wonders; you made known your power among peoples.

**Psalms 76:16**

With your arm you redeemed your people, sons of Jacob and Joseph. Interlude.

**Psalms 76:17**

Waters saw you, O God; waters saw you and feared, and deeps were troubled, multitude of sound of waters.

**Psalms 76:18**

Clouds gave voice, for your arrows pass through.

**Psalms 76:19**

The voice of your thunder in wheel; your lightnings appeared to inhabited world; earth was shaken and became trembling.

**Psalms 76:20**

In sea your way and your paths in many waters, and your footprints will not be known.

**Psalms 76:21**

You guided your people like sheep by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

#### Chapter 77

**Psalms 77:1**

For understanding. Of Asaph. Attend, my people, to my law; incline your ear to the words of my mouth.

**Psalms 77:2**

I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter riddles from the beginning,

**Psalms 77:3**

things we heard and knew, and our fathers told us.

**Psalms 77:4**

It was not hidden from their children, to another generation declaring praises of the Lord and his powers and his wonders which he did.

**Psalms 77:5**

And he raised testimony in Jacob and set law in Israel, things he commanded our fathers to make known to their sons,

**Psalms 77:6**

so that another generation might know, sons being born, and rise and tell them to their sons,

**Psalms 77:7**

so that they might place their hope upon God and not forget works of God and seek out his commandments,

**Psalms 77:8**

so that they may not become like their fathers, generation crooked and provoking, generation which did not set its heart straight and whose spirit was not faithful with God.

**Psalms 77:9**

Sons of Ephraim, stringing and shooting bows, turned back in the day of war.

**Psalms 77:10**

They did not keep covenant of God and did not want to walk in his law.

**Psalms 77:11**

And they forgot his good deeds and his wonders which he showed them,

**Psalms 77:12**

things he did wondrously before their fathers in the land of Egypt, in the plain of Zoan.

**Psalms 77:13**

He split sea and led them through; he made waters stand like a wineskin.

**Psalms 77:14**

And he guided them in cloud by day and all night in the light of fire.

**Psalms 77:15**

He split rock in the wilderness and gave them drink as from great deep.

**Psalms 77:16**

And he brought water out from rock and brought waters down like rivers.

**Psalms 77:17**

And they added still to sin against him; they provoked Most High in waterless place.

**Psalms 77:18**

And they tested God in their hearts by asking foods for their souls.

**Psalms 77:19**

And they spoke against God and said, Will God be able to prepare table in the wilderness?

**Psalms 77:20**

Since he struck rock and waters flowed and torrents overflowed, can he also give bread or prepare table for his people?

**Psalms 77:21**

Therefore the Lord heard and deferred, and fire was kindled in Jacob, and wrath rose upon Israel,

**Psalms 77:22**

because they did not believe in God nor hope on his salvation.

**Psalms 77:23**

And he commanded clouds above and opened doors of heaven,

**Psalms 77:24**

and rained manna on them to eat and gave them bread of heaven.

**Psalms 77:25**

Man ate bread of angels; he sent them provision unto fullness.

**Psalms 77:26**

He lifted south wind from heaven and brought in by his dominion southwest wind.

**Psalms 77:27**

And he rained flesh upon them like dust and winged birds like the sand of the seas.

**Psalms 77:28**

And they fell into the midst of their camp, around their tents.

**Psalms 77:29**

And they ate and were filled exceedingly, and he brought them their desire.

**Psalms 77:30**

They were not deprived of their desire; while their food was still in their mouth,

**Psalms 77:31**

wrath of God rose upon them and killed among their fat ones and hamstrung chosen ones of Israel.

**Psalms 77:32**

In all these things they still sinned and did not believe in his wonders.

**Psalms 77:33**

And their days failed in vanity and their years in haste.

**Psalms 77:34**

When he killed them, they sought him, and returned and rose early toward God.

**Psalms 77:35**

And they remembered that God is their helper and God Most High their redeemer.

**Psalms 77:36**

And they deceived him with their mouth and lied to him with their tongue.

**Psalms 77:37**

But their heart was not straight with him, nor were they faithful in his covenant.

**Psalms 77:38**

But he compassionate and will propitiate their sins and not destroy, and he will multiply turning away his wrath and will not kindle all his anger.

**Psalms 77:39**

And he remembered that they are flesh, spirit going and not returning.

**Psalms 77:40**

How often they provoked him in the wilderness, angered him in waterless land.

**Psalms 77:41**

And they turned and tested God and provoked the Holy One of Israel.

**Psalms 77:42**

They did not remember his hand, day when he redeemed them from the hand of afflicter,

**Psalms 77:43**

how he set his signs in Egypt and his wonders in the plain of Zoan,

**Psalms 77:44**

and turned their rivers into blood and their rainfalls so they might not drink.

**Psalms 77:45**

He sent upon them dog-fly and it devoured them, and frog and it ruined them.

**Psalms 77:46**

And he gave their fruit to mildew and their labors to locust.

**Psalms 77:47**

He killed their vine with hail and their sycamores with frost.

**Psalms 77:48**

And he handed over their cattle to hail and their possessions to fire.

**Psalms 77:49**

He sent upon them wrath of his anger, anger and fury and affliction, dispatch by evil angels.

**Psalms 77:50**

He made way for his anger; he did not spare their souls from death and enclosed their cattle in death.

**Psalms 77:51**

And he struck every firstborn in Egypt, first fruits of their labors in the tents of Ham.

**Psalms 77:52**

And he lifted up his people like sheep and led them like a flock in the wilderness.

**Psalms 77:53**

And he guided them in hope and they did not fear, and sea covered their enemies.

**Psalms 77:54**

And he brought them into boundary of his sanctuary, this mountain which his right hand acquired.

**Psalms 77:55**

And he cast out nations from before them and gave them inheritance by measuring line and made the tribes of Israel dwell in their tents.

**Psalms 77:56**

And they tested and provoked God Most High, and his testimonies they did not keep.

**Psalms 77:57**

And they turned back and broke covenant just as their fathers, and were twisted into crooked bow.

**Psalms 77:58**

And they angered him with their hills and with their carved images stirred him to jealousy.

**Psalms 77:59**

God heard and disregarded and greatly despised Israel.

**Psalms 77:60**

And he rejected tent of Shiloh, his tabernacle where he dwelt among men.

**Psalms 77:61**

And he gave their strength into captivity and their beauty into the hand of enemy.

**Psalms 77:62**

And he enclosed his people to sword and disregarded his inheritance.

**Psalms 77:63**

Fire devoured their young men, and their virgins were not mourned.

**Psalms 77:64**

Their priests fell by sword, and their widows will not be wept.

**Psalms 77:65**

And the Lord awoke like one sleeping, like mighty man sobered from wine.

**Psalms 77:66**

And he struck his enemies backward; everlasting reproach he gave them.

**Psalms 77:67**

And he rejected tent of Joseph, and tribe of Ephraim he did not choose.

**Psalms 77:68**

And he chose tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.

**Psalms 77:69**

And he built his sanctuary like unicorns; on earth he founded it forever.

**Psalms 77:70**

And he chose David his servant and took him up from flocks of sheep.

**Psalms 77:71**

From behind nursing ones he took him to shepherd Jacob his people and Israel his inheritance.

**Psalms 77:72**

And he shepherded them in the innocence of his heart and guided them in understandings of his hands.

#### Chapter 78

**Psalms 78:1**

Psalm of Asaph. O God, nations came into your inheritance; they defiled your holy temple; they made Jerusalem into orchard-watch hut.

**Psalms 78:2**

They set dead bodies of your servants as food to the birds of heaven, flesh of your holy ones to the beasts of the earth.

**Psalms 78:3**

They poured out their blood like water around Jerusalem, and there was none burying.

**Psalms 78:4**

We became a reproach to our neighbors, mocking and derision to those around us.

**Psalms 78:5**

How long, Lord? Will you be angry to end? Will your zeal burn like fire?

**Psalms 78:6**

Pour out your anger upon nations not knowing you and upon kingdoms which did not call upon your name,

**Psalms 78:7**

because they devoured Jacob and laid waste his place.

**Psalms 78:8**

Do not remember against us ancient lawlessnesses; let your compassions quickly go before us, because we became very poor.

**Psalms 78:9**

Help us, God our savior, for the sake of glory of your name. Lord, rescue us and propitiate our sins for the sake of your name.

**Psalms 78:10**

Lest nations say, Where is their God? Let vengeance of blood of your servants poured out be known among nations before our eyes.

**Psalms 78:11**

Let groaning of chained ones enter before you; according to greatness of your arm preserve sons of those put to death.

**Psalms 78:12**

Repay to our neighbors sevenfold into their bosom their reproach with which they reproached you, Lord.

**Psalms 78:13**

But we are your people and sheep of your pasture will confess to you forever; from generation to generation we will declare your praise.

#### Chapter 79

**Psalms 79:1**

For end, concerning those to be changed, testimony of Asaph, psalm concerning Assyrian.

**Psalms 79:2**

You shepherding Israel, attend; you leading Joseph like sheep, you sitting upon cherubim, show yourself.

**Psalms 79:3**

Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up your dominion and come to save us.

**Psalms 79:4**

O God, turn us back and make your face shine, and we will be saved.

**Psalms 79:5**

Lord God of hosts, how long are you angry over prayer of your servant?

**Psalms 79:6**

You feed us bread of tears and give us tears to drink in measure.

**Psalms 79:7**

You set us for contradiction to our neighbors, and our enemies mocked us.

**Psalms 79:8**

Lord God of hosts, turn us back and make your face shine, and we will be saved. Interlude.

**Psalms 79:9**

You transplanted vine out of Egypt; you cast out nations and planted her.

**Psalms 79:10**

You made way before her and planted her roots, and land was filled.

**Psalms 79:11**

Her shadow covered mountains, and her branches the cedars of God.

**Psalms 79:12**

She stretched out her shoots unto sea and her offshoots unto river.

**Psalms 79:13**

Why did you pull down her fence, and all passing by road gather from her?

**Psalms 79:14**

Boar from the forest ravaged her, and solitary wild beast fed on her.

**Psalms 79:15**

God of hosts, turn now; look from heaven and see and visit this vine,

**Psalms 79:16**

and restore what your right hand planted, and upon the son of man whom you strengthened for yourself.

**Psalms 79:17**

Burned with fire and dug up, they will perish from rebuke of your face.

**Psalms 79:18**

Let your hand be upon man of your right hand and upon the son of man whom you strengthened for yourself.

**Psalms 79:19**

And we will never depart from you; you will make us live, and we will call upon your name.

**Psalms 79:20**

Lord God of hosts, turn us back and make your face shine, and we will be saved.

#### Chapter 80

**Psalms 80:1**

For end, concerning winepresses. Of Asaph. Psalm.

**Psalms 80:2**

Exult in God our helper; shout to God of Jacob.

**Psalms 80:3**

Take psalm and give tambourine, pleasant psaltery with lyre.

**Psalms 80:4**

Blow trumpet at new moon, on notable day of our feast,

**Psalms 80:5**

because ordinance for Israel it is and judgment for God of Jacob.

**Psalms 80:6**

He set it as testimony in Joseph when he went out from the land of Egypt; he heard language he did not know.

**Psalms 80:7**

He removed his back from burdens; his hands served in basket.

**Psalms 80:8**

In affliction you called on me, and I rescued you; I heard you in the hidden place of storm; I tested you at the water of contradiction. Interlude.

**Psalms 80:9**

Hear, my people, and I will testify to you; Israel, if you would hear me,

**Psalms 80:10**

there will not be in you recent god, nor will you worship strange god.

**Psalms 80:11**

For I am the Lord your God, who brought you up from the land of Egypt; widen your mouth, and I will fill it.

**Psalms 80:12**

And my people did not hear my voice, and Israel did not attend to me.

**Psalms 80:13**

And I sent them according to practices of their hearts; they will walk in their practices.

**Psalms 80:14**

If my people heard me, if Israel walked in my ways,

**Psalms 80:15**

in nothing I would humble their enemies and against those afflicting them I would lay my hand.

**Psalms 80:16**

The enemies of the Lord lied to him, and their time will be forever.

**Psalms 80:17**

And he fed them from the fat of wheat, and from rock he satisfied them with honey.

#### Chapter 81

**Psalms 81:1**

Psalm of Asaph. God stood in the gathering of gods, and in midst he judges gods.

**Psalms 81:2**

How long will you judge injustice and take faces of sinners? Interlude.

**Psalms 81:3**

Judge an orphan and a poor one; justify a humble one and a needy one.

**Psalms 81:4**

Rescue a needy one and a poor one; deliver from the hand of a sinner.

**Psalms 81:5**

They did not know nor understand; they walk in darkness; all foundations of the earth will be shaken.

**Psalms 81:6**

I said, You are gods, and all sons of Most High.

**Psalms 81:7**

But you die like men and fall like one of rulers.

**Psalms 81:8**

Rise up, O God, judge earth, because you will inherit among all nations.

#### Chapter 82

**Psalms 82:1**

Song of psalm of Asaph.

**Psalms 82:2**

O God, who will be likened to you? Do not be silent nor be made gentle, O God.

**Psalms 82:3**

Because behold, your enemies sounded out, and those hating you raised head.

**Psalms 82:4**

Against your people they worked crafty counsel and took counsel against your holy ones.

**Psalms 82:5**

They said, Come, and let us destroy them from nation, and the name of Israel will not be remembered any longer.

**Psalms 82:6**

Because they took counsel with one accord together; against you they arranged covenant:

**Psalms 82:7**

tents of Edomites and Ishmaelites, Moab and Hagarites,

**Psalms 82:8**

Gebal and Ammon and Amalek, foreigners with those dwelling in Tyre.

**Psalms 82:9**

For Asshur also came along with them; they became support to the sons of Lot. Interlude.

**Psalms 82:10**

Do to them as to Midian and to Sisera, as to Jabin at torrent Kishon.

**Psalms 82:11**

They were destroyed at Endor; they became like dung for earth.

**Psalms 82:12**

Make their rulers like Oreb and Zeeb and Zebee and Zalmunna, all their rulers,

**Psalms 82:13**

who said, Let us inherit sanctuary of God for ourselves.

**Psalms 82:14**

My God, make them like a wheel, like stubble before wind,

**Psalms 82:15**

as fire kindles forest, as a flame burns mountains,

**Psalms 82:16**

so you will pursue them in your storm, and in your anger you will trouble them.

**Psalms 82:17**

Fill their faces with dishonor, and they will seek your name, Lord.

**Psalms 82:18**

Let them be shamed and troubled forever and ever, and let them be disgraced and perish.

**Psalms 82:19**

And let them know that your name Lord, you alone Most High over all the earth.

#### Chapter 83

**Psalms 83:1**

For end, concerning winepresses, for the sons of Korah, psalm.

**Psalms 83:2**

How beloved your tabernacles, Lord of hosts.

**Psalms 83:3**

My soul longs and fails for courts of the Lord; my heart and my flesh exulted in living God.

**Psalms 83:4**

For even sparrow found house for itself, and turtledove nest for herself where she may place her nestlings: your altars, Lord of hosts, my king and my God.

**Psalms 83:5**

Blessed are those dwelling in your house; forever and ever they will praise you. Interlude.

**Psalms 83:6**

Blessed is the man whose support is from you, Lord; ascents in his heart he arranged,

**Psalms 83:7**

in the valley of weeping, into place he appointed; for lawgiver will also give blessings.

**Psalms 83:8**

They will go from strength to strength; the God of gods will be seen in Zion.

**Psalms 83:9**

Lord God of hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, God of Jacob. Interlude.

**Psalms 83:10**

Our defender, see, O God, and look upon the face of your anointed.

**Psalms 83:11**

Because one day in your courts is better than thousands; I chose to be cast aside in the house of God rather than dwell in the tents of sinners.

**Psalms 83:12**

Because the Lord God loves mercy and truth; the Lord will give grace and glory; he will not withhold good things from those walking in innocence.

**Psalms 83:13**

Lord of hosts, blessed man hoping on you.

#### Chapter 84

**Psalms 84:1**

For end, for the sons of Korah, psalm.

**Psalms 84:2**

You took pleasure, Lord, in your land; you turned back captivity of Jacob.

**Psalms 84:3**

You forgave lawlessnesses of your people; you covered all their sins. Interlude.

**Psalms 84:4**

You stopped all your anger; you turned back from the wrath of your anger.

**Psalms 84:5**

Turn us back, O God of our salvations, and turn your anger away from us.

**Psalms 84:6**

Will you be angry with us forever, or stretch your anger from generation to generation?

**Psalms 84:7**

O God, you, turning back, will make us live, and your people will rejoice in you.

**Psalms 84:8**

Show us, Lord, your mercy, and give us your salvation.

**Psalms 84:9**

I will hear what the Lord God will speak in me, because he will speak peace upon his people and upon his holy ones and upon those turning heart toward him.

**Psalms 84:10**

Surely his salvation near those fearing him, so that glory may dwell in our land.

**Psalms 84:11**

Mercy and truth met together; righteousness and peace kissed.

**Psalms 84:12**

Truth rose from earth, and righteousness looked down from heaven.

**Psalms 84:13**

For the Lord will give goodness, and our land will give its fruit.

**Psalms 84:14**

Righteousness will go before him and set his footsteps in the way.

#### Chapter 85

**Psalms 85:1**

Prayer of David. Incline your ear, Lord, and hear me, because I poor and needy.

**Psalms 85:2**

Guard my soul, because I holy; save your servant, my God, hoping on you.

**Psalms 85:3**

Have mercy on me, Lord, because to you I will cry whole day.

**Psalms 85:4**

Gladden soul of your servant, because to you, Lord, I lifted my soul.

**Psalms 85:5**

Because you, Lord, kind and gentle and rich in mercy to all calling on you.

**Psalms 85:6**

Give ear, Lord, to my prayer and attend to the voice of my supplication.

**Psalms 85:7**

In the day of my affliction I cried to you, because you heard me.

**Psalms 85:8**

There is none like you among gods, Lord, and none according to your works.

**Psalms 85:9**

All nations, as many as you made, will come and worship before you, Lord, and will glorify your name.

**Psalms 85:10**

Because you great and doing wonders; you alone the great God.

**Psalms 85:11**

Guide me, Lord, in your way, and I will walk in your truth; let my heart rejoice to fear your name.

**Psalms 85:12**

I will confess to you, Lord my God, with all my heart, and I will glorify your name forever.

**Psalms 85:13**

Because your mercy great upon me, and you rescued my soul from lowest Hades.

**Psalms 85:14**

O God, lawless men rose against me, and gathering of strong men sought my soul, and they did not set you before them.

**Psalms 85:15**

But you, Lord God, compassionate and merciful, long-suffering and rich in mercy and true.

**Psalms 85:16**

Look upon me and have mercy on me; give your strength to your child and save son of your handmaid.

**Psalms 85:17**

Do with me sign for good, and let those hating me see and be shamed, because you, Lord, helped me and comforted me.

#### Chapter 86

**Psalms 86:1**

For the sons of Korah. Psalm of song. His foundations in holy mountains.

**Psalms 86:2**

The Lord loves gates of Zion above all tabernacles of Jacob.

**Psalms 86:3**

Glorious things were spoken concerning you, city of God. Interlude.

**Psalms 86:4**

I will remember Rahab and Babylon to those knowing me; behold, foreigners and Tyre and people of Ethiopians, these were born there.

**Psalms 86:5**

Mother Zion, man will say, and man was born in her, and Most High himself founded her.

**Psalms 86:6**

The Lord will recount in the writing of peoples and rulers, these who were born in her. Interlude.

**Psalms 86:7**

As of all rejoicing ones, dwelling in you.

#### Chapter 87

**Psalms 87:1**

Song of psalm for the sons of Korah, for end, concerning Mahalath, for answering, for understanding, of Heman the Israelite.

**Psalms 87:2**

Lord God of my salvation, by day I cried and by night before you.

**Psalms 87:3**

Let my prayer enter before you; incline your ear to my supplication, Lord.

**Psalms 87:4**

Because my soul was filled with evils, and my life drew near to Hades.

**Psalms 87:5**

I was counted with those going down into pit; I became like helpless man among dead, free,

**Psalms 87:6**

like wounded ones cast down, sleeping in tomb, whom you no longer remembered and they were thrust away from your hand.

**Psalms 87:7**

They set me in lowest pit, in dark places and in the shadow of death.

**Psalms 87:8**

Your wrath was fixed upon me, and all your surges you brought upon me. Interlude.

**Psalms 87:9**

You removed my acquaintances from me; they made me abomination to themselves. I was handed over and did not go out.

**Psalms 87:10**

My eyes grew weak from poverty; I cried to you, Lord, whole day; I spread out my hands to you.

**Psalms 87:11**

Will you do wonders for dead, or will physicians raise them and confess to you?

**Psalms 87:12**

Will anyone recount your mercy in tomb, and your truth in destruction?

**Psalms 87:13**

Will your wonders be known in darkness and your righteousness in forgotten land?

**Psalms 87:14**

But I cried to you, Lord, and in morning my prayer will go before you.

**Psalms 87:15**

Why, Lord, do you reject my soul? You turn your face away from me.

**Psalms 87:16**

I poor and in labors from my youth; having been exalted, I was humbled and came to despair.

**Psalms 87:17**

Your angers passed over me, and your terrors troubled me.

**Psalms 87:18**

They encircled me like water whole day; together they surrounded me.

**Psalms 87:19**

You removed friend and neighbor from me and my acquaintances from misery.

#### Chapter 88

**Psalms 88:1**

For understanding. Of Ethan the Israelite.

**Psalms 88:2**

Your mercies, Lord, forever I will sing; from generation to generation I will declare your truth with my mouth.

**Psalms 88:3**

Because you said, Mercy will be built forever; in heavens your truth will be prepared.

**Psalms 88:4**

I arranged covenant with my chosen ones; I swore to David my servant,

**Psalms 88:5**

Until age I will prepare your seed and build your throne to generation and generation. Interlude.

**Psalms 88:6**

Heavens will confess your wonders, Lord, and your truth in the assembly of holy ones.

**Psalms 88:7**

Because who in clouds will be made equal to the Lord, and who will be likened to the Lord among sons of God?

**Psalms 88:8**

God glorified in the council of holy ones, great and fearful above all around him.

**Psalms 88:9**

Lord God of hosts, who like you? Mighty are you, Lord, and your truth around you.

**Psalms 88:10**

You rule power of sea, and disturbance of its waves you calm.

**Psalms 88:11**

You humbled proud one like a wounded man, and with arm of your power you scattered your enemies.

**Psalms 88:12**

Yours the heavens and yours the earth; inhabited world and its fullness, you founded them.

**Psalms 88:13**

North and seas you created; Tabor and Hermon will exult in your name.

**Psalms 88:14**

Yours the arm with dominion; let your hand be strengthened; let your right hand be exalted.

**Psalms 88:15**

Righteousness and judgment are the foundation of your throne; mercy and truth will go before your face.

**Psalms 88:16**

Blessed are the people knowing shout; Lord, in the light of your face they will walk.

**Psalms 88:17**

And in your name they will exult whole day, and in your righteousness they will be exalted.

**Psalms 88:18**

Because you boast of their power, and in your good pleasure our horn will be exalted.

**Psalms 88:19**

Because support belongs to the Lord, and to the Holy One of Israel, our king.

**Psalms 88:20**

Then you spoke in vision to your holy ones and said, I set help upon mighty one; I exalted chosen one from my people.

**Psalms 88:21**

I found David my servant; with my holy oil I anointed him.

**Psalms 88:22**

For my hand will support him, and my arm will strengthen him.

**Psalms 88:23**

Enemy will not profit in him, and son of lawlessness will not add to harm him.

**Psalms 88:24**

And I will cut down his enemies from before him, and those hating him I will rout.

**Psalms 88:25**

And my truth and my mercy with him, and in my name his horn will be exalted.

**Psalms 88:26**

And I will set his hand in sea and his right hand in rivers.

**Psalms 88:27**

He will call upon me, You are my father, my God and supporter of my salvation.

**Psalms 88:28**

And I will set him firstborn, high above kings of the earth.

**Psalms 88:29**

Forever I will keep my mercy for him, and my covenant faithful to him.

**Psalms 88:30**

And I will set his seed forever and ever and his throne as days of heaven.

**Psalms 88:31**

If his sons forsake my law and do not walk in my judgments,

**Psalms 88:32**

if they profane my ordinances and do not keep my commandments,

**Psalms 88:33**

I will visit their lawlessnesses with rod and their sins with whips.

**Psalms 88:34**

But my mercy I will certainly not scatter from him, nor will I act unjustly in my truth.

**Psalms 88:35**

Nor will I profane my covenant, and what goes out through my lips I will certainly not set aside.

**Psalms 88:36**

Once I swore in my holy place: will I lie to David?

**Psalms 88:37**

His seed remains forever, and his throne as sun before me,

**Psalms 88:38**

and as moon established forever, and witness in heaven faithful. Interlude.

**Psalms 88:39**

But you rejected and despised; you deferred your anointed.

**Psalms 88:40**

You overturned covenant of your servant; you profaned his sanctuary to earth.

**Psalms 88:41**

You pulled down all his fences; you made his strongholds fear.

**Psalms 88:42**

All passing by road plundered him; he became a reproach to his neighbors.

**Psalms 88:43**

You exalted right hand of his enemies; you gladdened all his enemies.

**Psalms 88:44**

You turned back help of his sword and did not support him in war.

**Psalms 88:45**

You dissolved him from cleansing; his throne you shattered to earth.

**Psalms 88:46**

You shortened days of his time; you poured out shame upon him. Interlude.

**Psalms 88:47**

How long, Lord? Will you turn away to end? Will your anger burn like fire?

**Psalms 88:48**

Remember what my substance is; for not in vain did you create all sons of men.

**Psalms 88:49**

Who is man who will live and not see death? Will he rescue his soul from the hand of Hades? Interlude.

**Psalms 88:50**

Where are your former mercies, Lord, which you swore to David in your truth?

**Psalms 88:51**

Remember, Lord, reproach of your servants, which I bore in my bosom from many nations,

**Psalms 88:52**

with which your enemies reproached, Lord, with which they reproached exchange of your anointed.

**Psalms 88:53**

Blessed is the Lord forever. Amen, amen.

#### Chapter 89

**Psalms 89:1**

Prayer of Moses, man of God. Lord, you became refuge to us in generation and generation.

**Psalms 89:2**

Before mountains were born and earth and inhabited world were formed, from age until age you are.

**Psalms 89:3**

Do not turn man away into humiliation; and you said, Return, sons of men.

**Psalms 89:4**

Because thousand years in your eyes like yesterday day that passed and like watch in night.

**Psalms 89:5**

Their despised things will be years; in morning like grass let it pass away.

**Psalms 89:6**

In morning let it flower and pass away; in evening let it fall, grow hard, and dry up.

**Psalms 89:7**

Because we failed in your anger and in your fury we were troubled.

**Psalms 89:8**

You set our lawlessnesses before you, our age in the light of your face.

**Psalms 89:9**

Because all our days failed, and in your anger we failed; our years I kept meditating like a spider.

**Psalms 89:10**

Days of our years, in them seventy years; and if in dominions, eighty years; and more of them labor and pain, because meekness came upon us and we will be disciplined.

**Psalms 89:11**

Who knows strength of your anger and from your fear your fury?

**Psalms 89:12**

To number your right hand, thus make known, and those bound in heart in wisdom.

**Psalms 89:13**

Turn back, Lord, how long, and be comforted over your servants.

**Psalms 89:14**

We were filled in morning with your mercy, and we exulted and rejoiced in all our days.

**Psalms 89:15**

We rejoiced for days in which you humbled us, years in which we saw evils.

**Psalms 89:16**

And look upon your servants and your works and guide their sons.

**Psalms 89:17**

And let brightness of the Lord our God be upon us, and works of our hands direct upon us.

#### Chapter 90

**Psalms 90:1**

Praise, song of David. One dwelling in help of Most High will lodge in the shelter of the God of heaven.

**Psalms 90:2**

He will say to the Lord, You are my supporter and my refuge, my God; I will hope on him.

**Psalms 90:3**

Because he will rescue me from the snare of hunters and from troubled word.

**Psalms 90:4**

With his shoulders he will overshadow you, and under his wings you will hope; his truth will encircle you with shield.

**Psalms 90:5**

You will not fear from night fear, from arrow flying by day,

**Psalms 90:6**

from thing passing in darkness, from mishap and midday demon.

**Psalms 90:7**

A thousand will fall from your side and ten thousand from your right, but it will not come near you.

**Psalms 90:8**

Only with your eyes you will observe and see the repayment of sinners.

**Psalms 90:9**

Because you, Lord, my hope; you made Most High your refuge.

**Psalms 90:10**

Evils will not come near you, and scourge will not draw near your tent.

**Psalms 90:11**

Because he will command his angels concerning you, to guard you in all your ways.

**Psalms 90:12**

On hands they will carry you, lest you strike your foot against stone.

**Psalms 90:13**

You will step on asp and basilisk and trample lion and dragon.

**Psalms 90:14**

Because he hoped on me, and I will rescue him; I will shelter him, because he knew my name.

**Psalms 90:15**

He will call upon me, and I will hear him; I am with him in affliction, and I will deliver and glorify him.

**Psalms 90:16**

With length of days I will fill him and show him my salvation.

#### Chapter 91

**Psalms 91:1**

Psalm, song for the day of Sabbath.

**Psalms 91:2**

Good thing to confess to the Lord and sing to your name, Most High,

**Psalms 91:3**

to proclaim in morning your mercy and your truth by night,

**Psalms 91:4**

on ten-stringed psaltery, with song on lyre.

**Psalms 91:5**

Because you gladdened me, Lord, in your workmanship, and in the works of your hands I will exult.

**Psalms 91:6**

How your works were magnified, Lord; your thoughts were made very deep.

**Psalms 91:7**

Foolish man will not know, and senseless man will not understand these things:

**Psalms 91:8**

when sinners spring up like grass and all workers of lawlessness peered out, so that they might be destroyed forever and ever.

**Psalms 91:9**

But you, Most High forever, Lord.

**Psalms 91:10**

Because behold, your enemies will perish, and all workers of lawlessness will be scattered.

**Psalms 91:11**

And my horn will be exalted like unicorn, and my old age in rich oil.

**Psalms 91:12**

And my eye looked upon my enemies, and on those rising against me doing evil my ear will hear.

**Psalms 91:13**

The righteous one will flower like a palm tree; like a cedar in Lebanon he will multiply.

**Psalms 91:14**

Planted in the house of the Lord, in the courts of our God they will flower.

**Psalms 91:15**

They will still multiply in rich old age and be prospering,

**Psalms 91:16**

to declare that the Lord my God is upright, and there is no injustice in him.

#### Chapter 92

**Psalms 92:1**

For day before Sabbath, when earth was settled. Praise, song of David. The Lord reigned; he clothed himself with beauty, the Lord clothed himself with power and girded himself; for he also made firm inhabited world which will not be shaken.

**Psalms 92:2**

Your throne ready from then; from age you are.

**Psalms 92:3**

Rivers lifted up, Lord, rivers lifted up their voices.

**Psalms 92:4**

From voices of many waters, wondrous the surges of sea; wondrous in heights Lord.

**Psalms 92:5**

Your testimonies were made very faithful; holiness fits your house, Lord, for the length of days.

#### Chapter 93

**Psalms 93:1**

Psalm of David, fourth of Sabbaths. God of vengeances, Lord; God of vengeances spoke openly.

**Psalms 93:2**

Be exalted, judge of earth; repay recompense to proud ones.

**Psalms 93:3**

How long, sinners, Lord, how long will sinners boast?

**Psalms 93:4**

They will utter and speak injustice; all workers of lawlessness will speak.

**Psalms 93:5**

Your people, Lord, they humbled, and your inheritance they afflicted.

**Psalms 93:6**

Widow and sojourner they killed, and orphans they murdered.

**Psalms 93:7**

And they said, the Lord will not see, nor will God of Jacob understand.

**Psalms 93:8**

Understand now, foolish ones among people, and senseless ones, when will you understand?

**Psalms 93:9**

One planting ear, does he not hear? One forming eye, does he not perceive?

**Psalms 93:10**

One disciplining nations, will he not reprove? One teaching man knowledge?

**Psalms 93:11**

The Lord knows thoughts of men, that they are vain.

**Psalms 93:12**

Blessed is the man whom you discipline, Lord, and teach from your law,

**Psalms 93:13**

to make him gentle away from evil days until pit be dug for sinner.

**Psalms 93:14**

Because the Lord will not reject his people and will not forsake his inheritance,

**Psalms 93:15**

until righteousness returns to judgment, and all straight in heart close behind it. Interlude.

**Psalms 93:16**

Who will rise for me against evil-doers, or who will stand with me against workers of lawlessness?

**Psalms 93:17**

If not that the Lord helped me, my soul would almost have dwelt in Hades.

**Psalms 93:18**

If I said, My foot was shaken, your mercy, Lord, was helping me.

**Psalms 93:19**

Lord, according to the multitude of my pains in my heart, your comforts loved my soul.

**Psalms 93:20**

Will throne of lawlessness join itself with you, one fashioning labor by ordinance?

**Psalms 93:21**

They will hunt against soul of a righteous man and condemn innocent blood.

**Psalms 93:22**

And the Lord became refuge to me, and my God helper of my hope.

**Psalms 93:23**

And he will repay them their lawlessness and in their evil he will destroy them, Lord our God.

#### Chapter 94

**Psalms 94:1**

Praise, song of David. Come, let us exult in the Lord; let us shout to God our savior.

**Psalms 94:2**

Let us come before his face in confession, and in psalms let us shout to him.

**Psalms 94:3**

Because great God Lord and great king over all gods,

**Psalms 94:4**

because ends of the earth in his hand and heights of mountains his.

**Psalms 94:5**

Because sea his and he made it, and dry land his hands formed.

**Psalms 94:6**

Come, let us worship and fall down before him and weep before the Lord who made us,

**Psalms 94:7**

because he our God and we people of his pasture and sheep of his hand. Today, if you hear his voice,

**Psalms 94:8**
