do not harden your hearts as in provocation, according to day of testing in the wilderness,

**Psalms 94:9**

where your fathers tested me, tried me, and saw my works.

**Psalms 94:10**

Forty years I felt loathing toward that generation and said, They always go astray in heart, and they did not know my ways,

**Psalms 94:11**

as I swore in my anger, They will not enter into my rest.

#### Chapter 95

**Psalms 95:1**

When house was being built after captivity. Song of David. Sing to the Lord new song; sing to the Lord, all the earth.

**Psalms 95:2**

Sing to the Lord; bless his name; bring good news day from day of his salvation.

**Psalms 95:3**

Declare among nations his glory, among all peoples his wonders.

**Psalms 95:4**

Because great Lord and greatly praised; fearful he over all gods.

**Psalms 95:5**

Because all gods of nations demons, but the Lord made heavens.

**Psalms 95:6**

Confession and beauty before him, holiness and magnificence in his sanctuary.

**Psalms 95:7**

Bring to the Lord, families of nations, bring to the Lord glory and honor.

**Psalms 95:8**

Bring to the Lord glory to his name; take sacrifices and enter into his courts.

**Psalms 95:9**

Worship the Lord in his holy court; let all the earth be shaken from before him.

**Psalms 95:10**

Say among nations, the Lord reigned, for he also set inhabited world straight, which will not be shaken; he will judge peoples in uprightness.

**Psalms 95:11**

Let heavens rejoice and earth exult; let sea be shaken and its fullness.

**Psalms 95:12**

Fields will be glad and all things in them; then all trees of the forest will exult

**Psalms 95:13**

before the Lord, because he comes, because he comes to judge earth; he will judge inhabited world in righteousness and peoples in his truth.

#### Chapter 96

**Psalms 96:1**

Of David, when his land is established. The Lord reigned; let earth exult; let many islands rejoice.

**Psalms 96:2**

Cloud and gloom around him; righteousness and judgment correction of his throne.

**Psalms 96:3**

Fire will go before him and flame around his enemies.

**Psalms 96:4**

His lightnings shone to inhabited world; earth saw and was shaken.

**Psalms 96:5**

Mountains melted like wax from the face of the Lord, from the face of the Lord of all the earth.

**Psalms 96:6**

Heavens declared his righteousness, and all peoples saw his glory.

**Psalms 96:7**

Let all worshiping carved images be shamed, those boasting in their idols; worship him, all his angels.

**Psalms 96:8**

Zion heard and rejoiced, and daughters of Judah exulted because of your judgments, Lord.

**Psalms 96:9**

Because you are Lord, Most High over all the earth; you were greatly exalted above all gods.

**Psalms 96:10**

You who love the Lord, hate evil; The Lord guards the souls of his holy ones; from the hand of sinners he will rescue them.

**Psalms 96:11**

Light arose for a righteous one, and gladness for the straight in heart.

**Psalms 96:12**

Rejoice, righteous ones, in the Lord, and confess to memory of his holiness.

#### Chapter 97

**Psalms 97:1**

Psalm of David. Sing to the Lord new song, because the Lord did wondrous things; his right hand saved for him, and his holy arm.

**Psalms 97:2**

The Lord made known his salvation; before nations he revealed his righteousness.

**Psalms 97:3**

He remembered his mercy to Jacob and his truth to the house of Israel; all ends of the earth saw salvation of our God.

**Psalms 97:4**

Shout to God, all the earth; sing and exult and make melody.

**Psalms 97:5**

Make melody to the Lord with lyre, with lyre and voice of psalm,

**Psalms 97:6**

with hammered trumpets and voice of horn trumpet; shout before the king, Lord.

**Psalms 97:7**

Let sea be shaken and its fullness, inhabited world and those dwelling in it.

**Psalms 97:8**

Rivers will clap with hand; together mountains will exult,

**Psalms 97:9**

because he comes to judge earth; he will judge inhabited world in righteousness and peoples in uprightness.

#### Chapter 98

**Psalms 98:1**

Psalm of David. The Lord reigned; let peoples be angry; one sitting upon cherubim, let earth be shaken.

**Psalms 98:2**

The Lord great in Zion and high over all peoples.

**Psalms 98:3**

Let them confess to your name, the great one, because it fearful and holy.

**Psalms 98:4**

And honor of the king loves judgment. You prepared uprightnesses; judgment and righteousness in Jacob you did.

**Psalms 98:5**

Exalt the Lord our God and worship at footstool of his feet, because holy he is.

**Psalms 98:6**

Moses and Aaron among his priests and Samuel among those calling on his name; they called on the Lord, and he heard them.

**Psalms 98:7**

In the pillar of cloud he spoke to them; they kept his testimonies and ordinances he gave them.

**Psalms 98:8**

Lord our God, you heard them; O God, you became propitious to them and avenging over all their practices.

**Psalms 98:9**

Exalt the Lord our God and worship at his holy mountain, because holy is the Lord our God.

#### Chapter 99

**Psalms 99:1**

Psalm for confession. Shout to the Lord, all the earth.

**Psalms 99:2**

Serve the Lord with gladness; enter before him with exultation.

**Psalms 99:3**

Know that Lord, he is God; he made us, and not we ourselves, his people and sheep of his pasture.

**Psalms 99:4**

Enter his gates in confession, his courts in hymns; confess to him, praise his name.

**Psalms 99:5**

Because the Lord kind; forever his mercy, and unto generation and generation his truth.

#### Chapter 100

**Psalms 100:1**

Of David. Psalm. Mercy and judgment I will sing to you, Lord.

**Psalms 100:2**

I will sing and understand in blameless way. When will you come to me? I walked in the innocence of my heart in the midst of my house.

**Psalms 100:3**

I did not set before my eyes lawless thing; those doing transgressions I hated.

**Psalms 100:4**

Crooked heart did not cling to me; when evil one turned away from me, I did not know him.

**Psalms 100:5**

One slandering his neighbor secretly, this one I drove out; one with proud eye and insatiable heart, with this one I did not eat.

**Psalms 100:6**

My eyes upon faithful ones of earth, so that they may sit with me; one walking in blameless way, this one served me.

**Psalms 100:7**

One doing pride did not dwell in the midst of my house; one speaking unjust things did not go straight before my eyes.

**Psalms 100:8**

In mornings I killed all sinners of earth, to destroy from the city of the Lord all workers of lawlessness.

#### Chapter 101

**Psalms 101:1**

Prayer for the poor man, when he grows faint and pours out his supplication before the Lord.

**Psalms 101:2**

Hear, Lord, my prayer, and let my cry come to you.

**Psalms 101:3**

Do not turn your face from me in whatever day I am afflicted; incline your ear to me; in whatever day I call on you, quickly hear me.

**Psalms 101:4**

Because my days failed like smoke, and my bones were scorched like brushwood.

**Psalms 101:5**

My heart was struck like grass and dried up, because I forgot to eat my bread.

**Psalms 101:6**

From the voice of my groaning, my bone clung to my flesh.

**Psalms 101:7**

I became like a desert pelican; I became like night-raven in ruined place.

**Psalms 101:8**

I kept watch and became like a sparrow solitary on housetop.

**Psalms 101:9**

Whole day my enemies reproached me, and those praising me swore against me.

**Psalms 101:10**

Because I ate ash like bread and mixed my drink with weeping,

**Psalms 101:11**

from the face of your anger and your fury, because lifting me up you dashed me down.

**Psalms 101:12**

My days declined like a shadow, and I dried up like grass.

**Psalms 101:13**

But you, Lord, remain forever, and your memorial to generation and generation.

**Psalms 101:14**

You, rising up, will have compassion on Zion, because time to pity her, because time came.

**Psalms 101:15**

Because your servants took pleasure in her stones and will pity her dust.

**Psalms 101:16**

And nations will fear the name of the Lord, and all kings of the earth your glory.

**Psalms 101:17**

Because the Lord will build Zion and will be seen in his glory.

**Psalms 101:18**

He looked upon the prayer of humble ones and did not despise their supplication.

**Psalms 101:19**

Let this be written for another generation, and people being created will praise the Lord,

**Psalms 101:20**

because he looked down from the height of his holy place; The Lord from heaven looked upon earth,

**Psalms 101:21**

to hear groaning of chained ones, to loose sons of those put to death,

**Psalms 101:22**

to declare in Zion the name of the Lord and his praise in Jerusalem,

**Psalms 101:23**

when peoples are gathered together and kingdoms to serve Lord.

**Psalms 101:24**

He answered him in the way of his strength, Tell me fewness of my days.

**Psalms 101:25**

Do not bring me up in half of my days; your years through the generations of generations.

**Psalms 101:26**

At beginnings, you, Lord, founded earth, and heavens works of your hands.

**Psalms 101:27**

They will perish, but you remain; and all will grow old like a garment, and like a cloak you will change them, and they will be changed.

**Psalms 101:28**

But you same, and your years will not fail.

**Psalms 101:29**

Sons of your servants will dwell, and their seed will be directed forever.

#### Chapter 102

**Psalms 102:1**

Of David. Bless the Lord, my soul, and all within me, his holy name.

**Psalms 102:2**

Bless the Lord, my soul, and do not forget all his repayments,

**Psalms 102:3**

the one propitiating all your lawlessnesses, the one healing all your diseases,

**Psalms 102:4**

the one redeeming your life from corruption, the one crowning you in mercy and compassions,

**Psalms 102:5**

the one filling your desire with good things; your youth will be renewed like an eagle.

**Psalms 102:6**

The Lord doing mercies and judgment for all suffering injustice.

**Psalms 102:7**

He made known his ways to Moses, to the sons of Israel his wills.

**Psalms 102:8**

Compassionate and merciful Lord, long-suffering and rich in mercy.

**Psalms 102:9**

He will not be angry to end, nor rage forever.

**Psalms 102:10**

Not according to our sins did he do to us, nor according to our lawlessnesses did he repay us.

**Psalms 102:11**

Because according to height of heaven from earth, the Lord strengthened his mercy upon those fearing him.

**Psalms 102:12**

As far as east from west, he removed our lawlessnesses from us.

**Psalms 102:13**

As father has compassion on sons, the Lord had compassion on those fearing him.

**Psalms 102:14**

Because he knew our formation; remember that we are dust.

**Psalms 102:15**

Man, his days like grass; like a flower of field, so he will flower.

**Psalms 102:16**

Because wind passed in him and he will not exist, and he will no longer know his place.

**Psalms 102:17**

But mercy of the Lord from age and until age upon those fearing him, and his righteousness upon the sons of sons,

**Psalms 102:18**

to those keeping his covenant and remembering his commandments to do them.

**Psalms 102:19**

The Lord prepared his throne in heaven, and his kingdom rules all.

**Psalms 102:20**

Bless the Lord, all his angels, mighty in strength, doing his word, to hear the voice of his words.

**Psalms 102:21**

Bless the Lord, all his powers, his ministers doing his will.

**Psalms 102:22**

Bless the Lord, all his works, in every place of his lordship; bless the Lord, my soul.

#### Chapter 103

**Psalms 103:1**

Of David. Bless the Lord, my soul. Lord my God, you were made exceedingly great; confession and beauty you clothed yourself with,

**Psalms 103:2**

wrapping yourself in light like a garment, stretching out heaven like skin,

**Psalms 103:3**

roofing his upper rooms in waters, setting clouds as his ascent, walking on the wings of winds,

**Psalms 103:4**

making his angels spirits and his ministers flaming fire,

**Psalms 103:5**

who founded earth on its security; it will not be inclined forever and ever.

**Psalms 103:6**

Deep like a garment its covering; on mountains waters will stand.

**Psalms 103:7**

From your rebuke they will flee; from the voice of your thunder they will fear.

**Psalms 103:8**

Mountains go up and plains go down to place which you founded for them.

**Psalms 103:9**

You set boundary they will not pass, nor return to cover earth.

**Psalms 103:10**

One sending out springs in valleys; among mountains waters will pass.

**Psalms 103:11**

They give drink to all the beasts of the field; wild donkeys will receive for their thirst.

**Psalms 103:12**

Upon them birds of heaven will dwell; from the midst of rocks they will give voice.

**Psalms 103:13**

One watering mountains from his upper rooms; from the fruit of your works earth will be satisfied.

**Psalms 103:14**

One causing grass to spring up for cattle and green plant for the service of men, to bring bread out of earth,

**Psalms 103:15**

and wine gladdens the heart of man, to brighten the face with oil, and bread strengthens the heart of man.

**Psalms 103:16**

The trees of the plain will be filled, cedars of Lebanon which he planted.

**Psalms 103:17**

There sparrows will nest; house of stork leads them.

**Psalms 103:18**

High mountains for deer, rock refuge for rock-badgers.

**Psalms 103:19**

He made moon for seasons; sun knew its setting.

**Psalms 103:20**

You set darkness, and night came; in it all beasts of the forest will pass through.

**Psalms 103:21**

Lion-cubs roaring to seize and to seek food for themselves from God.

**Psalms 103:22**

Sun rose, and they were gathered, and in their dens they will lie down.

**Psalms 103:23**

Man will go out to his work and to his labor until evening.

**Psalms 103:24**

How your works were magnified, Lord; in wisdom you made all. Earth was filled with your creation.

**Psalms 103:25**

This sea, great and broad-spaced: there creeping things without number, small animals with great.

**Psalms 103:26**

There ships pass through; this dragon you formed to play in it.

**Psalms 103:27**

All look to you to give food to them in due season.

**Psalms 103:28**

When you give to them, they will gather; when you open your hand, all things will be filled with goodness.

**Psalms 103:29**

When you turn away your face, they will be troubled; you will take away their spirit, and they will fail and return to their dust.

**Psalms 103:30**

You send out your spirit, and they will be created, and you renew face of the earth.

**Psalms 103:31**

Let the glory of the Lord be forever; The Lord will rejoice in his works,

**Psalms 103:32**

one looking upon earth and making it tremble, one touching mountains and they smoke.

**Psalms 103:33**

I will sing to the Lord in my life; I will make melody to my God while I exist.

**Psalms 103:34**

Let my discourse be sweet to him; and I will rejoice in the Lord.

**Psalms 103:35**

Let sinners fail from earth, and lawless ones so as not to exist. Bless the Lord, my soul.

#### Chapter 104

**Psalms 104:1**

Alleluia. Confess to the Lord and call on his name; declare among nations his works.

**Psalms 104:2**

Sing to him and make melody to him; recount all his wonders.

**Psalms 104:3**

Praise in his holy name; let heart of those seeking the Lord rejoice.

**Psalms 104:4**

Seek the Lord and be strengthened; seek his face continually.

**Psalms 104:5**

Remember his wonders which he did, his portents and judgments of his mouth,

**Psalms 104:6**

seed of Abraham, his servants, sons of Jacob, his chosen ones.

**Psalms 104:7**

He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.

**Psalms 104:8**

He remembered his covenant forever, word which he commanded for thousand generations,

**Psalms 104:9**

which he arranged with Abraham and his oath to Isaac.

**Psalms 104:10**

And he set it to Jacob for ordinance and to Israel everlasting covenant,

**Psalms 104:11**

saying, To you I will give the land of Canaan, line-measure of your inheritance,

**Psalms 104:12**

when they were few in number, very few and sojourners in it,

**Psalms 104:13**

and they passed from nation to nation, from kingdom to another people.

**Psalms 104:14**

He did not allow man to do them injustice, and he reproved kings for their sake:

**Psalms 104:15**

Do not touch my anointed ones, and in my prophets do not do evil.

**Psalms 104:16**

And he called famine upon earth; he crushed every support of bread.

**Psalms 104:17**

He sent before them man; Joseph was sold for slave.

**Psalms 104:18**

They humbled his feet in shackles; iron went through his soul,

**Psalms 104:19**

until his word came; saying of the Lord refined him.

**Psalms 104:20**

King sent and loosed him, ruler of peoples and released him.

**Psalms 104:21**

He made him lord of his house and ruler of all his possession,

**Psalms 104:22**

to discipline his rulers like himself and make his elders wise.

**Psalms 104:23**

And Israel entered into Egypt, and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

**Psalms 104:24**

And he increased his people exceedingly and strengthened it beyond its enemies.

**Psalms 104:25**

He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal deceitfully with his servants.

**Psalms 104:26**

He sent Moses his servant, Aaron whom he chose,

**Psalms 104:27**

he set among them words of his signs and portents in the land of Ham.

**Psalms 104:28**

He sent darkness and darkened, and they provoked his words.

**Psalms 104:29**

He turned their waters to blood and killed their fish.

**Psalms 104:30**

Their land teemed with frogs in the chambers of their kings.

**Psalms 104:31**

He spoke, and dog-fly came, and gnats in all their borders.

**Psalms 104:32**

He made their rains hail, burning fire in their land.

**Psalms 104:33**

And he struck their vines and their fig trees and shattered every tree of their border.

**Psalms 104:34**

He spoke, and locust came, and young locust without number,

**Psalms 104:35**

and devoured all grass in their land and devoured fruit of their earth.

**Psalms 104:36**

And he struck every firstborn in their land, firstfruits of all their labor.

**Psalms 104:37**

And he led them out with silver and gold, and there was none weak in their tribes.

**Psalms 104:38**

Egypt rejoiced in their departure, because fear of them fell upon them.

**Psalms 104:39**

He spread out cloud for covering to them and fire to give them light by night.

**Psalms 104:40**

They asked, and quail came, and bread of heaven filled them.

**Psalms 104:41**

He split rock and waters flowed; rivers went in waterless places.

**Psalms 104:42**

Because he remembered his holy word to Abraham his servant.

**Psalms 104:43**

And he led out his people with exultation and his chosen ones with gladness.

**Psalms 104:44**

And he gave them lands of nations, and they inherited labors of peoples,

**Psalms 104:45**

so that they might keep his ordinances and seek out his law.

#### Chapter 105

**Psalms 105:1**

Alleluia. Confess to the Lord, because kind, because his mercy forever.

**Psalms 105:2**

Who will speak powers of the Lord, make all his praises heard?

**Psalms 105:3**

Blessed are those keeping judgment and doing righteousness in every time.

**Psalms 105:4**

Remember us, Lord, in good pleasure of your people; visit us in your salvation,

**Psalms 105:5**

to see in goodness of your chosen ones, to rejoice in the gladness of your nation, to be praised with your inheritance.

**Psalms 105:6**

We sinned with our fathers, we acted lawlessly, we did injustice.

**Psalms 105:7**

Our fathers in Egypt did not understand your wonders; they did not remember multitude of your mercy and provoked while going up at Red Sea.

**Psalms 105:8**

And he saved them for the sake of his name, to make known his dominion.

**Psalms 105:9**

And he rebuked Red Sea and it dried up, and he guided them in deep as in the wilderness.

**Psalms 105:10**

And he saved them from the hand of those hating and redeemed them from the hand of enemy.

**Psalms 105:11**

And water covered those afflicting them; not one of them was left.

**Psalms 105:12**

And they believed in his words and sang his praise.

**Psalms 105:13**

They hurried, they forgot his works; they did not wait for his counsel.

**Psalms 105:14**

And they desired desire in the wilderness and tested God in waterless place.

**Psalms 105:15**

And he gave them their request and sent fullness into their souls.

**Psalms 105:16**

And they angered Moses in camp, and Aaron, holy one of the Lord.

**Psalms 105:17**

Earth opened and swallowed Dathan and covered over assembly of Abiram.

**Psalms 105:18**

And fire burned in their assembly; flame consumed sinners.

**Psalms 105:19**

And they made calf in Horeb and worshiped carved image.

**Psalms 105:20**

And they exchanged their glory for likeness of calf eating grass.

**Psalms 105:21**

They forgot God saving them, one doing great things in Egypt,

**Psalms 105:22**

wondrous things in the land of Ham, fearful things by Red Sea.

**Psalms 105:23**

And he said to destroy them, if not Moses, his chosen one, stood in breaking before him to turn back his anger, so as not to destroy.

**Psalms 105:24**

And they despised desirable land; they did not believe his word.

**Psalms 105:25**

And they grumbled in their tents; they did not hear the voice of the Lord.

**Psalms 105:26**

And he raised his hand against them, to cast them down in the wilderness,

**Psalms 105:27**

and to cast down their seed among nations and scatter them in lands.

**Psalms 105:28**

And they were joined to Baal-peor and ate sacrifices of dead ones.

**Psalms 105:29**

And they provoked him in their practices, and falling was multiplied among them.

**Psalms 105:30**

And Phinehas stood and propitiated, and breaking ceased.

**Psalms 105:31**

And it was counted to him as righteousness from generation to generation forever.

**Psalms 105:32**

And they angered him at the water of contradiction, and Moses was harmed because of them,

**Psalms 105:33**

because they provoked his spirit, and he distinguished with his lips.

**Psalms 105:34**

They did not destroy nations which the Lord told them,

**Psalms 105:35**

and they mixed among nations and learned their works.

**Psalms 105:36**

And they served their carved images, and it became to them stumbling-block.

**Psalms 105:37**

And they sacrificed their sons and daughters to demons,

**Psalms 105:38**

and poured out innocent blood, blood of their sons and daughters whom they sacrificed to carved images of Canaan, and land was stained with bloods.

**Psalms 105:39**

And they were defiled in their works and prostituted in their practices.

**Psalms 105:40**

And the Lord was angered in fury against his people and abhorred his inheritance.

**Psalms 105:41**

And he handed them into the hands of nations, and those hating them ruled over them.

**Psalms 105:42**

And their enemies afflicted them, and they were humbled under their hands.

**Psalms 105:43**

Many times he rescued them, but they provoked him in their counsel and were humbled in their lawlessnesses.

**Psalms 105:44**

And he saw when they were afflicted, when he heard their supplication.

**Psalms 105:45**

And he remembered his covenant and relented according to the multitude of his mercy.

**Psalms 105:46**

And he gave them into compassions before all who had taken them captive.

**Psalms 105:47**

Save us, O Lord our God, and gather us from the nations, to confess to your holy name, to boast in your praise.

**Psalms 105:48**

Blessed is the Lord God of Israel from age and until age, and let all the people say, Amen, amen.

#### Chapter 106

**Psalms 106:1**

Alleluia. Confess to the Lord, because kind, because his mercy forever.

**Psalms 106:2**

Let those redeemed by the Lord say so, whom he redeemed from the hand of enemy

**Psalms 106:3**

and gathered them from lands, from east and west and north and sea.

**Psalms 106:4**

They wandered in the wilderness, in waterless place; they did not find way of the city of dwelling.

**Psalms 106:5**

Hungry and thirsty, their soul in them failed.

**Psalms 106:6**

And they cried to the Lord when they were afflicted, and from their necessities he rescued them.

**Psalms 106:7**

And he guided them in straight way to go into the city of dwelling.

**Psalms 106:8**

Let them confess to the Lord his mercies and his wonders to the sons of men,

**Psalms 106:9**

because he satisfied empty soul, and hungry soul he filled with good things.

**Psalms 106:10**

Those sitting in darkness and the shadow of death, chained in poverty and iron,

**Psalms 106:11**

because they provoked the words of God and angered counsel of Most High.

**Psalms 106:12**

And their heart was humbled in labors; they grew weak, and there was none helping.

**Psalms 106:13**

And they cried to the Lord when they were afflicted, and from their necessities he saved them.

**Psalms 106:14**

And he led them out from darkness and the shadow of death and tore apart their bonds.

**Psalms 106:15**

Let them confess to the Lord his mercies and his wonders to the sons of men,

**Psalms 106:16**

because he shattered bronze gates and broke iron bars.

**Psalms 106:17**

He took hold of them out of way of their lawlessnesses, for because of their lawlessnesses they were humbled.

**Psalms 106:18**

Their soul abhorred all food, and they drew near to the gates of death.

**Psalms 106:19**

And they cried to the Lord when they were afflicted, and from their necessities he saved them.

**Psalms 106:20**

He sent his word and healed them and rescued them from their corruptions.

**Psalms 106:21**

Let them confess to the Lord his mercies and his wonders to the sons of men,

**Psalms 106:22**

and let them offer a sacrifice of praise and declare his works in exultation.

**Psalms 106:23**

Those going down into sea in ships, doing business in many waters,

**Psalms 106:24**

they saw works of the Lord and his wonders in deep.

**Psalms 106:25**

He spoke, and storm wind stood, and its waves were lifted up.

**Psalms 106:26**

They go up to heavens and go down to deeps; their soul in evils was melting.

**Psalms 106:27**

They were troubled, they were shaken like a drunkard, and all their wisdom was swallowed up.

**Psalms 106:28**

And they cried to the Lord when they were afflicted, and from their necessities he brought them out.

**Psalms 106:29**

And he commanded storm, and it stood to breeze, and its waves were silent.

**Psalms 106:30**

And they rejoiced because they were quiet, and he guided them to harbor of their will.

**Psalms 106:31**

Let them confess to the Lord his mercies and his wonders to the sons of men,

**Psalms 106:32**

let them exalt him in the assembly of the people, and in the seat of elders let them praise him.

**Psalms 106:33**

He made rivers into desert and outgoings of waters into thirst,

**Psalms 106:34**

fruitful land into salt-flat because of evil of those dwelling in it.

**Psalms 106:35**

He made desert into pools of waters and waterless land into outgoings of waters.

**Psalms 106:36**

And he settled there hungry ones, and they established city of dwelling.

**Psalms 106:37**

And they sowed fields and planted vineyards and made fruit of produce.

**Psalms 106:38**

And he blessed them, and they multiplied exceedingly, and their cattle he did not lessen.

**Psalms 106:39**

And they were few and afflicted from the affliction of evils and pain.

**Psalms 106:40**

Contempt was poured out upon rulers, and he made them wander in trackless place and not way.

**Psalms 106:41**

And he helped a poor man out of poverty and made families like sheep.

**Psalms 106:42**

Straight ones will see and rejoice, and all lawlessness will shut its mouth.

**Psalms 106:43**

Who wise and will keep these things? And they will understand mercies of the Lord.

#### Chapter 107

**Psalms 107:1**

Song of psalm of David.

**Psalms 107:2**

Ready my heart, O God, ready my heart; I will sing and make melody in my glory.

**Psalms 107:3**

Awake, psaltery and lyre; I will awake at dawn.

**Psalms 107:4**

I will confess to you among peoples, Lord, and sing to you among nations,

**Psalms 107:5**

because great above heavens your mercy and unto clouds your truth.

**Psalms 107:6**

Be exalted above heavens, O God, and over all the earth your glory.

**Psalms 107:7**

So that your beloved ones may be rescued, save with your right hand and hear me.

**Psalms 107:8**

God spoke in his holy place: I will be exalted and divide Shechem and valley of tents I will measure out.

**Psalms 107:9**

Mine Gilead and mine Manasseh, and Ephraim support of my head, Judah my king.

**Psalms 107:10**

Moab cauldron of my hope; upon Edom I will stretch out my sandal; foreigners were subjected to me.

**Psalms 107:11**

Who will bring me into fortified city? Who will guide me as far as Edom?

**Psalms 107:12**

Is it not you, O God, who rejected us? And God will not go out with our powers.

**Psalms 107:13**

Give us help from affliction, and salvation of man is vain.

**Psalms 107:14**

In God we will do mighty deed, and he will despise our enemies.

#### Chapter 108

**Psalms 108:1**

For end, of David, psalm. O God, my praise, do not pass over in silence,

**Psalms 108:2**

because the mouth of a sinner and the mouth of a deceitful one opened against me; they spoke against me with a deceitful tongue.

**Psalms 108:3**

And with the words of hatred they surrounded me and fought me without cause.

**Psalms 108:4**

Instead of loving me they slandered me, but I was praying.

**Psalms 108:5**

And they set against me evils for good things and hatred for my love.

**Psalms 108:6**

Appoint sinner over him, and let devil stand at his right hand.

**Psalms 108:7**

When he is judged, let him go out condemned, and let his prayer become sin.

**Psalms 108:8**

Let his days become few, and let another take his oversight.

**Psalms 108:9**

Let his sons become orphans and his wife widow.

**Psalms 108:10**

Trembling, let his sons wander and beg; let them be cast out from their homesteads.

**Psalms 108:11**

Let lender search out all things he has; let strangers plunder his labors.

**Psalms 108:12**

Let there be no supporter for him, nor let there be one compassionate to his orphans.

**Psalms 108:13**

Let his children be for destruction; in one generation let his name be blotted out.

**Psalms 108:14**

Let lawlessness of his fathers be remembered before the Lord, and sin of his mother let it not be blotted out.

**Psalms 108:15**

Let them be before the Lord continually, and let their memory be destroyed from earth,

**Psalms 108:16**

because he did not remember to do mercy and pursued poor and needy man and one pierced in heart to kill.

**Psalms 108:17**

And he loved curse, and it will come to him; and he did not want blessing, and it will be far from him.

**Psalms 108:18**

And he clothed himself with curse like a garment, and it entered like water into his inward parts and like oil into his bones.

**Psalms 108:19**

Let it become to him like a garment he wraps around and like belt which he girds continually.

**Psalms 108:20**

This work of those slandering me from the Lord and of those speaking evil against my soul.

**Psalms 108:21**

But you, Lord, Lord, deal mercifully with me for the sake of your name, because your mercy kind.

**Psalms 108:22**

Rescue me, because I poor and needy, and my heart troubled within me.

**Psalms 108:23**

Like shadow in its decline I was taken away; I was shaken out like locusts.

**Psalms 108:24**

My knees grew weak from fasting, and my flesh was changed away from oil.

**Psalms 108:25**

And I became a reproach to them; they saw me and shook their heads.

**Psalms 108:26**

Help me, Lord my God; save me according to your mercy.

**Psalms 108:27**

And let them know that this your hand, and you, Lord, did it.

**Psalms 108:28**

They will curse, but you will bless; those rising against me let them be shamed, but your servant will rejoice.

**Psalms 108:29**

Let those slandering me be clothed in shame and wrap their shame around themselves like double-cloak.

**Psalms 108:30**

I will confess to the Lord exceedingly with my mouth, and in the midst of many I will praise him,

**Psalms 108:31**

because he stood at the right hand of a poor man to save from those pursuing my soul.

#### Chapter 109

**Psalms 109:1**

Of David. Psalm. The Lord said to my Lord, Sit at my right hand until I place your enemies footstool of your feet.

**Psalms 109:2**

The Lord will send rod of your power from Zion, and rule in the midst of your enemies.

**Psalms 109:3**

With you beginning in the day of your power, in splendors of holy ones; from womb before morning-star I begot you.

**Psalms 109:4**

The Lord swore and will not regret, You priest forever according to order of Melchizedek.

**Psalms 109:5**

The Lord at your right hand crushed kings in the day of his anger.

**Psalms 109:6**

He will judge among nations, he will fill corpses, he will crush heads over the land of many.

**Psalms 109:7**

From torrent in way he will drink; therefore he will lift up head.

#### Chapter 110

**Psalms 110:1**

Alleluia. I will confess to you, Lord, with all my heart, in the council of straight ones and gathering.

**Psalms 110:2**

Great works of the Lord, sought out for all his wills.

**Psalms 110:3**

Confession and magnificence his work, and his righteousness remains forever and ever.

**Psalms 110:4**

He made remembrance of his wonders; merciful and compassionate Lord.

**Psalms 110:5**

He gave food to those fearing him; he will remember his covenant forever.

**Psalms 110:6**

He declared strength of his works to his people, to give them inheritance of nations.

**Psalms 110:7**

The works of his hands truth and judgment; all his commandments faithful,

**Psalms 110:8**

**Psalms 110:9**

**Psalms 110:10**

#### Chapter 111

**Psalms 111:1**

Alleluia. Blessed is the man fearing the Lord; in his commandments he will desire greatly.

**Psalms 111:2**

His seed will be mighty in earth; generation of straight ones will be blessed.

**Psalms 111:3**

Glory and wealth are in his house, and his righteousness remains forever and ever.

**Psalms 111:4**

**Psalms 111:5**

Good man, one showing compassion and lending, will manage his matters in judgment,

**Psalms 111:6**

**Psalms 111:7**

**Psalms 111:8**

**Psalms 111:9**

**Psalms 111:10**

#### Chapter 112

**Psalms 112:1**

Alleluia. Praise, servants, Lord; praise the name of the Lord.

**Psalms 112:2**

Let the name of the Lord be blessed from now and until age.

**Psalms 112:3**

From risings of sun until settings, praise the name of the Lord.

**Psalms 112:4**

High over all nations Lord, above heavens his glory.

**Psalms 112:5**

Who is like the Lord our God, the one dwelling in heights,

**Psalms 112:6**

and watching low things in heaven and on earth,

**Psalms 112:7**

one raising poor from earth and lifting needy from dung-heap,

**Psalms 112:8**

**Psalms 112:9**

one settling barren woman in a house, joyful mother of children.

#### Chapter 113

**Psalms 113:1**

Alleluia. When Israel went out from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a barbarous people,

**Psalms 113:2**

Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his authority.

**Psalms 113:3**

Sea saw and fled; Jordan turned backward.

**Psalms 113:4**

Mountains skipped like rams, and hills like lambs of sheep.

**Psalms 113:5**

What is with you, sea, that you fled, and you, Jordan, that you turned back?

**Psalms 113:6**

Mountains, why did you skip like rams, and hills like lambs of sheep?

**Psalms 113:7**

From the face of the Lord earth was shaken, from the face of God of Jacob,

**Psalms 113:8**

who turned rock into pools of waters and flint into springs of waters.

**Psalms 113:9**

Not to us, Lord, not to us, but to your name give glory, upon your mercy and your truth.

**Psalms 113:10**

Lest nations say, Where is their God?

**Psalms 113:11**

But our God above in heaven, in heavens and on earth, all things whatever he wanted he did.

**Psalms 113:12**

The idols of nations silver and gold, works of the hands of men.

**Psalms 113:13**

They have mouth and will not speak, eyes and will not see,

**Psalms 113:14**

they have ears and will not hear, noses and will not smell,

**Psalms 113:15**

they have hands and will not feel, feet and will not walk; they will not make sound in their throat.

**Psalms 113:16**

Let those making them become like them, and all trusting in them.

**Psalms 113:17**

The house of Israel hoped on the Lord; he is their helper and defender.

**Psalms 113:18**

The house of Aaron hoped on the Lord; he is their helper and defender.

**Psalms 113:19**

Those fearing the Lord hoped on the Lord; he is their helper and defender.

**Psalms 113:20**

The Lord remembered us and blessed us; he blessed the house of Israel, he blessed the house of Aaron.

**Psalms 113:21**

He blessed those fearing the Lord, small with great.

**Psalms 113:22**

May the Lord add upon you, upon you and upon your sons.

**Psalms 113:23**

Blessed are you by the Lord, who made heaven and earth.

**Psalms 113:24**

The heaven of heaven belongs to the Lord, but the earth he gave to the sons of men.

**Psalms 113:25**

**Psalms 113:26**

#### Chapter 114

**Psalms 114:1**

Alleluia. I loved because the Lord will hear the voice of my supplication,

**Psalms 114:2**

because he inclined his ear to me, and in my days I will call upon him.

**Psalms 114:3**

The pangs of death surrounded me, dangers of Hades found me; affliction and pain I found.

**Psalms 114:4**

#### Chapter 119

**Psalms 119:7**

**Psalms 128:3**

On my back sinners built; they lengthened their lawlessness.

**Psalms 128:4**

The righteous Lord cut necks of sinners.

**Psalms 128:5**

Let all hating Zion be shamed and turned backward.

**Psalms 128:6**

Let them become like grass of housetops, which before being pulled up dried up.

**Psalms 128:7**

With which reaper did not fill his hand, nor gatherer of sheaves his bosom.

**Psalms 128:8**

And passersby did not say, "Blessing of the Lord upon you; we blessed you in the name of the Lord."

#### Chapter 129

**Psalms 129:1**

Song of ascents. Out of the depths I cried to you, Lord.

**Psalms 129:2**

Lord, hear my voice; let your ears attend to the voice of my supplication.

**Psalms 129:3**

If you should watch lawless deeds, Lord, Lord, who will stand?

**Psalms 129:4**

Because with you propitiation.

**Psalms 129:5**

For the sake of your law I waited for you, Lord; my soul waited for your word.

**Psalms 129:6**

My soul hoped in the Lord from morning watch until night; from morning watch let Israel hope in the Lord.

**Psalms 129:7**

Because with the Lord mercy, and much redemption with him.

**Psalms 129:8**

And he will redeem Israel from all his lawless deeds.

#### Chapter 130

**Psalms 130:1**

Song of ascents. Of David. Lord, my heart is not exalted, nor my eyes raised high, nor I walked in great things nor in marvels beyond me.

**Psalms 130:2**

If not, I was humble-minded, but I lifted my soul like child weaned against its mother, like recompense upon my soul.

**Psalms 130:3**

Let Israel hope in the Lord from now and until age.

#### Chapter 131

**Psalms 131:1**

Song of ascents. Remember, Lord, David and all his gentleness.

**Psalms 131:2**

How he swore to the Lord, vowed to God of Jacob.

**Psalms 131:3**

If I enter tent of my house, if I go up upon the bed of my couch,

**Psalms 131:4**

if I give sleep to my eyes and slumber to my eyelids and rest to my temples,

**Psalms 131:5**

until I find place for the Lord, tabernacle for God of Jacob.

**Psalms 131:6**

Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah; we found it in fields of the wood.

**Psalms 131:7**

We will enter his tabernacles; we will worship at place where his feet stood.

**Psalms 131:8**

Rise, Lord, into your rest, you and ark of your holiness.

**Psalms 131:9**

Your priests will clothe themselves with righteousness, and your holy ones will exult.

**Psalms 131:10**

For the sake of David your servant, do not turn away face of your anointed.

**Psalms 131:11**

The Lord swore truth to David, and he will not set it aside: from the fruit of your belly I will set upon your throne.

**Psalms 131:12**

If your sons keep my covenant and these testimonies that I will teach them, their sons also forever will sit upon your throne.

**Psalms 131:13**

Because the Lord chose Zion; he chose her for dwelling to himself.

**Psalms 131:14**

This my resting-place forever and ever; here I will dwell, because I chose her.

**Psalms 131:15**

**Psalms 131:16**

**Psalms 131:17**

**Psalms 131:18**

#### Chapter 132

**Psalms 132:1**

Song of ascents. Of David. Behold now, what is good or what is pleasant, but brothers dwelling together.

**Psalms 132:2**

**Psalms 132:3**

#### Chapter 133

**Psalms 133:1**

Song of ascents. Behold now, bless the Lord, all servants of the Lord, standing in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our God.

**Psalms 133:2**

In nights lift your hands to holy things and bless the Lord.

**Psalms 133:3**

The Lord will bless you from Zion, maker of heaven and earth.

#### Chapter 134

**Psalms 134:1**

Alleluia. Praise the name of the Lord; praise the Lord, servants.

**Psalms 134:2**

Those standing in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our God.

**Psalms 134:3**

Praise the Lord, because the Lord is good; sing psalms to his name, because good.

**Psalms 134:4**

Because the Lord chose Jacob for himself, Israel for his special possession.

**Psalms 134:5**

Because I knew that the Lord is great, and our Lord is beyond all gods.

**Psalms 134:6**

All that the Lord wanted he did in heaven and on earth, in seas and in all deeps.

**Psalms 134:7**

Raising clouds from the ends of the earth, he made lightnings for rain, bringing winds from his treasuries.

**Psalms 134:8**

Who struck firstborn of Egypt, from man to beast.

**Psalms 134:9**

He sent signs and wonders into your midst, Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.

**Psalms 134:10**

Who struck many nations and killed mighty kings.

**Psalms 134:11**

Sihon king of Amorites and Og king of Bashan and all kingdoms of Canaan.

**Psalms 134:12**

And gave their land inheritance, inheritance to Israel his people.

**Psalms 134:13**

Lord, your name forever; Lord, your memorial from generation to generation.

**Psalms 134:14**

Because the Lord will judge his people and over his servants he will be comforted.

**Psalms 134:15**

The idols of nations silver and gold, works of the hands of men.

**Psalms 134:16**

Mouths they have and will not speak; eyes they have and will not see.

**Psalms 134:17**

Ears they have and will not hear; noses they have and will not smell; hands they have and will not feel; feet they have and will not walk; no sound in their throat, for no spirit in their mouth.

**Psalms 134:18**

Like them may those making them become, and all trusting in them.

**Psalms 134:19**

The house of Israel, bless the Lord; house of Aaron, bless the Lord.

**Psalms 134:20**

The house of Levi, bless the Lord; those fearing the Lord, bless the Lord.

**Psalms 134:21**

Blessed is the Lord from Zion, one dwelling in Jerusalem.

#### Chapter 135

**Psalms 135:1**

Alleluia. Give thanks to the Lord, because kind, because his mercy forever.

**Psalms 135:2**

Give thanks to the God of gods, because his mercy forever.

**Psalms 135:3**

Give thanks to the Lord of lords, because his mercy forever.

**Psalms 135:4**

To one doing great wonders alone, because his mercy forever.

**Psalms 135:5**

To one making heavens in understanding, because his mercy forever.

**Psalms 135:6**

To one establishing earth upon waters, because his mercy forever.

**Psalms 135:7**

To one making great lights alone, because his mercy forever.

**Psalms 135:10**

**Psalms 135:11**

**Psalms 135:12**

**Psalms 135:13**

To one cutting Red Sea into divisions, because his mercy forever.

**Psalms 135:14**

And leading Israel through its midst, because his mercy forever.

**Psalms 135:15**

**Psalms 135:16**

To one leading his people through wilderness, because his mercy forever; to one bringing water from sheer rock, because his mercy forever.

**Psalms 135:17**

To one striking great kings, because his mercy forever.

**Psalms 135:18**

And killing mighty kings, because his mercy forever.

**Psalms 135:19**

Sihon king of Amorites, because his mercy forever.

**Psalms 135:20**

And Og king of Bashan, because his mercy forever.

**Psalms 135:21**

And giving their land inheritance, because his mercy forever.

**Psalms 135:22**

Inheritance to Israel his servant, because his mercy forever.

**Psalms 135:23**

**Psalms 135:24**

**Psalms 135:25**

**Psalms 135:26**

#### Chapter 136

**Psalms 136:1**

Of David. By rivers of Babylon, there we sat and wept when remembering Zion.

**Psalms 136:2**

On willows in the midst of it we hung our instruments.

**Psalms 136:3**

**Psalms 136:4**

How should we sing song of the Lord on foreign land?

**Psalms 136:5**

If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand be forgotten.

**Psalms 136:6**

**Psalms 136:7**

**Psalms 136:9**

#### Chapter 137

**Psalms 137:1**

Of David. I will give thanks to you, Lord, with all my heart, because you heard sayings of my mouth; before angels I will sing psalms to you.

**Psalms 137:2**

I will worship toward your holy temple and give thanks to your name for your mercy and your truth, because you magnified your saying above every name.

**Psalms 137:3**

In whatever day I call on you, quickly hear me; with power in my soul you will greatly strengthen me.

**Psalms 137:4**

Let all kings of the earth give thanks to you, Lord, because they heard all sayings of your mouth.

**Psalms 137:5**

And let them sing in the ways of the Lord, because great is the glory of the Lord.

**Psalms 137:6**

Because the Lord high and looks upon humble things, and high things he knows from far away.

**Psalms 137:7**

If I walk in the midst of affliction, you will make me live; against anger of my enemies you stretched out your hand, and your right hand saved me.

**Psalms 137:8**

The Lord will repay on my behalf; Lord, your mercy forever. Works of your hands do not disregard.

#### Chapter 138

**Psalms 138:1**

For end. Psalm of David. Lord, you tested me and knew me.

**Psalms 138:2**

You knew my sitting down and my rising up; you understood my thoughts from far away.

**Psalms 138:3**

My path and my measuring line you traced out, and all my ways you foresaw.

**Psalms 138:4**

Because no word on my tongue—

**Psalms 138:5**

behold, the Lord, you knew all last things and first things; you formed me and laid your hand upon me.

**Psalms 138:6**

Your knowledge made wondrous beyond me; it grew strong; I will not be able toward it.

**Psalms 138:7**

Where should I go from your spirit, and where should I flee from your face?

**Psalms 138:8**

If I go up into heaven, you there; if I go down into Hades, present.

**Psalms 138:9**

If I take up my wings at dawn and dwell in uttermost parts of sea,

**Psalms 138:10**

even there your hand will guide me and your right hand will hold me fast.

**Psalms 138:11**

And I said, "Then darkness will trample me," yet night illumination in my delight.

**Psalms 138:12**

Because darkness will not be darkened from you, and night will be lit as day; as its darkness, so also its light.

**Psalms 138:13**

Because you acquired my inward parts, Lord; you took hold of me from my mother's womb.

**Psalms 138:14**

I will give thanks to you because fearfully I was made wondrous; wondrous your works, and my soul knows very much.

**Psalms 138:15**

My bone not hidden from you, which you made in secret, and my substance in lowest parts of earth.

**Psalms 138:16**

Your eyes saw my unformed thing, and in your book all will be written; days will be formed, and no one among them.

**Psalms 138:17**

To me your friends, God, were greatly honored; their chief ones grew very strong.

**Psalms 138:18**

I will number them, and beyond sand they will multiply; I awoke, and still I am with you.

**Psalms 138:19**

If only you would kill sinners, God; men of blood, turn aside from me.

**Psalms 138:20**

Because they speak of you for scheming; they will take your cities in vain.

**Psalms 138:21**

Did I not hate those hating you, Lord, and waste away over your enemies?

**Psalms 138:22**

With perfect hatred I hated them; they became enemies to me.

**Psalms 138:23**

Test me, God, and know my heart; examine me and know my paths.

**Psalms 138:24**

And see if way of lawlessness in me, and guide me in age-lasting way.

#### Chapter 139

**Psalms 139:1**

For end. Psalm of David.

**Psalms 139:2**

Rescue me, Lord, from evil man; from unjust man deliver me.

**Psalms 139:3**

Who devised injustices in heart; whole day they arrayed wars.

**Psalms 139:4**

They sharpened their tongue like serpent; venom of asps under their lips. Selah.

**Psalms 139:5**

Guard me, Lord, from the hand of sinner; from unjust men deliver me, who devised to trip my steps.

**Psalms 139:6**

Proud ones hid snare for me and stretched ropes; traps for my feet, beside path they set stumbling block for me. Selah.

**Psalms 139:7**

I said to the Lord, "My God you." Give ear, Lord, to the voice of my supplication.

**Psalms 139:8**

Lord, Lord, strength of my salvation, you overshadowed over my head in the day of war.

**Psalms 139:9**

Do not give me over, Lord, from my desire to sinner; they schemed against me; do not abandon me, lest they be exalted. Selah.

**Psalms 139:10**

The head of their encirclement—labor of their lips will cover them.

**Psalms 139:11**

Coals will fall upon them; in fire you will cast them down, in miseries they will not withstand.

**Psalms 139:12**

Tongue-man will not be directed on earth; evil will hunt unjust man into destruction.

**Psalms 139:13**

I knew the Lord will do judgment of a poor one and justice of the needy.

**Psalms 139:14**

Yet the righteous will give thanks to your name, and the upright will dwell with your face.

#### Chapter 140

**Psalms 140:1**

Psalm of David. Lord, I cried to you; hear me. Attend to the voice of my supplication when I cry to you.

**Psalms 140:2**

Let my prayer be set straight as incense before you, lifting up of my hands evening sacrifice.

**Psalms 140:3**

Set guard, Lord, for my mouth, and door of enclosure around my lips.

**Psalms 140:4**

Do not incline my heart to the words of evil, to make excuses of excuses in sins with men working lawlessness, and I will not join with their chosen ones.

**Psalms 140:5**

A righteous one will instruct me in mercy and reprove me, but oil of a sinner may it not fatten my head; because still my prayer against their pleasures.

**Psalms 140:6**

Their judges were swallowed up beside rock; they will hear my words because they were pleasant.

**Psalms 140:7**

Like thickness of earth broken up upon ground, our bones were scattered beside Hades.

**Psalms 140:8**

Because toward you, Lord, Lord, my eyes; in you I hoped; do not take away my soul.

**Psalms 140:9**

Guard me from snare they set together for me and from stumbling blocks of workers of lawlessness.

**Psalms 140:10**

Sinners will fall in his net; alone I am until I pass by.

#### Chapter 141

**Psalms 141:1**

Of understanding. Of David, when he was in cave. Prayer.

**Psalms 141:2**

With my voice to the Lord I cried; with my voice to the Lord I made supplication.

**Psalms 141:3**

I pour out before him my supplication; my affliction before him I declare.

**Psalms 141:4**

When my spirit was failing from me, then you knew my paths. In this way where I walked, they hid snare for me.

**Psalms 141:5**

I was looking to right and watching, and there was none knowing me; flight perished from me, and none seeking my soul.

**Psalms 141:6**

I cried to you, Lord; I said, "You my hope, my portion in the land of living."

**Psalms 141:7**

Attend to my supplication, because I was greatly humbled; rescue me from those pursuing me, because they grew stronger than I.

**Psalms 141:8**

Bring my soul out from prison to give thanks to your name, Lord. The righteous will wait for me until you repay me.

#### Chapter 142

**Psalms 142:1**

Psalm of David, when son pursued him. Lord, hear my prayer; give ear to my supplication in your truth; hear me in your righteousness.

**Psalms 142:2**

And do not enter into judgment with your servant, because no living one will be justified before you.

**Psalms 142:3**

Because enemy pursued my soul; he humbled my life to earth; he seated me in dark places like the dead of age.

**Psalms 142:4**

And my spirit grew weary upon me; within me my heart troubled.

**Psalms 142:5**

I remembered ancient days and meditated on all your works; in the works of your hands I kept meditating.

**Psalms 142:6**

I spread out my hands to you; my soul as waterless land to you. Selah.

**Psalms 142:7**

Quickly hear me, Lord; my spirit failed. Do not turn away your face from me, and I will be likened to those going down into pit.

**Psalms 142:8**

Make your mercy heard to me in morning, because on you I hoped. Make known to me, Lord, way in which I should walk, because to you I lifted my soul.

**Psalms 142:9**

Rescue me from my enemies, Lord, because to you I fled.

**Psalms 142:10**

Teach me to do your will, because you my God. Your good spirit will guide me in straight land.

**Psalms 142:11**

For the sake of your name, Lord, you will make me live; in your righteousness you will bring my soul out from affliction.

**Psalms 142:12**

And in your mercy you will utterly destroy my enemies and destroy all afflicting my soul, because I am your servant.

#### Chapter 143

**Psalms 143:1**

Of David, against Goliath. Blessed is the Lord my God, teaching my hands for battle, my fingers for war.

**Psalms 143:2**

My mercy and my refuge, my helper and my deliverer, my protector, and on him I hoped, one subduing my people under me.

**Psalms 143:3**

Lord, what man that you became known to him, or son of man that you count him?

**Psalms 143:4**

**Psalms 143:5**

**Psalms 143:6**

**Psalms 143:7**

**Psalms 143:8**

whose mouth spoke vanity and their right hand, the right hand of injustice.

**Psalms 143:9**

God, I will sing new song to you; on ten-stringed psaltery I will sing psalms to you.

**Psalms 143:10**

To one giving salvation to kings, to one redeeming David his servant from evil sword.

**Psalms 143:11**

Rescue me and deliver me from the hand of foreign sons, whose mouth spoke vanity and their right hand, the right hand of injustice.

**Psalms 143:12**

**Psalms 143:13**

**Psalms 143:14**

**Psalms 143:15**

#### Chapter 144

**Psalms 144:1**

Praise of David. I will exalt you, my God, my king, and bless your name forever and forever of age.

**Psalms 144:3**

**Psalms 144:4**

**Psalms 144:5**

**Psalms 144:6**

**Psalms 144:7**

**Psalms 144:9**

**Psalms 144:14**

**Psalms 144:15**

**Psalms 144:16**

**Psalms 144:17**

**Psalms 144:18**

**Psalms 144:19**

**Psalms 144:20**

**Psalms 144:21**

#### Chapter 145

**Psalms 145:1**

**Psalms 145:2**

**Psalms 145:3**

**Psalms 145:5**

**Psalms 145:6**

**Psalms 146:3**

#### Chapter 147

**Psalms 147:1**

#### Chapter 149

#### Chapter 1

**Proverbs 1:1**

**Proverbs 1:9**

**Proverbs 1:10**

**Proverbs 1:11**

**Proverbs 1:12**

**Proverbs 1:13**

**Proverbs 1:14**

**Proverbs 1:15**

**Proverbs 1:16**

**Proverbs 1:17**

**Proverbs 1:18**

**Proverbs 1:19**

**Proverbs 1:20**

Wisdom is hymned in exits, and in broad places she leads boldness.

**Proverbs 1:21**

**Proverbs 1:22**

**Proverbs 1:23**

**Proverbs 1:24**

**Proverbs 1:25**

**Proverbs 1:26**

**Proverbs 1:27**

**Proverbs 1:28**

**Proverbs 1:29**

**Proverbs 1:30**

**Proverbs 1:31**

**Proverbs 1:32**

For because they wronged simple ones, they will be killed, and scrutiny destroys ungodly.

**Proverbs 1:33**

**Proverbs 9:13**

Foolish and bold woman, lacking bread, becomes one who does not know shame.

**Proverbs 9:14**

She sat at the doors of her house on chair openly in squares,

**Proverbs 9:15**

calling those passing by and going straight in their ways,

**Proverbs 9:16**

"Who among you most foolish? Let him turn aside to me." And to those lacking sense I exhort, saying,

**Proverbs 9:17**

"Touch hidden breads pleasantly and sweet water of theft."

**Proverbs 9:18**

But he does not know that earthborn men perish beside her, and he meets floor of Hades. But spring away; do not delay in place, nor set your eye toward her. For thus you will cross foreign water and pass over foreign river. Hold back from foreign water and do not drink from foreign spring, so that you may live long time and years of life be added.

**Proverbs 27:5**

**Proverbs 27:6**

**Proverbs 27:7**

**Proverbs 27:11**

**Proverbs 27:13**

**Proverbs 27:14**

**Proverbs 27:15**

**Proverbs 27:16**

**Proverbs 27:17**

**Proverbs 27:18**

**Proverbs 27:19**

**Proverbs 27:20**

**Proverbs 27:25**

**Proverbs 30:1**

**Proverbs 30:20**

**Proverbs 30:21**

**Proverbs 30:22**

if a servant reigns and a fool is filled with foods,

**Proverbs 30:23**

Four things on the earth are very little, yet wiser than the wise:

**Proverbs 30:26**

**Proverbs 30:27**

**Proverbs 30:28**

and a lizard bracing itself with its hands, though vulnerable, dwells in the fortresses of the king.

**Proverbs 30:30**

**Proverbs 30:31**

**Proverbs 30:32**

**Proverbs 31:1**
